Method: 提出星上AI系统：地面将灾前高分辨率光学图像编码为紧凑潜在表示并上传至卫星；卫星将新获取的灾后图像与预存的潜在表示在轨进行比较，利用AI实现目标级建筑物损毁定位与分类。系统通过孪生网络处理、交叉注意力、潜在空间压缩及鲁棒性数据增强等变体进行设计空间探索与基准测试。

Result: 在xBD数据集上的实验表明，该方法在图像存在未对准的情况下仍能实现可靠且鲁棒的损毁评估，且在强压缩条件下性能下降极小。

Conclusion: 该星上处理架构通过减少下传数据量同时保留任务关键信息，有效提升系统响应性，为星上智能遥感处理提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Rapid identification of damaged buildings after natural disasters or on war areas is crucial to support emergency response and prioritize interventions. Earth Observation constellations provide timely, large-scale coverage, but actionable information is often delayed by data downlink constraints, on-ground processing, and human interpretation. Reducing this latency is essential to improve decision-making responsiveness. In this work, we propose an original AI-based system that enables object-level building damage assessment (localization and damage classification) directly onboard satellites from pre-disaster and post-disaster highresolution optical imagery. Available pre-disaster images are encoded on ground into compact latent representations, transmitted to the satellite, and compared on-board with newly acquired post-event observations. Leveraging AI interpretation capabilities and increasing processing capabilities on-board satellites, the proposed design enables processing directly at the data source, reducing the amount of information to be downlinked while preserving task-relevant content and improving overall system responsivity. We explore the design space through a systematic benchmark of onboard-compatible variants, analyzing the impact of siamese processing, cross-attention, latent-space compression, and robustness-oriented data augmentation. Experiments on xBD dataset demonstrate reliable and robust damage assessment under misalignment, with minimal performance degradation under strong compression.

</details>


### [55] [Mitigating State Aliasing in Vision-Language-Action Models via Inverse Dynamics Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29577)
*Kyujin Lee,Injae Kim,Jihwan Park,Yejun Ju,Minseok Joo,Hyunwoo J. Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于逆动力学学习的辅助目标，通过直接监督VLA视觉编码器区分细微视觉差异来缓解状态混叠问题，在无需额外标注的情况下提升了多种VLA基线的操作性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA模型由于VLM衍生的表示对低级控制所需的细微视觉差异不敏感，导致视觉上相似但动作截然不同的状态之间存在状态混叠问题，而先前方法仅通过端到端预测间接塑造编码器，未显式分析视觉特征空间中的状态混叠。

Method: 引入逆动力学学习作为辅助目标，通过预测当前与未来观测之间的动作来直接监督VLA视觉编码器；同时采用伪反向监督，使编码器暴露于更广泛的动作方向以提升泛化能力。

Result: 在CALVIN ABC-D和SimplerEnv上，多种VLA基线均取得一致性能提升；冻结编码器探针测试和状态-特征对齐分析表明，学习到的视觉表示具有状态区分性，减少了状态混叠，并与机器人状态变化更好对齐。

Conclusion: 逆动力学学习作为辅助目标能有效缓解VLA模型中的状态混叠问题，且无需额外标注，保持了测试时的原始推理流程，是一种轻量且通用的改进方法。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a promising framework that unifies perception, reasoning, and control for robot manipulation by adapting pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) to action prediction. However, VLM-derived representations are often insensitive to subtle visual distinctions required for low-level control, causing state aliasing between visually similar states that require substantially different actions. Prior VLA studies improve visual understanding by generating visual or reasoning outputs, such as future frames, 2D grounding points or traces, or intermediate spatial reasoning steps, but these objectives typically shape the vision encoder only indirectly through end-to-end prediction and do not explicitly analyze state aliasing in the learned visual feature space. To mitigate state aliasing, we introduce inverse dynamics learning as an auxiliary objective that directly supervises the VLA vision encoder. By predicting the action between current and future observations, our objective encourages the encoder to capture fine-grained visual distinctions that determine low-level actions. We further use pseudo-reversed supervision to expose the encoder to a broader range of action directions and improve generalization under limited robot demonstrations. Our method applies to diverse VLA baselines, uses only standard observation-action pairs without additional annotations, and preserves the original inference pipeline at test time. Experiments on CALVIN ABC-D and SimplerEnv show consistent gains across diverse VLA baselines. Frozen-encoder probing and state-feature alignment analyses further show that our method learns state-discriminative visual representations that reduce state aliasing and better align with robot state changes.

</details>


### [56] [ReactBench: A Cause-Driven Benchmark for Multimodal Hallucination via Systematic Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29579)
*Shizhe Zhou,Bohan Jia,Kai Wu,Yan Shen,Tongyun Li,Yuyang Wu,Shaohui Lin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ReactBench是一个因果驱动的多模态幻觉基准测试，通过对抗性图像和诱导幻觉的查询，系统性地暴露多模态大模型在共现偏差、语言先验、跨图像比较感知缺陷和细粒度感知瓶颈等方面的脆弱性，并利用思维链推理识别幻觉的细粒度子原因。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有幻觉基准主要关注检测幻觉结果而非评估其根本原因，且依赖于简单场景和有限的评估格式，无法挑战当前最先进的模型。

Method: 通过对抗性图像和诱导幻觉的查询，设计了四个针对性任务（关系擦除、反事实属性、变化追踪、密集计数），并采用思维链推理进行细粒度子原因识别。

Result: 当前多模态大模型对特定因果幻觉触发器仍然显著脆弱，证明了ReactBench作为系统性、可解释测试床的价值。

Conclusion: ReactBench为诊断和提升多模态模型鲁棒性提供了一个系统化且可解释的测试平台。

Abstract: While multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have achieved rapid progress in vision-language understanding, they remain prone to multimodal hallucinations, producing responses that are inconsistent with the visual input. Existing benchmarks predominantly focus on detecting hallucination outcomes rather than evaluating the underlying causes of these failures. Moreover, many benchmarks rely on simplistic scenarios and limited evaluation formats that no longer challenge state-of-the-art models. To address these limitations, we introduce ReactBench, a cause-driven hallucination benchmark featuring multiple tasks and an exam-style evaluation format. By generating adversarial images and hallucination-inducing queries, ReactBench introduces four targeted tasks: Relational Erasure, Counterfactual Attribute, Alteration Tracing, and Dense Counting. These tasks systematically expose co-occurrence bias, language priors, cross-image comparative perception deficiencies, and fine-grained perceptual bottlenecks. Beyond standard accuracy-based evaluation, we leverage Chain-of-Thought reasoning to identify fine-grained sub-causes of hallucination within each task. Extensive evaluations reveal that current MLLMs remain notably vulnerable to cause-specific hallucination triggers, demonstrating the value of ReactBench as a systematic and interpretable testbed for diagnosing and improving multimodal model robustness. The project page is available at https://reactbench.github.io/.

</details>


### [57] [BitC-3DGS: High-Capacity 3D Gaussian Splatting Watermarking via Bit Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29583)
*Yuquan Bi,Baosheng Yu,Yingke Lei,Jianwei Yang,Hongsong Wang,Jie Gui,Yuan Yan Tang,James Tin-Yau Kwok*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: BitC-3DGS提出一种位压缩框架，通过将多个消息位编码为单个语义令牌，突破CLIP文本编码器77令牌长度限制，实现128位水印容量，在保持高恢复精度和渲染保真度的同时，支持3DGS资产的高容量水印嵌入。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于预训练文本编码器的bit-to-token水印方法受限于CLIP的固定77令牌上下文长度，无法支持超过77位的高容量消息嵌入，难以满足大规模3D资产管线中对丰富信息（如所有权、来源和认证码）的嵌入需求。

Method: 提出位压缩编码方案，将同一块内多个消息位编码为单个语义令牌；设计双分支架构实现联合块解压缩与位解码；引入硬消息采样策略以增强解码器训练时的组合覆盖。

Result: 在Blender和LLFF数据集上，BitC-3DGS实现128位消息容量，恢复精度与最新方法64位相当，同时保持高渲染保真度。

Conclusion: BitC-3DGS通过位压缩机制有效突破CLIP令牌长度限制，为3DGS资产提供了高容量水印方案，兼顾消息恢复准确性与渲染质量。

Abstract: High-capacity watermarking is necessary for 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) assets to embed rich information (e.g., ownership, provenance, and authentication codes), enabling reliable identification and integrity verification in large-scale 3D asset pipelines. Existing bit-to-token watermarking methods based on a pre-trained text encoder are limited to 77-bit messages due to CLIP's fixed 77-token context length, as tokens beyond this limit are unsupported by learned positional embeddings. To address this limitation, we introduce BitC-3DGS, a bit-compression framework that encodes multiple message bits per token. It employs a bit-compressed tokenization scheme that encodes multiple bits within the same chunk into a single semantic token. To enable recovery of the compressed information, it further introduces a dual-branch architecture for joint chunk decompression and bit decoding, along with a hard-message sampling strategy to improve combinatorial coverage during decoder training. Extensive experiments on the Blender and LLFF datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of BitC-3DGS for high-capacity watermarking, achieving high message recovery accuracy and rendering fidelity. For example, it supports 128-bit message capacity with recovery accuracy comparable to that of 64-bit messages in recent state-of-the-art methods.

</details>


### [58] [Non-Forgetting Knowledge Allocation with Bi-level Competition for Class-Incremental Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29592)
*Xiang Tan,Run He,Yawen Cui,Mengchen Zhao,Yan Wu,Tianyi Chen,Huiping Zhuang,Xiaonan Luo,Guanbin Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出NoFA-BC方法，通过非遗忘分配器（将训练转化为递归最小二乘问题）和双层竞争机制（任务内胜者全拿+任务间末位淘汰）来解决基于预训练模型的类别增量学习中的适配器分配与遗忘问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于适配器的类别增量学习方法在推理时对每个适配器采用统一的知识分配，忽略了任务差异的本质，导致适配器利用次优；同时在增量学习约束下，分配器容易随着任务演化而遗忘。

Method: 1) 非遗忘分配器（NFA）：将分配器训练转化为递归最小二乘问题，实现与全数据训练等价的分配器；2) 双层竞争（BLC）：任务内胜者全拿（WTA）提取任务内最大logit表示适配器贡献，任务间末位淘汰（LOF）抑制无关适配器；3) 稳定性增强（SE）进一步改善旧任务性能。

Result: 通过双层竞争机制，每个适配器的参与比例可根据输入定制，实现了更好的适配器知识分配。

Conclusion: NoFA-BC有效解决了类别增量学习中适配器分配不均和遗忘问题，提升了模型性能。

Abstract: Class-Incremental Learning (CIL) with pre-trained models (PTMs) aims to sequentially adapt PTMs to new categories without forgetting old knowledge. Built upon PTMs, existing adapter-based methods mainly train models via distinct task-specific adapters, and present a uniform knowledge allocation for each adapter during inference. However, this allocation mechanism ignores the nature of task discrepancy and leads to suboptimal utilization of adapters. Also, under CIL constraint, an allocator is prone to forgetting when tasks evolve. To address these issues, we propose a Non-Forgetting Allocation with Bi-Level Competition (NoFA-BC). NoFA-BC constructs a non-forgetting allocator (NFA) by transforming the allocator training into a recursive least-squares problem and achieves an allocator equivalent to that trained with all data. Based on the NFA, a Bi-Level Competition (BLC) including an intra-task level Winner-Takes-All (WTA) mechanism and inter-task Last-Ones-Fall (LOF) elimination is proposed to provide better allocation of adapter knowledge. WTA extracts the most significant logit within a task to represent the adapter's contribution and LOF suppresses the irrelevant adapters. With BLC, participation ratio of each adapter can be tailored for each input. Moreover, a Stability Enhancement (SE) process is incorporated to further improve the performance of old tasks.

</details>


### [59] [CogniVerse: Revolutionizing Multi-Modal Retrieval-Augmented Generation with Cognitive Reflection and Geometric Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29602)
*Xiang Fang,Wanlong Fang,Changshuo Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CogniVerse 是一个受认知启发的多模态检索增强生成框架，通过认知反射模块、基于黎曼流形和谱图理论的多模态检索模块，以及采用最优传输损失的分层生成模块，解决了现有MMRAG中的噪声检索、跨模态语义错位和生成不连贯等问题，在准确性和连贯性上显著超越现有系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MMRAG框架存在检索噪声大、跨模态语义不对齐、缺乏自适应推理能力以及局部与全局上下文生成不连贯等关键局限性，亟需一种更鲁棒、更精确的解决方案。

Method: CogniVerse 包含三个协同模块：(1) 认知反射模块，动态评估检索必要性并过滤相关多模态内容；(2) 多模态检索模块，利用信息几何在黎曼流形中对齐嵌入，并通过谱图理论优化知识图谱；(3) 分层生成模块，采用基于最优传输的损失函数平衡token级准确性与全局语义连贯性。

Result: 大量实验表明，CogniVerse 在准确性和连贯性上显著超越现有最先进系统，同时降低了检索延迟。

Conclusion: CogniVerse 通过认知启发的数学化方法有效解决了MMRAG的核心挑战，为多模态知识密集型问答提供了更高效、更精准的解决方案。

Abstract: Multi-modal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (MMRAG) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for enhancing Multimodal Large Language Models in knowledge-intensive question answering by integrating external visual, textual, and structural knowledge. However, existing MMRAG frameworks suffer from critical limitations, including noisy and irrelevant retrieval, cross-modal semantic misalignment, lack of adaptive reasoning, and incoherent generation across local and global contexts. We introduce \textbf{CogniVerse}, a novel MMRAG framework that addresses these challenges through a cognitive-inspired, mathematically rigorous approach. Drawing from human-like reasoning, CogniVerse integrates three synergistic components: (1) a Cognitive Reflection Module that dynamically assesses retrieval necessity and filters relevant multi-modal content, reducing noise and computational overhead; (2) a Multi-modal Retrieval Module that aligns embeddings in a Riemannian manifold using information geometry and refines knowledge graphs via spectral graph theory, ensuring precise and coherent retrieval; and (3) a Hierarchical Generation Module that employs an optimal transport-based loss to balance token-level accuracy and global semantic coherence. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CogniVerse significantly outperforms state-of-the-art systems in both accuracy and coherence, while reducing retrieval latency.

</details>


### [60] [Learning Context-Conditioned Predicate Semantics via Prototype Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29610)
*NamGyu Jung,Chang Choi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: AlignG通过原型反馈机制学习上下文条件化的谓词语义，在场景图生成任务中实现了对多义谓词的动态语义重组，在VG-150和GQA-200数据集上取得了最优结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 场景图生成中，谓词具有多义性（polysemy），其含义随上下文变化。现有方法将谓词分解为多个静态原型或检索语义相似的样本，但这些策略保持谓词表示静态不变，无法根据图像特定证据重组语义，导致在模糊上下文中出现系统性混淆。

Method: AlignG提出上下文条件化的谓词语义学习框架，通过原型反馈机制实现：1）从每张图像的关系候选中推断上下文条件化的谓词语义；2）将自适应语义反馈回关系表示进行重新校准；3）学习目标将这种适应锚定到全局语义中心，在防止语义漂移的同时允许选择性重组。

Result: 在VG-150和GQA-200数据集上，SGDet任务中F@100分别提升+1.4和+2.7，超越现有最优基线。可视化显示原型会根据场景证据进行选择性的合并或分离。

Conclusion: AlignG通过上下文感知的谓词语义动态重组，有效解决了场景图生成中谓词多义性问题，证明了原型反馈机制在语义适应与保持全局一致性之间的有效性。

Abstract: In scene graph generation, a central challenge is modeling polysemous predicates whose meanings shift across contexts. Prior approaches address this issue by decomposing predicates into multiple static prototypes or retrieving semantically similar exemplars. However, these strategies keep predicate representations static and cannot reorganize semantics to reflect image-specific evidence, leading to systematic confusions in ambiguous contexts. We propose AlignG, which learns context-conditioned predicate semantics via prototype feedback. AlignG infers context-conditioned predicate semantics from the relation candidates within each image and feeds the adapted semantics back to recalibrate relation representations. The learning objective anchors this adaptation to global semantic centers, preventing semantic drift while still allowing selective reorganization when the scene provides consistent relational cues. Experiments on VG-150 and GQA-200 show consistent improvements over state-of-the-art baselines, with F@100 improvements of +1.4 on VG-150 and +2.7 on GQA-200 under SGDet. We further visualize per-image prototype similarity shifts and observe coherent context-dependent reorganization where prototypes selectively merge or separate predicates according to scene evidence. The code is available at https://github.com/Namgyu97/AlignG-SGG.pytorch.

</details>


### [61] [DiffSpot: Can VLMs Spot Fine-Grained Visual Differences in Web Interfaces?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29615)
*Linhao Zhang,Aiwei Liu,Yuan Liu,Xiao Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DiffSpot是一个基于代码驱动的Web界面找差异基准测试，通过CSS属性突变构造了4,400个图像对。评估13个前沿VLM模型发现，最佳模型仅能识别40.7%的真实变化，Hard难度召回率低于23%，且难度与CSS属性类型强相关，像素幅度和CLIP距离均无法可靠预测召回率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM在高层次图像-文本对齐上进展显著，但感知细微视觉差异的能力仍然有限。作者利用Web界面中局部视觉变化作为细粒度感知的诊断测试，同时满足GUI智能体和设计工具的实际需求，因此需要构建一个可控的、开放的找差异基准来评估VLM的细粒度视觉感知能力。

Method: DiffSpot通过突变自包含HTML中目标元素的单个CSS属性并重渲染页面来构造受控图像对，记录变化的属性、元素和突变幅度。采用"接地门控"机制确保渲染后的像素差异仅局限于目标元素。最终数据集包含4,400对，其中3,900对有差异对均衡覆盖13种CSS属性操作符和三个难度层级，另有500个无差异对用于幻觉控制。

Result: 评估13个前沿VLM模型零样本表现，最佳模型仅识别40.7%的真实变化，所有模型在Hard难度层级上召回率均低于23%。难度与CSS属性类型高度相关，像素幅度和CLIP距离均不能可靠预测各CSS操作符上的召回率。

Conclusion: 当前VLM在Web界面的细粒度视觉感知上仍然存在显著局限，尤其是对于高难度变化。DiffSpot揭示了难度与CSS属性类型的强依赖性，表明现有VLM对不同类型的视觉变化感知能力差异巨大，且简单基于像素或特征距离的度量无法准确预测模型表现。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have made strong progress on high-level image-text alignment, yet their ability to perceive subtle visual differences remains limited. We study this problem in rendered web interfaces, where localized visual changes are both a diagnostic test of fine-grained perception and a practical requirement for GUI agents and design tools. We introduce \textbf{DiffSpot}, a code-driven benchmark for open-ended spot-the-difference on web interfaces. DiffSpot constructs controlled image pairs by mutating a single CSS property of a target element in self-contained HTML, re-rendering the page, and recording the changed property, element, and mutation magnitude. A grounding gate retains only pairs whose rendered pixel difference is confined to the target element. The benchmark contains 4{,}400 pairs, including 3{,}900 has-diff pairs balanced across 13 CSS-property operators and three difficulty tiers, plus 500 no-diff pairs for hallucination control. Evaluating 13 frontier VLMs zero-shot, we find that even the best model identifies only $40.7\%$ of true changes, with Hard-tier Recall below $23\%$ for every model. DiffSpot further shows that difficulty is strongly property-dependent: across CSS operators, neither pixel magnitude nor CLIP distance reliably predicts Recall.

</details>


### [62] [AgentCVR: Active Multi-Agent Cross-Video Reasoning via Script-Simulated Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29643)
*Yilun Qiu,Jiahe Wang,Cilin Yan,Jiayin Cai,Xiaolong Jiang,Yao Hu,Chun Yuan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出AgentCVR，一种多智能体框架，将跨视频推理（CVR）建模为主动证据获取任务，通过主智能体协调视觉和音频智能体进行定向证据提取，并引入脚本模拟强化学习（Script-Simulated RL）优化策略，在CVR基准测试中超越单次基线方法，性能媲美闭源系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MLLM在跨视频推理中采用单次编码策略，将多视频压缩到共享上下文中，容易掩盖稀有关键证据，导致CVR任务表现不佳。

Method: 提出AgentCVR多智能体框架：1) Master Agent迭代协调专用的Visual Agent和Audio Agent进行定向证据提取；2) 引入Script-Simulated RL，利用LLM生成的语义脚本和轻量文本模拟器优化策略，避免在线探索时昂贵的多模态推理开销。

Result: 在全面的CVR基准测试中，AgentCVR优于单次基线方法，性能与最先进的闭源系统相当，尤其在复杂跨视频对齐和定位任务上表现突出。

Conclusion: AgentCVR通过多智能体协作与脚本模拟强化学习有效解决了跨视频推理中的关键证据遮蔽问题，为CVR提供了新的范式。

Abstract: Cross-Video Reasoning (CVR) has emerged as a critical frontier in multimodal intelligence, requiring models to retrieve, align, and aggregate evidence distributed across multiple videos. Current Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) often struggle with CVR, as simple single-pass strategies encode multiple videos into a shared compressed context, potentially obscuring rare but critical evidence. In this paper, we propose AgentCVR, a multi-agent framework that treats CVR as an active evidence-acquisition task. AgentCVR employs a Master Agent to iteratively coordinate specialized Visual and Audio Agents for targeted evidence extraction. To ensure efficient training, we introduce Script-Simulated RL, which optimizes the agent's policy with LLM-generated semantic scripts and a lightweight text-based simulator, bypassing costly multimodal inference during online exploration. Experimental results on a comprehensive CVR benchmark show that AgentCVR outperforms single-pass baselines and achieves comparable performance to state-of-the-art closed-source systems, particularly in complex cross-video alignment and localization. To ensure reproducibility, our code is available at https://github.com/wang-jh24/AgentCVR.

</details>


### [63] [MARTIAN: A Rendering Framework for Aerial Mars Imagery from HiRISE Orbital Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29647)
*Dario Pisanti,Georgios Georgakis*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MARTIAN是一个基于Blender的开源渲染框架，利用真实的HiRISE轨道地图产品，在可控光照条件和不同高度下合成逼真的火星地形航拍视图，并生成精确的位姿标注，以解决火星视觉导航训练数据稀缺的问题。该框架已在Ingenuity及未来火星旋翼机的地图定位系统中得到验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 火星表面光照条件多样、地形形态复杂，视觉导航需要鲁棒的管道，但大规模带标注的航拍数据集极为稀缺，成为训练和评估此类方法的关键瓶颈。

Method: 基于Blender的开源渲染框架，利用真实HiRISE轨道地图产品，在可控光照条件和不同高度下合成逼真的火星地形航拍视图，并生成精确的位姿标注。

Result: 该框架已成功部署于Ingenuity和未来火星旋翼机的地图定位系统，合成训练得到的深度图像匹配器能够在真实火星图像上成功评估。

Conclusion: MARTIAN有效解决了火星航拍标注数据稀缺问题，为火星旋翼机视觉导航提供可扩展的数据生成方案，代码已开源。

Abstract: Aerial navigation on Mars requires vision-based pipelines that are robust to the diverse illumination conditions and terrain morphology of the Martian surface. A key bottleneck for training and evaluating such methods is the scarcity of large-scale, annotated aerial datasets. We present MARTIAN, an open-source Blender-based rendering framework that leverages real HiRISE orbital map products to synthesize realistic aerial views of the Martian terrain under controllable lighting conditions and at varying altitudes. MARTIAN generates observations with accurate pose annotations, directly addressing the scarcity of training data for vision-based navigation on Mars. The framework has been validated through its deployment in concurrent work on map-based localization systems for Ingenuity and future Mars rotorcraft, where synthetically trained deep image matchers were successfully evaluated on real Mars imagery. MARTIAN is publicly available at: https://github.com/nasa-jpl/martian.

</details>


### [64] [SuperVoxelGPT: Adaptive and Ordered 3D Tokenization for Autoregressive Shape Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29655)
*Yuan Li,Congyi Zhang,Xifeng Gao,Xiaohu Guo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SuperVoxelGPT 提出了一种基于自适应、确定性排序的超体素标记化框架，解决了自回归多模态大语言模型在3D生成中因标记化不足导致的高分辨率生成困难和序列过长问题。通过粗糙几何显著性分布预测和显著性引导的质心Voronoi剖分构建形状自适应超体素分区，结合SuperVoxelVAE和微调MLLM实现自回归生成。在Trellis-500K上，序列长度降至均匀体素标记化的12.8%，生成质量达SOTA，平均加速10倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自回归多模态大语言模型在3D生成中面临标记化的结构权衡：基于集合的紧凑表示因确定性空间排序缺失导致序列预测模糊，而均匀或八叉树体素网格虽保留排序但存在严重冗余和序列过长问题，限制了稳定高效的3D生成。

Method: 1) 预测粗糙几何显著性分布；2) 通过显著性引导的质心Voronoi剖分（CVT）构建形状自适应超体素分区，复杂区域分配细粒度单元，平滑区域分配大单元；3) 引入SuperVoxelVAE对超体素进行编码；4) 微调预训练MLLM自回归生成超体素token。

Result: 在Trellis-500K数据集上，SuperVoxelGPT将token序列长度降至均匀体素标记化的12.8%，实现SOTA生成质量，平均速度提升10倍。

Conclusion: SuperVoxelGPT通过表示优先的自适应超体素标记化框架，有效解决了自回归3D生成中序列长度与生成质量之间的权衡问题，为高分辨率3D生成提供了一种高效且稳定的新范式。

Abstract: Autoregressive multimodal large language models (MLLMs) enable 3D generation but struggle to scale to high-resolution shapes due to
  inadequate 3D tokenizations. Compact set-based representations discard deterministic spatial ordering, leading to ambiguous sequence
  prediction, while uniform or octree-based voxel grids preserve ordering at the cost of severe redundancy and excessively long
  sequences. This structural trade-off limits stable and efficient autoregressive 3D generation.
  We present SuperVoxelGPT, a representation-first framework that resolves this tension through adaptive and deterministically ordered
  supervoxel tokenization. Given a prompt, we first predict a coarse geometric saliency distribution and construct a shape-adaptive
  supervoxel partition using saliency-guided centroidal Voronoi tessellation, allocating fine-grained cells to complex regions and
  larger cells to smooth regions. Conditioned on the text and ordered supervoxel layout, we introduce a SuperVoxelVAE and fine-tune a
  pretrained MLLM to autoregressively generate supervoxel tokens.
  Experiments on Trellis-500K show that SuperVoxelGPT reduces token sequence length to 12.8% of uniform voxel tokenization while
  achieving state-of-the-art generation quality and an average 10$\times$ speedup over prior methods.

</details>


### [65] [OccamToken: Efficient VLM Inference with Training-Free and Budget-Adaptive Token Pruning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29657)
*Geng Li,Guohao Chen,Ting Chen,Shilin Shan,Kuangji Zuo,Bofan Lyu,Tuo An,Gen Li,Jianfei Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: OccamToken提出了一种基于寄存器锚定的相对证据测试框架，替代传统的绝对排序范式进行视觉Token剪枝。在LLaVA-NeXT等模型上，可将2880个视觉Token压缩至约40个（保留率1.4%），同时保持93%以上的原始精度，无需额外训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉Token剪枝方法基于绝对重要性排序范式存在根本性缺陷：注意力下沉现象扭曲了Token重要性排名，而图像冗余和查询依赖的视觉证据使得固定Token预算在不同输入间不可靠。

Method: 提出OccamToken框架，核心思想是利用寄存器Token作为稳定参考基准，评估视觉Token是否提供了超出寄存器参考的信息。具体通过寄存器注意力动态阈值，实现图像自适应的冗余剪枝和查询自适应的相关性剪枝。

Result: 在LLaVA-NeXT、LLaVA-v1.5和Qwen3-VL上均取得一致的精度-效率权衡提升。在LLaVA-NeXT上，将2880个视觉Token压缩至约40个（保留率1.4%），保持93%以上原始精度。

Conclusion: 基于寄存器锚定的相对证据测试范式有效替代了绝对排序范式，实现了训练无关的、稳定的极端视觉Token压缩，且在不同模型上具有泛化性。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) rely on long visual token sequences for visual understanding, making the prefill stage expensive in both computation and memory. Most existing pruning methods follow an absolute-ranking paradigm, assigning importance scores to visual tokens and retaining a fixed top-K subset. In this work, we argue that this paradigm is fundamentally brittle: attention sinks distort token importance rankings, while image redundancy and query-dependent visual evidence make fixed token budgets unreliable across inputs. We propose OccamToken, a training-free framework that replaces absolute token ranking with register-anchored relative evidence testing. Instead of asking which tokens are globally important, OccamToken evaluates whether a visual token provides information beyond a register-based reference. Our key insight is that register tokens naturally absorb low-information attention patterns, making them a stable reference for identifying genuinely informative visual evidence. Based on this principle, OccamToken performs both image-adaptive redundancy pruning and query-adaptive relevance pruning through dynamic thresholds derived from register attention. Across LLaVA-NeXT, LLaVA-v1.5, and Qwen3-VL, OccamToken consistently improves the accuracy-efficiency trade-off without additional training. Notably, on LLaVA-NeXT, it reduces 2,880 visual tokens to approximately 40 while preserving over 93% of the original accuracy, enabling stable visual token compression even in the extreme 1.4% retention regime.

</details>


### [66] [Geometry-Guided Modeling of Foundation Features Enables Generalizable Object Shape Deformation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29661)
*Yiyao Ma,Kai Chen,Zhongxiang Zhou,Zhuheng Song,Dongsheng Xie,Zelong Tan,Rong Xiong,Qi Dou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种通用可变形学习框架GODeform，通过几何引导的特征建模和视角自适应特征聚合，从单目图像中重建3D物体，在形状变化大、视角多样的场景下显著优于现有方法，并支持真实世界的灵巧机器人操作任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单目3D形状恢复在任意视角和未见物体类别上的鲁棒泛化仍是一个重大挑战，现有方法难以处理模板与目标之间复杂的形状变化以及固定模板与任意目标视角之间的差异。

Method: 1) 几何引导的特征建模：利用模板拓扑增强基础特征得到几何感知表示，再与目标观测显式关联以指导变形；2) 视角自适应特征聚合模块：利用多视角模板特征及对应相机位姿丰富规范模板表示，实现跨视角的鲁棒特征对齐。

Result: 在应对大形状变化和多样视角方面显著优于现有方法，对未见类别展现出强泛化能力，并能有效支持下游真实灵巧机器人操作任务。

Conclusion: GODeform通过几何引导的变形学习和视角自适应机制，实现了对任意视角和未见类别的强泛化3D重建，并为机器人灵巧操作等下游任务提供了可靠支持。

Abstract: Monocular 3D shape recovery is fundamental to geometric understanding, yet achieving robust generalization across arbitrary viewpoints and unseen object categories remains a significant challenge. In this paper, we present a generalizable deformation learning framework that reconstructs 3D objects by explicitly deforming a category-level shape template to match the target observation. To address complex shape variations between the template and the target, we introduce a geometry-guided feature modeling mechanism. This process first enriches foundation features with template topology to yield a geometry-aware representation, which is then explicitly correlated with the target observation to guide precise deformation. Furthermore, to bridge the disparity between the fixed template and arbitrary target views, we propose a view-adaptive feature aggregation module. This module leverages multi-view template features and their corresponding camera poses to enrich the canonical template representation, ensuring robust feature alignment regardless of the target's perspective. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in handling large shape variations and diverse viewpoints, exhibiting strong generalization to novel categories and effectively supporting downstream real-world dexterous robotic manipulation tasks. Project homepage: https://GODeform.github.io/

</details>


### [67] [Dual-Stream Diffusion for World-Model Augmented Vision-Language-Action Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.27607)
*John Won,Kyungmin Lee,Huiwon Jang,Dongyoung Kim,Jinwoo Shin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出DUST框架，通过双流扩散Transformer解决VLA中的模态间隙问题，在模拟和真实机器人任务上均取得显著性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLAs与世界模型结合面临状态与动作联合预测的模态间隙挑战，需要一种能保持各模态独立性同时实现跨模态知识共享的方法。

Method: 提出DUST框架，包含：(1) 双流扩散Transformer，保持独立模态流并支持跨模态共享；(2) 独立噪声扰动与解耦流匹配损失，学习跨模态因果关系；(3) 异步采样方法，通过推理时缩放提升性能。

Result: 在RoboCasa和GR-1模拟基准上比SOTA方法提升6%，推理时缩放额外提升2-5%；在Franka Research 3真实任务中成功率提升10%。

Conclusion: DUST有效弥合了模态间隙，支持无动作视频预训练及异构机器人/人类数据集的联合训练，展示了良好的迁移学习能力。

Abstract: Augmenting vision-language-action models (VLAs) with world models is promising for robotic policy learning but faces challenges in jointly predicting states and actions due to the modality gap. To address this, we propose DUal-STream diffusion (DUST), a world-model augmented VLA framework featuring a multimodal diffusion transformer that maintains separate modality streams while enabling cross-modal knowledge sharing. In addition, DUST utilizes independent noise perturbations and a decoupled flow matching loss to learn cross-modal causal relationships. We further introduce an asynchronous sampling method for action and vision tokens that enhances performance through inference-time scaling. Experimental results on simulated benchmarks like RoboCasa and GR-1 show that DUST achieves up to 6% gains over state-of-the-art VLA and world-modeling baselines, with inference-time scaling providing an additional 2-5% improvement. In real-world tasks using the Franka Research 3, DUST outperforms baselines by 10% in success rate. Finally, we demonstrate that DUST enables effective transfer learning through both pretraining on action-free videos and joint-training with heterogeneous robot and human datasets.

</details>


### [68] [SAFE-Pruner: Semantic Attention-Guided Future-Aware Token Pruning for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29662)
*Shilin Ma,Chubin Zhang,Changyuan Wang,Yuji Wang,Yue Wu,Zixuan Wang,Jingqi Tian,Zheng Zhu,Yansong Tang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SAFE-Pruner提出了一种面向视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的剪枝框架，通过利用语义注意力一致性（模型在多个执行步骤中注意力概率集中在相同语义实体上的趋势），预测深层token重要性，实现1.89倍加速且成功率仅下降不到1.7%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉token剪枝方法大多依赖浅层线索进行剪枝决策，容易丢弃深层网络所需的关键视觉信息，导致加速不稳定。

Method: 1) 发现VLA模型的语义注意力一致性现象；2) 提出前瞻性策略，利用浅层注意力预测深层token重要性；3) 引入自适应子任务划分策略检测注意力突变，提升预测准确性。

Result: 在仿真和真实场景中实现最高1.89倍加速，成功率下降不超过1.7%，超越现有方法最多1.9%。

Conclusion: 通过前瞻性剪枝策略，SAFE-Pruner在保持高任务成功率的同时显著加速VLA推理，是一种即插即用的高效剪枝框架。

Abstract: Real-time inference of vision-language-action (VLA) models is essential for robotic control. While visual token pruning has shown strong potential for accelerating inference, most existing methods mainly base pruning decisions on shallow-layer cues and risk discarding visual information required by deep layers. To address this issue, we propose SAFE-Pruner, a plug-and-play pruning framework that incorporates attention cues of future layers into pruning decisions. Specifically, we identify semantic attention consistency, the tendency that VLA models concentrate their attention probability mass on the same semantic entity across execution steps. Based on this observation, we design a forward-looking strategy to forecast the token saliency in deep layers, which prevents the premature removal of critical tokens and leads to more stable acceleration. We further introduce an adaptive subtask division strategy to detect abrupt attention shifts, thereby improving forecasting accuracy and pruning reliability. Extensive experiments in simulation and real-world settings demonstrate that our method achieves up to 1.89x speedup with a minimal degradation in success rate of less than 1.7%, while outperforming state-of-the-art methods by up to 1.9%.

</details>


### [69] [Unsupervised Semantic Segmentation Facilitates Model Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29691)
*Xiaoyan Yu,Lisa Mais,Jannik Franzen,Peter Hirsch,Nick Lechtenbörger,Andreas Mardt,Dagmar Kainmüller*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种简单直观的可视化协议，通过无监督语义分割结果来理解自监督视觉Transformer（ViT）的表示特性，揭示了不同SSL模型（对比学习 vs 掩码图像建模）的位置偏差、尺度行为及边界伪影等差异，并帮助区分位置效应与局部性偏差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前自监督学习产生的视觉Transformer模型多样性丰富，但社区对模型理解不够深入，对比学习模型的结论有时被错误地泛化到掩码图像建模模型上。作者希望提供一个简单直观的可视化协议，使模型理解对广泛受众变得直接和易于解释。

Method: 提出一个基于可视化无监督语义分割结果的协议，目标不是最大化分割性能，而是传达跨图像一致出现的模型行为。通过在多个SSL模型的各层和表示上进行基准测试，分析位置偏差、尺度行为及边界伪影等特性。

Result: 获得了关于不同SSL模型位置偏差和尺度行为的新见解，包括在DINOv3-Large模型令牌中发现了强边界伪影。该协议还能清晰地区分位置效应与局部性偏差。

Conclusion: 该可视化协议补充并帮助传达了已有研究成果，代码已公开在GitHub上，有望推动更广泛社区对模型的进一步理解。

Abstract: Self-supervised learning (SSL) has produced a diverse landscape of vision transformers (ViTs) whose pretrained representations support a wide range of downstream tasks. Towards a better understanding of these models, a body of work has assessed the mechanics of their self-attention as well as the types of information captured across their representations, revealing, for example, stark differences between models trained with contrastive learning (CL) and masked image modeling (MIM). However, these advances in model understanding have not yet fully permeated the broader community, where insights specific to CL models are sometimes generalized to MIM models. To make model understanding straightforward and intuitive for a broad audience, we propose a simple and easily interpretable visualization protocol.
  Our protocol is based on visualizing unsupervised semantic segmentation results, yet our goal is not to maximize segmentation performance. Instead, it allows us to convey model behaviors that consistently emerge across images. Benchmarking a diverse set of SSL models across layers and representations, we obtain novel insights into distinct positional biases and scaling behaviors, including strong boundary artifacts in DINOv3-Large model tokens. These insights complement and help communicate a range of previous findings.
  Our protocol further enables a clear visual distinction between positional effects and the closely related but distinct locality bias, which has been studied much more extensively in the literature. The protocol is publicly available on GitHub and we believe it will catalyze further model understanding for a broad community.

</details>


### [70] [SurfFill: Completion of LiDAR Point Clouds via Gaussian Surfel Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.03010)
*Svenja Strobel,Matthias Innmann,Bernhard Egger,Marc Stamminger,Linus Franke*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SurfFill 提出了一种基于高斯曲面元（Gaussian surfel）的 LiDAR 点云补全方法。通过分析 LiDAR 光束发散导致薄结构丢失的问题，利用点云密度变化识别缺失区域，引导高斯曲面元重建聚焦于这些模糊区域，最终提取并采样高斯基元以补全点云，并采用分治策略处理大规模场景，效果优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Method: 1. 将 LiDAR 光束发散归因为薄结构和边缘伪影的主要因素；2. 提出模糊性启发式方法，通过评估点云密度变化识别靠近缺失区域的可疑点；3. 利用这些可疑点引导高斯曲面元重建，优化和密集化聚焦于模糊区域；4. 从模糊区域的高斯基元中提取并采样点云以完成补全；5. 针对大规模重建，采用分治策略处理建筑规模的点云补全。

Result: 在合成和真实场景的 LiDAR 点云补全任务上，SurfFill 在性能上优于先前的重建方法。

Conclusion: SurfFill 通过结合 LiDAR 与相机捕获的优势，利用光束发散分析与高斯曲面元引导优化，有效补全了 LiDAR 点云中缺失的薄结构和边缘细节，且适用于大规模场景。

Abstract: LiDAR-captured point clouds are often considered the gold standard in active 3D reconstruction. While their accuracy is exceptional in flat regions, the capturing is susceptible to miss small geometric structures and may fail with dark, absorbent materials. Alternatively, capturing multiple photos of the scene and applying 3D photogrammetry can infer these details as they often represent feature-rich regions. However, the accuracy of LiDAR for featureless regions is rarely reached. Therefore, we suggest combining the strengths of LiDAR and camera-based capture by introducing SurfFill: a Gaussian surfel-based LiDAR completion scheme. We analyze LiDAR capturings and attribute LiDAR beam divergence as a main factor for artifacts, manifesting mostly at thin structures and edges. We use this insight to introduce an ambiguity heuristic for completed scans by evaluating the change in density in the point cloud. This allows us to identify points close to missed areas, which we can then use to grow additional points from to complete the scan. For this point growing, we constrain Gaussian surfel reconstruction to focus optimization and densification on these ambiguous areas. Finally, Gaussian primitives of the reconstruction in ambiguous areas are extracted and sampled for points to complete the point cloud. To address the challenges of large-scale reconstruction, we extend this pipeline with a divide-and-conquer scheme for building-sized point cloud completion. We evaluate on the task of LiDAR point cloud completion of synthetic and real-world scenes and find that our method outperforms previous reconstruction methods.

</details>


### [71] [Efficient, Validation-Free Intrinsic Quality Estimation for Large-Scale Face Recognition Datasets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29720)
*Zhichao Chen,Yongle Zhao,Kaicheng Yang,Meng Yang,Yin Xie,Ziyong Feng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种称为Intrinsic Quality (IQ)的免验证度量方法，通过邻域一致性和全局表示子空间复杂度两个组件，在无需完整训练的情况下评估人脸识别数据集的潜力，支持快速数据集诊断和筛选。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的人脸识别数据集质量评估通常需要完整的模型训练流程，耗时且计算资源消耗大。缺乏一种能够在训练前快速评估数据集固有潜力的方法，以帮助研究人员在投入资源密集型训练之前进行数据集诊断和筛选。

Method: IQ由两个组件构成：(i) 邻域一致性分数（Neighbor-Consistency Score），通过最近邻量化局部身份标签的一致性；(ii) 全局表示子空间复杂度（Effective Rank, ER），捕捉底层嵌入几何结构和数据集多样性。评估可使用轻量级代理模型或数据子集快速完成。

Result: 提出了针对干净、噪声和混合质量FR数据集的实验协议，并概述了验证IQ对下游性能预测能力的评估方法。

Conclusion: IQ作为一种免验证的度量方法，能够在无需完整训练的情况下有效评估人脸识别数据集的固有潜力，为数据集诊断和筛选提供了一种高效的工具，有助于在资源密集型训练前做出更优的数据选择决策。

Abstract: We propose Intrinsic Quality (IQ), a validation-free metric designed to estimate the inherent potential of face recognition (FR) datasets to produce high-performance models without the need for full-scale training. IQ integrates two components: (i) a Neighbor-Consistency Score that quantifies local identity label agreement via nearest neighbors, and (ii) Global Representation Subspace Complexity (Effective Rank, ER), which captures the underlying embedding geometry and dataset diversity. IQ allows for rapid evaluation using lightweight proxy models or data subsets, facilitating dataset diagnosis and curation prior to resource-intensive full-scale training. We describe an experimental protocol tailored to clean, noisy, and mixed-quality FR datasets, and outline evaluation methodologies to validate IQ's predictive power for downstream performance.

</details>


### [72] [SLAD : Shared LoRA Adapters for Task Specific Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29726)
*Reda Bensaid,Yassir Bendou,Vincent Gripon,François Leduc-Primeau*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SLAD方法，通过低秩适应和参数共享策略改善教师与学生模型间的特征对齐，在任务特定蒸馏框架下实现更高效的知识迁移，训练速度提升2倍，在多个分类和分割数据集上达到最先进性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在资源受限环境（如嵌入式系统）中，缩小版基础模型适配下游任务日益流行。近期研究发现，教师模型微调会导致师生特征表示不对齐，从而阻碍知识蒸馏效果。本文旨在解决这一特征对齐问题，提升任务特定蒸馏的效率。

Method: 首先利用低秩适应（LoRA）替代微调，改善特征对齐；进一步提出参数共享策略，在联合训练中共享教师和学生编码器之间的适配器参数。所提方法名为SLAD。

Result: SLAD方法实现了更好的师生特征对齐，不仅学生模型性能提升，教师模型性能也得到增强；训练速度比微调快2倍；在多个分类和分割数据集上达到任务特定蒸馏框架下的最先进性能。

Conclusion: 特征对齐是影响知识蒸馏效果的关键因素，通过低秩适应和参数共享可以有效缓解教师微调导致的对齐问题，实现更高效的知识迁移，同时加速训练过程。

Abstract: In the context of resource-constrained environments such as embedded systems, adapting reduced-size foundation models to downstream tasks has become increasingly popular. This has recently motivated the emerging setting of task-specific distillation, where a larger and a smaller version of the same foundation model are both adapted to the same downstream task, with the goal of transferring knowledge from the former to the latter. Recent work has demonstrated the benefits of using a larger version of the same foundation model to assist the adaptation of a smaller one. Typically, the larger model (teacher) is first adapted via fine-tuning or linear probing before its knowledge is distilled into the smaller model (student). While fine-tuning the teacher often increases its performance, recent work showed that probing it leads to better knowledge distillation to the student. Our findings show that this is mainly due to a mis-alignment in feature representation between the teacher and the student which occurs during the teacher's fine-tuning. Inspired by existing efforts to preserve previously learned knowledge, we first propose leveraging low-rank adaptation, resulting in better feature alignment and therefore better knowledge transfer. Drawing from this insight, we further enhance the feature alignment through a parameter-sharing strategy of the adapters between the two encoders during joint training. Our proposed method, SLAD, shows better feature alignment between the teacher and student, which results in increased performance for not only the student but also the teacher model, while being 2x faster to train than fine-tuning. Through extensive experiments on multiple classification and segmentation datasets, we demonstrate the improved accuracy and transfer efficiency of our method, achieving state-of-the-art performance in the task-specific distillation framework.

</details>


### [73] [S2MDF: A Plug-And-Play Layer for Intersection-Free Multi-Object Signed Distance Fields](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29761)
*Deniz Sayin Mercadier,Federico Stella,Aurel Bizeau,Nicolas Talabot,Pascal Fua*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出S2MDF模块，通过对向量值SDF施加硬约束，从根本上防止物体组合隐式表示中的几何穿透，无需修改网络架构且计算开销极小。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有物体组合隐式表面表示（每个物体由SDF编码）存在多个SDF产生的几何体相互穿透的问题，违反物理合理性。现有方法使用软惩罚项只能减少而非消除穿透，且需要仔细的损失加权。

Method: 提出对向量值SDF的硬约束，并设计S2MDF——一种轻量级即插即用模块，在无需架构修改的情况下强制该约束，兼容标准Marching Cubes等网格算法，可在训练或后处理阶段使用。

Result: 在多个最先进的组合方法上，S2MDF将穿透降低到数值精度水平，同时保持重建质量，优于现有缓解策略。

Conclusion: S2MDF通过硬约束从根本上解决了组合隐式表示中的几何穿透问题，是一个高效、即插即用的解决方案。

Abstract: Compositional implicit surface representations model scenes as collections of objects, each encoded by a Signed Distance Field (SDF). A fundamental limitation of this approach is that multiple SDFs can produce geometries that interpenetrate, violating physical plausibility. Existing mitigation strategies rely on soft penalty terms that reduce but do not eliminate intersections, and require careful loss weighting. To truly prevent interpenetration, we propose a hard constraint on vector-valued SDFs and introduce S2MDF, a lightweight plug-and-play module that enforces the constraint on any object-compositional SDF representation without architectural modifications. It introduces negligible computational overhead and is compatible with linearly-interpolated standard meshing algorithms such as Marching Cubes. It can be applied during training or as a post-processing step. Experiments on multiple state-of-the-art compositional methods show that S2MDF reduces intersections to numerical precision while preserving reconstruction quality, outperforming existing mitigation strategies.

</details>


### [74] [GeoMag: Geometric-Aware Video Motion Magnification via State Space Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29762)
*Kecheng Han,Yuchen Zhang,Bingqing Liu,Boqiang Guo,Wenbin Zheng,Shiyuan Pei*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GeoMag提出了基于状态空间模型的几何感知视频运动放大框架，并构建了包含丰富几何变换和传感器退化的大规模合成数据集Geo-200K，在保持线性复杂度的同时实现了全局一致的运动放大，在视觉保真度和计算效率上优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VMM方法在复杂几何变换下存在结构不一致问题，CNN全局上下文有限，Transformer计算成本高，且训练数据多为简单线性运动，缺乏几何和成像复杂性。

Method: 提出GeoMag框架，基于状态空间模型实现线性复杂度的全局一致运动放大；构建Geo-200K大规模合成数据集，引入丰富几何变换和传感器真实退化。

Result: 在合成和真实基准测试中，GeoMag在视觉保真度和计算效率上持续优于先前方法，产生更少伪影且结构一致性更好。

Conclusion: GeoMag通过状态空间模型和高质量训练数据有效解决了VMM在复杂几何场景下的结构一致性问题。

Abstract: Video Motion Magnification (VMM) reveals imperceptible dynamics but often suffers from structural inconsistencies under complex geometric transformations. Existing learning-based methods generally face a trade-off between the limited global context of CNNs and the high computational cost of Transformers. In addition, current training protocols, largely dominated by simple linear motion, fail to capture the geometric and imaging complexities encountered in real-world videos. To address these issues, we propose GeoMag, a geometric-aware VMM framework built upon State Space Models to achieve globally consistent motion amplification with linear complexity. We further construct Geo-200K, a large-scale synthetic dataset that introduces rich geometric transformations together with sensor-realistic degradations, improving the diversity and realism of training signals. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world benchmarks show that GeoMag consistently outperforms prior methods in visual fidelity and computational efficiency, while producing fewer artifacts and better structural consistency.

</details>


### [75] [Improving CLIP Adaptation by Breaking Tail Alignment for Source-Free Cross-Domain Few-Shot Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29776)
*Shuai Yi,Yixiong Zou,Yuhua Li,Ruixuan Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出自适应尾-头对齐（ATHA）微调策略，通过有选择地减弱低相似度图像token（尾token）与文本嵌入的对齐，解决了CLIP在跨域少样本学习中的过拟合问题，在四个基准上达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CLIP在跨域少样本场景下性能严重下降，现有微调方法对所有图像patch token与文本嵌入进行均匀对齐，但研究发现强行对齐低相似度的"尾token"会导致过拟合，需要更自适应的方法。

Method: 提出ATHA（Adaptive Tail-Head Alignment）策略，将传统的均匀对齐范式转变为自适应对齐范式：对语义信息充足的"头token"加强对齐，对语义信息不足的"尾token"减弱对齐，从而避免过拟合。

Result: 在四个具有挑战性的CDFSL基准数据集上达到SOTA性能，验证了方法的有效性。

Conclusion: 在大领域偏移和训练数据稀缺时，模型难以从视觉输入中提取语义信息；均匀对齐仅对已有足够语义信息的token有效，对尾token强行对齐会导致过拟合，打破对齐反而更有用。

Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) such as CLIP demonstrate strong zero-shot generalization, but their performance significantly degrades in cross-domain scenarios with scarce target-domain training data (Cross-Domain Few-Shot Learning, CDFSL). In this paper, we focus on the target-domain few-shot finetuning in the CLIP-based CDFSL task. Prevailing finetuning paradigms uniformly align all image patch tokens with their corresponding textual embeddings. However, we find a counterintuitive phenomenon: actively pushing away certain low-similarity image tokens, termed "tail tokens", from their textual embeddings consistently improves target-domain performance. We delve into this phenomenon and provide a novel interpretation: under great domain shifts and scarce training data, the model can hardly extract semantic information from visual inputs; therefore, the common belief of alignment is valid only for tokens already containing sufficient semantic information; for tail tokens, forcing the alignment would lead to excessive overfitting to the scarce training, while breaking the alignment is more useful. Motivated by this, we propose Adaptive Tail-Head Alignment (ATHA), a novel fine-tuning strategy for CLIP that transforms the conventional uniform alignment paradigm to an adaptive alignment paradigm, with both alignment strengthening and weakening. Extensive experiments on four challenging CDFSL benchmarks validate our state-of-the-art performance. Our code is available at https://github.com/shuaiyi308/ATHA.

</details>


### [76] [Fewer Steps, Better Performance: Efficient Cross-Modal Clip Trimming for Video Moment Retrieval Using Language](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29793)
*Xiang Fang,Daizong Liu,Wanlong Fang,Pan Zhou,Zichuan Xu,Wenzheng Xu,Junyang Chen,Renfu Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SpotVMR，一种即插即用的高效视频时刻检索方法，通过设计基于语言查询的片段搜索模型和低代价语义索引特征，先定位查询相关区域再精细检索，解决了现有方法因均匀下采样导致边界模糊和跨模态错位的问题，在三个数据集上验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VMR方法先将未修剪视频均匀下采样为固定长度片段，这会导致：(1) 查询相关帧可能被滤除，模糊目标时刻边界；(2) 引入相邻无关帧作为新边界，造成跨模态不对齐，产生边界偏差和推理偏差，难以处理长达数小时的真实视频。

Method: (1) 设计基于语言查询的剪辑搜索模型，学习识别有希望的视频区域进行搜索；(2) 引入低代价语义索引特征，捕捉对象及交互的上下文信息以指导搜索；(3) 使用蒸馏损失解决剪辑选择器与VMR模型端到端联合训练中的优化问题。

Result: 在三个具有挑战性的数据集上进行了广泛实验，结果表明SpotVMR作为即插即用模块能提升现有SOTA VMR方法的效率，同时保持良好检索性能。

Conclusion: SpotVMR通过先剪枝再检索的方式有效缓解了均匀下采样带来的边界模糊和跨模态错位问题，且可作为即插即用模块与现有VMR方法兼容，兼顾效率与性能。

Abstract: Given an untrimmed video and a sentence query, video moment retrieval using language (VMR) aims to locate a target query-relevant moment. Since the untrimmed video is overlong, almost all existing VMR methods first sparsely down-sample each untrimmed video into multiple fixed-length video clips and then conduct multi-modal interactions with the query feature and expensive clip features for reasoning, which is infeasible for long real-world videos that span hours. Since the video is downsampled into fixed-length clips, some query-related frames may be filtered out, which will blur the specific boundary of the target moment, take the adjacent irrelevant frames as new boundaries, easily leading to cross-modal misalignment and introducing both boundary-bias and reasoning-bias. To this end, in this paper, we propose an efficient approach, SpotVMR, to trim the query-relevant clip. Besides, our proposed SpotVMR can serve as plug-and-play module, which achieves efficiency for state-of-the-art VMR methods while maintaining good retrieval performance. Especially, we first design a novel clip search model that learns to identify promising video regions to search conditioned on the language query. Then, we introduce a set of low-cost semantic indexing features to capture the context of objects and interactions that suggest where to search the query-relevant moment. Also, the distillation loss is utilized to address the optimization issues arising from end-to-end joint training of the clip selector and VMR model. Extensive experiments on three challenging datasets demonstrate its effectiveness.

</details>


### [77] [Low-Magnification SEM May Suffice: Interpretable Deep Learning for Multi-Scale Fracture-Cause Classification in Zirconia-Toughened Alumina](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29798)
*Julian Schmid,Pawel Astankow,Tom Vater,Julius Beck,Robert Cichon,Danny Krautz*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种可解释的视觉Transformer（ViT）工作流，用于自动分类氧化铝基复合材料髋关节和膝关节植入物（BIOLOX delta）的断裂原因。在8,493张SEM图像数据集上，该模型在严重类别不平衡下达到0.907的准确率和0.888的macro-F1分数，且低倍率（50x）下性能与高倍率（1k-10kx）相当，Grad-CAM热图定位在标准断口特征上，表明ViT可作为陶瓷植入物质量保证的辅助工具，实现低倍率预筛并减少对高倍率SEM的依赖。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前氧化铝基复合材料植入物断裂起源的识别依赖于耗时、部分主观且需要高倍率扫描电子显微镜（SEM）的断口分析工作流，影响了质量保证效率和患者安全。

Method: 收集5年生产过程中8,493张SEM图像（50x-10,000x），标注为三类缺陷；使用预训练ViT进行微调，采用分层五折交叉验证评估；使用感知哈希/SSIM两级泄漏审计确保样本无重叠；利用Grad-CAM进行可解释性分析。

Result: 微调ViT在严重类别不平衡下达到0.907准确率和0.888 macro-F1；低倍率（50x）与高倍率（1k-10kx）性能相当；Grad-CAM定位在镜面、人字纹、孔隙、加工痕迹等标准断口特征上。

Conclusion: 可解释ViT可作为陶瓷植入物质量保证的互补工具，实现低倍率预筛选，减少对耗时高倍率SEM检查的依赖。

Abstract: Reliable identification of fracture origins in alumina matrix composite hip and knee implants is critical for quality assurance and patient safety, yet current fractographic workflows are time-consuming, partly subjective, and reliant on high-magnification scanning electron microscopy (SEM). We present an interpretable vision-transformer (ViT) workflow for automated classification of fracture causes in an alumina matrix composite (BIOLOX delta, CeramTec GmbH) widely used in total joint replacements. A dataset of 8,493 SEM images (50x-10,000x) was curated from five years of in-production burst and proof tests and annotated into three defect categories defined along the manufacturing chain: green body, hard machining, and material defects. Under severe class imbalance, the fine-tuned ViT reached an accuracy of 0.907 and a macro-F1 of 0.888 in stratified five-fold cross-validation, with a two-stage perceptual-hash/SSIM leakage audit confirming negligible specimen overlap. Notably, performance at low magnification (50x) was comparable to that at high magnification (1k-10kx), indicating that macro-scale features - mirror geometry and hackle line fields - already encode sufficient diagnostic signal. Grad-CAM attributions consistently localised on canonical fractographic cues (mirrors, hackles, pores, machining marks), aligning with established fractographic criteria. Together, these results position interpretable ViTs as a complementary tool for ceramic-implant quality assurance, enabling low-magnification pre-screening and reducing reliance on time-intensive high-magnification inspection.

</details>


### [78] [Not All Inputs Are Valid: Towards Open-Set Video Moment Retrieval Using Language](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29812)
*Xiang Fang,Wanlong Fang,Daizong Liu,Xiaoye Qu,Jianfeng Dong,Pan Zhou,Renfu Li,Zichuan Xu,Lixing Chen,Panpan Zheng,Yu Cheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文首次提出开放集视频时刻检索（OS-VMR）任务，并设计OpenVMR模型，通过归一化流区分ID/OOD查询，实现精确检索与异常拒绝。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VMR方法基于封闭集假设，无法处理开放场景下的无关查询（OOD），在高风险场景（如犯罪检测）中会导致不可逆损失。

Method: 1) 利用归一化流学习ID分布，假设ID查询服从多元高斯分布；2) 引入不确定性分数搜索ID-OOD分界边界；3) 拉近ID查询特征以细化边界；4) 设计视频-查询匹配（粗粒度）和帧-查询匹配（细粒度）跨模态交互；5) 引入正无标签学习进行时刻检索。

Result: 在三个VMR数据集上验证了OpenVMR的有效性。

Conclusion: OpenVMR成功将VMR拓展到开放集场景，兼顾了ID查询的精确检索与OOD查询的拒绝能力。

Abstract: Video Moment Retrieval (VMR) targets to retrieve the specific moment corresponding to a sentence query from an untrimmed video. Although recent works have made remarkable progress in this task, they implicitly are rooted in the closed-set assumption that all the given queries as video-relevant\footnote{In this paper, we treat ``video-relevant query'' as ``in-distribution (ID) query'' and ``video-irrelevant query'' as ``out-of-distribution (OOD) query''.}. Given an OOD query in open-set scenarios, they still utilize it for wrong retrieval, which might lead to irrecoverable losses in high-risk scenarios, \textit{e.g.}, criminal activity detection. To this end, we creatively explore a brand-new VMR setting termed Open-Set Video Moment Retrieval (OS-VMR), where we should not only retrieve the precise moments based on ID query, but also reject OOD queries. In this paper, we make the first attempt to step toward OS-VMR and propose a novel model \textbf{OpenVMR}, which first distinguishes ID and OOD queries based on the normalizing flow technology, and then conducts moment retrieval based on ID queries. Specifically, we first learn the ID distribution by constructing a normalizing flow, and assume the ID query distribution obeys the multi-variate Gaussian distribution. Then, we introduce an uncertainty score to search the ID-OOD separating boundary. After that, we refine the ID-OOD boundary by pulling together ID query features. Besides, video-query matching and frame-query matching are designed for coarse-grained and fine-grained cross-modal interaction, respectively. Finally, a positive-unlabeled learning module is introduced for moment retrieval. Experimental results on three VMR datasets show the effectiveness of our OpenVMR.

</details>


### [79] [Fairness Beyond Demographics: Optimizing Performance Across Appearance-Based Hidden Cohorts in Medical Imaging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29827)
*Milad Masroor,Cuong Nguyen,Kevin Wells,Gustavo Carneiro*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出无标签隐藏队列公平性（LHCF）训练范式，通过将图像聚类为基于外观的K个队列并对其优化公平性，替代传统基于可见人口属性（如性别、年龄）的公平性优化方法，从而发现模型误差的深层来源并避免多人口属性组合导致的稀疏性问题。实验表明，LHCF在单/多人口属性上均达到最优公平性结果，且无需人口标签。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法仅针对单一可见人口属性优化公平性，忽视了更具信息量的潜在隐层分层，且多属性组合会导致训练数据稀疏性问题。

Method: 提出LHCF训练范式：将医学图像聚类为K个基于外观的队列，并在这K个队列上进行公平性优化，而非对可见人口属性直接优化。

Result: 在提出的HIDFairBench基准上，LHCF在单属性与多属性场景下均取得最优公平性结果，且无需使用人口属性标签。

Conclusion: 隐藏队列公平性是一种实用、可扩展且稳健的替代方案，可用于可信医学图像分析。

Abstract: Medical image analysis models can exhibit performance disparities across patient subgroups, threatening clinical safety and fairness. Existing methods typically address this issue by optimizing accuracy and fairness metrics for visible demographic attributes (e.g., sex or age) considered in isolation. This strategy not only overlooks potentially more informative latent stratifications, which may reveal deeper sources of model error and inequity, but also fails to scale when multiple demographic attributes are considered simultaneously due to the resulting sparsity of training data within each subgroup. We deal with these issues by introducing the label-free hidden-cohort fairness (LHCF) training paradigm that instead of maximizing fairness over visible demographic attributes, it optimizes fairness across latent subpopulations discovered from image appearance. By clustering images into K appearance-based cohorts and applying fairness optimization over them, LHCF uncovers underlying sources of model error and avoids the combinatorial sparsity of multi-demographic attributes, reducing disparities across both single and multiple demographic attributes. We demonstrate on our proposed fairness benchmark, HIDFairBench, that LHCF provides state-of-the-art fairness results on single and multiple demographic attributes, despite never using demographic labels for training. Our results position hidden-cohort fairness as a practical, scalable, and robust alternative to demographic-based fairness optimization for trustworthy medical image analysis.

</details>


### [80] [Parameter-Efficient Subspace Decoupling ViT for Mitigating Multi-Task Negative Transfer in Histological Scoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29852)
*Youhan Huang,Jiajun Li,Yilin Fang,Shuai Wang,Chuheng Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种子空间解耦的多任务Vision Transformer，通过轻量级任务特定Adapter和正交性约束，实现NAFLD组织学NAS指标的自动化评分，在降低计算成本的同时提升多任务稳定性和泛化性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: NAFLD组织学评分自动化面临两大挑战：1) 高标注成本；2) NAS指标（脂肪变性、气球样变、炎症）之间存在强相关性，导致多任务学习中出现负迁移，任务间相互干扰影响性能。

Method: 1) 采用Vision Transformer作为骨干网络；2) 设计轻量级任务特定Adapter模块；3) 引入正交性约束（orthogonality-based constraints）为脂肪变性、气球样变和炎症构建独立的特征子空间，在保留共享表示的同时减少任务干扰；4) 构建了带专家标注的多任务小鼠NAFLD组织学数据集。

Result: 实验表明所提方法相比单独训练多个单任务模型，在显著降低计算成本的同时，提升了多任务学习的稳定性和泛化能力。

Conclusion: 子空间解耦策略能有效缓解多任务学习中强相关任务间的负迁移问题，为NAFLD自动化诊断提供了高效且实用的解决方案，代码和数据集将开源支持可复现性。

Abstract: Histological scoring is essential for diagnosing Non-Alcoholic Fatty Liver Disease (NAFLD), yet its automation remains challenging due to the high annotation cost and negative transfer among the strongly correlated NAFLD Activity Score (NAS) indicators in multi-task learning. To address this issue, we propose a subspace-decoupled multi-task Vision Transformer (ViT) that integrates lightweight task-specific Adapters with orthogonality-based constraints. This design constructs independent feature subspaces for steatosis, ballooning, and inflammation, effectively reducing task interference while retaining shared representations. We further construct a curated multi-task mouse NAFLD histology dataset with expert annotations for all NAS components. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method improves multi-task stability and generalization with substantially reduced computational cost compared to training separate single-task models. The code and the curated dataset have been prepared and will be made publicly available upon acceptance to support reproducibility.

</details>


### [81] [Building and Road Recognition in Dense Urban Informal Settlements: A Dataset and Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29856)
*Hongyu Long,Jiaxuan Liu,Rui Cao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了DenseUIS数据集，这是首个专门针对高密度城市村落的建筑和道路提取的高分辨率遥感数据集，覆盖深圳和广州126个城中村。实验发现现有深度学习方法在处理密集非正规聚落的独特形态模式时存在局限性，亟需专门方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 城中村作为非正规聚落对城市可持续发展构成重大挑战，现有遥感数据集主要关注城市建成环境，缺乏针对高密度建筑模式和狭窄道路网络的精细标注数据。

Method: 构建了DenseUIS数据集，包含深圳和广州126个城中村的高分辨率遥感影像及建筑/道路标注，并对现有最先进的深度学习模型进行了全面评估。

Result: 实验表明现有方法在处理密集非正规聚落的独特形态模式时表现有限，揭示了该领域的性能瓶颈。

Conclusion: DenseUIS为高密度非正规环境下的精细城市映射提供了可靠的基准，推动了该方向的专业化研究。

Abstract: As a widespread form of informal settlements, urban villages present significant challenges for sustainable urban development and governance. Precise mapping of their infrastructure is essential, however, existing remote sensing datasets primarily focus on formal urban environments, lacking fine-grained annotated data for the high-density building patterns and narrow road networks typical of urban villages. To address this gap, we introduce the \textit{DenseUIS} dataset, the first high-resolution remote sensing dataset specifically designed for building and road extraction in extremely dense urban informal settlements, covering 126 urban villages across Shenzhen and Guangzhou in China. Furthermore, we conduct a comprehensive evaluation of state-of-the-art deep learning models on this dataset. Experimental results reveal the limitations of existing methods in handling the unique morphological patterns of dense informal settlements, underscoring the need for specialized approaches. \textit{DenseUIS} therefore provides a robust benchmark for advancing fine-grained urban mapping in complex and high-density informal environments. The dataset is publicly available at https://github.com/rui-research/DenseUIS.

</details>


### [82] [Masked Diffusion Vision-Language Models for Temporal Action Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29858)
*Fengshun Wang,Zhengbo Zhang,Zhigang Tu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出MDVLM-TAL，将掩码扩散视觉语言模型适配到时间动作定位任务中，通过双向注意力迭代去噪实现语义与边界联合优化，并设计边界感知掩码、步骤加权重建和IoU奖励来解决标准扩散训练与TAL任务的不匹配问题，在多个数据集上超越自回归基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于视觉-语言公式的时间动作定位方法使用自回归解码器从左到右生成token，导致后续语义证据无法修正早期时间戳预测，限制了边界定位的精度。

Method: 将掩码扩散视觉语言模型(MDVLM)适配到TAL任务：(1) 提出Planned Training Objective，包含边界感知掩码和步骤加权重建，模拟时间token的后期恢复过程；(2) 引入Step-Level IoU Reward，在去噪过程中提供重叠感知的监督信号；(3) 结合标准序列级交叉熵作为基础重建信号。

Result: 在ActivityNet-RTL、ActivityNet-1.3和THUMOS-14数据集上，MDVLM-TAL在时间推理和边界定位上均超越自回归视觉语言基线，在严格时间IoU指标下提升尤为显著。

Conclusion: 掩码扩散模型通过双向注意力和迭代去噪机制，能够有效解决自回归解码器在TAL任务中语义无法回溯修正的问题，实现语义与边界联合优化。

Abstract: Temporal action localization (TAL) requires recognizing the target event and localizing its start and end times precisely in untrimmed videos. Recent vision-language formulations improve semantic reasoning and support language-conditioned outputs, but their autoregressive decoders still generate tokens from left to right, preventing later semantic evidence from revising earlier timestamp predictions.
  We adapt masked diffusion vision-language models (MDVLMs) to TAL so that semantic tokens and boundary tokens remain editable throughout iterative denoising with bidirectional attention, allowing temporal boundaries and semantic content to be refined jointly.
  Direct adaptation, however, creates two TAL-specific mismatches: standard masked diffusion training corrupts all positions uniformly at random, but the time tokens are more reliable when enough semantic context is available; and token-level cross-entropy does not reflect temporal IoU. To address these mismatches, we introduce a Planned Training Objective that uses boundary-aware masking and step-weighted reconstruction to rehearse the late recovery of time tokens, together with a Step-Level IoU Reward that provides overlap-aware supervision during denoising. A standard sequence-level cross-entropy term provides the base reconstruction signal.
  Experiments on ActivityNet-RTL, ActivityNet-1.3, and THUMOS-14 show that MDVLM-TAL improves both temporal reasoning and boundary localization over autoregressive vision-language baselines, with especially strong gains under stricter temporal IoU criteria.

</details>


### [83] [Mitigating Hallucination in Vision-Language Models through Barrier-Regulated Adaptive Closed-form Steering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29881)
*Soumyadeep Jana,Pulkit Mittal,Sanasam Ranbir Singh*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: BRACS是一个无需训练的推理时框架，通过注意力量化监测视觉接地状态，仅在接地退化时以闭式解析解修正隐藏状态，有效减少LVLM的对象幻觉，在CHAIR$_s$上降低9.4点，POPE F1提升2.7点，速度达贪婪解码的80%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LVLM在解码过程中视觉接地逐渐弱化导致对象幻觉。现有的推理时缓解方法存在三个关键缺陷：缺乏显式接地目标、在模型已良好接地时仍进行干预、使用固定的修正强度无法适应接地失效的严重程度。

Method: 提出Barrier-Regulated Adaptive Closed-form Steering (BRACS)框架。通过监测模型自身的注意力来量化视觉接地状态，仅当接地退化时才对隐藏状态施加修正。修正更新以闭式解析解计算，无需训练辅助网络或重训练模型。

Result: 在LLaVA-1.5-7B和Qwen-VL-Chat上，BRACS在幻觉基准上持续优于现有方法：CHAIR$_s$降低9.4点，POPE F1提升2.7点，在四项通用多模态基准上持平或提升。推理速度达贪婪解码吞吐量的80%，平均比基线快1.3倍。

Conclusion: BRACS通过自适应、训练免费的闭式引导有效解决了LVLM的对象幻觉问题，在性能和效率上均优于现有推理时干预方法。

Abstract: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) often hallucinate objects that are not present in the input image, largely because visual grounding weakens as decoding progresses. Existing inference-time mitigation methods modify logits or hidden states throughout generation, but they suffer from three key limitations: they lack an explicit grounding objective, intervene even when the model is already well-grounded, and use fixed correction strengths that do not adapt to the severity of grounding failure. We propose BRACS (Barrier-Regulated Adaptive Closed-form Steering), a training-free steering framework that addresses these issues through barrier-regulated adaptive closed-form steering. BRACS monitors the model's own attention to measure visual grounding and applies corrections to the hidden states only when grounding deteriorates. The corrective update is computed analytically in closed form, requiring no training of auxiliary networks or model retraining. Experiments on LLaVA-1.5-7B and Qwen-VL-Chat show that BRACS consistently outperforms prior methods on hallucination benchmarks, reducing CHAIR$_s$ by 9.4 points and improving POPE F1 by 2.7 points, while matching or improving performance on four general multimodal benchmarks. BRACS also remains efficient, operating at 80% of greedy decoding throughput and achieving 1.3 times higher speed on average than the baselines.

</details>


### [84] [DVSM: Decoder-only View Synthesis Model Done Right](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29891)
*Cheng Sun,Jaesung Choe,Min-Hung Chen,Ryo Hachiuma,Yu-Chiang Frank Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出DVSM，一种仅解码器架构的大视图合成模型，通过将场景隐式表示为KV-cache，在更少参数和相同渲染复杂度下超越编码器-解码器变体，并在多基准测试中实现新SOTA，密集输入下甚至优于3DGS。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 重新审视现有LVSMs中编码器-解码器分离重建与渲染的设计，探索更高效的统一架构。

Method: 1) 采用仅解码器架构，将场景隐式表示为KV-cache；2) 在颜色输入重建网络与仅相机渲染网络之间共享权重，以对齐同视角特征；3) 引入基础模型先验和分阶段块大小策略提升效率-质量权衡。

Result: 在多个新视角合成基准上达到SOTA，密集输入下甚至超越每场景优化的3DGS。

Conclusion: 仅解码器架构配合权重共享、基础模型先验和分阶段块大小策略，能显著提升大视图合成模型的效率与质量。

Abstract: Recent Large View Synthesis Models (LVSMs) advocate an encoder-decoder architecture that separates reconstruction and rendering into distinct networks. We re-examine this design. Through controlled experiments, we show that a decoder-only architecture, which represents scenes implicitly as a KV-cache, outperforms encoder-decoder variants while using fewer parameters at identical rendering complexity. Further analysis shows that sharing weights between the color-input reconstruction network and the camera-only rendering network better aligns their features at the same viewpoint, facilitating image synthesis. Building on this finding, our model, dubbed DVSM, further incorporates foundation model priors and stage-wise patch sizing for an improved efficiency-quality tradeoff. Our results establish a new state of the art for novel-view synthesis across multiple benchmarks, in some cases even outperforming per-scene-optimized 3DGS under dense input views.

</details>


### [85] [Train the Agent, Not the Expert: Learning to Harness Heterogeneous Experts for Multi-Turn Visual Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29894)
*Yaowu Fan,Tao Han,Dazhao Du,Andy J. Ma,Jia Wan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VisHarness是一个可训练视觉智能体，通过解耦高层感知/推理/决策与底层任务执行，学习调度一组异构视觉专家模型，以轻量训练实现通用视觉任务求解，并引入动态视觉记忆归档解决多轮交互中的token开销问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉模型通常针对孤立任务优化，难以支持需要复杂语言理解与密集小目标感知的通用视觉智能，缺乏能在高层推理与底层精确执行之间有效桥接的统一框架。

Method: 提出VisHarness框架：(1) 将高层感知、推理、决策与底层任务执行解耦；(2) 学习可泛化的视觉专家调度策略，通过多轮交互调用异构视觉专家模型；(3) 引入动态视觉记忆归档机制，缓解多轮交互中视觉token快速累积问题，支持在线策略强化学习训练。

Result: 在推理分割、广义指代分割、密集小目标检测、指代计数四个基准上，VisHarness显著优于现有通用模型，且与专用任务模型相比具有竞争力或更优性能。

Conclusion: VisHarness通过专家调度范式在保持智能体通用性的同时充分利用专用模型的精度优势，以轻量训练即可解决多种复杂条件下的基础视觉任务，为通用视觉智能提供了有效路径。

Abstract: Recent progress in computer vision has produced a wide range of powerful specialized models for detection, segmentation, counting, and other visual tasks. However, these models are usually optimized for isolated task formulations, making it difficult to directly support general-purpose visual intelligence, especially when a task requires complex language understanding and dense small-object perception. In this paper, we propose VisHarness, a trainable visual agent that decouples high-level perception, reasoning, and decision-making from low-level task execution. Instead of training a model to solve a specific visual task, VisHarness learns to harness a set of carefully designed heterogeneous visual experts. This paradigm preserves the general intelligence of the agent while fully leveraging the precision advantages of specialized visual models in concrete visual tasks. With only lightweight training, VisHarness learns a generalizable visual expert-harnessing policy and can solve common fundamental vision tasks under various complex conditions through multi-turn interactions with visual expert models. To enable efficient on-policy reinforcement learning training in a live environment, we introduce dynamic visual memory archiving, which mitigates the rapidly accumulating visual-token overhead caused by multi-turn interactions with visual expert models. Experiments on four representative benchmarks covering reasoning segmentation, generalized referring segmentation, dense small-object detection, and referring counting demonstrate that VisHarness substantially outperforms existing general-purpose models and achieves competitive or superior performance compared with task-specific models.

</details>


### [86] [CityGen: Structure-Guided City-Style Synthesis for Cross-City Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29935)
*Zezhong Qian,Zhao Yang,Lu Tan,Zhihao Yan,Weiyi Hong,Haizhuang Liu,Yawei Jueluo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出CityTransfer-Bench基准和CityGen框架，通过扩散模型和高清地图条件合成实现零标签城市自适应，有效提升自动驾驶在跨城市部署中的感知、分割和规划性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动驾驶系统在跨城市部署时面临严重的域偏移（外观、道路拓扑、交通模式），现有方法依赖标注目标数据或城市特定标注，可扩展性和效果有限。

Method: 提出CityTransfer-Bench地理不相交基准用于评估跨城市泛化，并设计CityGen扩散生成框架，通过HD地图条件合成和城市级视觉提示引导，实现零标签城市自适应。

Result: CityGen在多个任务（感知、分割、规划）上一致提升了跨城市鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 建立了可扩展且标签高效的通用自动驾驶基础，为零标签城市自适应提供了有效范式。

Abstract: Autonomous driving systems are commonly trained and evaluated within limited geographic regions, which hinders their scalability when deployed in new cities. However, significant domain shifts in appearance, road topology, and traffic patterns often cause severe performance degradation under cross-city deployment. Existing approaches based on domain adaptation, data augmentation, or synthetic data generation typically rely on labeled target data, city-specific annotations, or task-specific designs, limiting their scalability and effectiveness for holistic evaluation. In this paper, we introduce CityTransfer-Bench, a geographically disjoint benchmark for evaluating cross-city generalization across perception, segmentation, and planning, and propose CityGen, a diffusion-based generative framework that performs zero-label city adaptation via HD-map-conditioned synthesis guided by city-level visual prompts. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CityGen consistently improves cross-city robustness across multiple tasks, establishing a scalable and label-efficient foundation for generalizable autonomous driving.

</details>


### [87] [Mesh-Aware Epipolar Matching for Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimation in Basketball](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29953)
*Li Yin,Qin Haobin,Tomohiro Suzuki,Calvin Yeung,Mariko Isogawa,Keisuke Fujii*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出MAEM，一种无需训练的多视角多人3D姿态估计框架，通过单目3D人体网格恢复模型作为前端，结合两阶段极线匹配策略（基于并查集聚类和逐关节三角化），在无需目标域训练或微调的情况下，在两个篮球数据集上实现了优于现有无监督关联方法的性能（SportCenter EPFL: MPJPE 59.8mm, PA-MPJPE 40.7mm; Human-M3 Basketball: 74.0/51.8mm）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 团队运动场景中的多视角多人3D姿态估计面临球员遮挡、队服导致的视觉相似性以及标注多视角数据稀缺等挑战，限制了有监督方法的泛化能力；而无监督方法的性能受限于2D关键点检测精度和跨视角关联的鲁棒性。现有方法在这些场景下效果不佳，亟需一种无需训练且鲁棒性强的解决方案。

Method: 提出Mesh-Aware Epipolar Matching (MAEM)框架：1) 采用单目3D人体网格恢复模型作为前端，获取每帧的单视角网格估计；2) 引入两阶段极线匹配策略，第一阶段基于并查集(DSU)聚类实现初步跨视角关联，第二阶段通过逐关节三角化进行精细化的3D姿态重建与关联优化，利用密集网格几何信息提升匹配鲁棒性。

Result: 在SportCenter EPFL数据集上MPJPE/PA-MPJPE达到59.8/40.7 mm，在Human-M3 Basketball数据集上达到74.0/51.8 mm，一致优于现有的无训练关联基线方法，并在室内外篮球场景中达到具有竞争力的RGB-only性能。

Conclusion: MAEM通过利用密集网格几何信息进行跨视角关联，在不依赖目标域训练或微调的条件下，有效提升了多视角多人3D姿态估计的精度和鲁棒性，表明网格几何先验可有效弥补无监督方法在跨视角关联中的局限性。

Abstract: Multi-view multi-person 3D pose estimation in team sports scenarios remains challenging due to player occlusions, appearance similarity caused by team uniforms, and the scarcity of annotated multi-view data, all of which limit the effectiveness and generalization capability of learning-based methods. In contrast, the performance of training-free approaches is inherently constrained by the accuracy of 2D keypoint detection and the robustness of cross-view association. To address these challenges, we propose Mesh-Aware Epipolar Matching (MAEM), a training-free framework for multi-view multi-person 3D pose estimation. Our method employs a monocular 3D human mesh recovery model as the frontend and introduces a two-stage epipolar matching strategy based on the recovered mesh outputs. Specifically, the proposed framework combines disjoint-set-union-based clustering with per-joint triangulation to achieve robust cross-view association and accurate 3D pose reconstruction. Experiments on two public multi-view basketball datasets demonstrate that MAEM consistently outperforms existing training-free association baselines while achieving competitive RGB-only performance in both indoor and outdoor basketball scenarios. MAEM achieves MPJPE/PA-MPJPE scores of 59.8/40.7 mm on SportCenter EPFL and 74.0/51.8 mm on Human-M3 Basketball, highlighting the effectiveness of dense mesh geometry for cross-view association without requiring target-domain training or fine-tuning.

</details>


### [88] [SwInception -- Local Attention Meets Convolutions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29954)
*David Hagerman,Roman Naeem,Jakob Lindqvist,Carl Lindström,Fredrik Kahl,Lennart Svensson*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SwInception架构，通过在Swin Transformer的前馈层引入Inception多分支卷积块来增强归纳偏置，并改进解码器以更少参数捕获更精细细节，在11个医学数据集上取得了性能提升，超越了Medical Segmentation Decathlon等基准挑战中的先前最优方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Swin Transformer虽然性能优异但在小数据集上容易过拟合，需要增强其归纳偏置以缓解这一问题。

Method: 在Swin Transformer的前馈层中引入Inception多分支卷积块以增强局部多尺度特征推理能力；同时改进解码器层，用更少参数捕获更精细的细节信息。

Result: 在11个不同医学数据集上进行了广泛实验，在Medical Segmentation Decathlon和Beyond the Cranial Vault等基准挑战中超越了先前的最优骨干网络。

Conclusion: Swin Transformer现有的归纳偏置可以进一步改进，本文工作为增强稀疏视觉Transformer在医学和自然图像分割任务中的能力提供了有前景的方向。

Abstract: Sparse vision transformers have gained popularity as efficient encoders for medical volumetric segmentation, with Swin emerging as a prominent choice. Swin uses local attention to reduce complexity and yields excellent performance for many tasks but still tends to overfit on small datasets. To mitigate this weakness, we propose a novel architecture that further enhances Swin's inductive bias by introducing Inception blocks in the feed-forward layers. The introduction of these multi-branch convolutions enables more direct reasoning over local, multi-scale features within the transformer block. We have also modified the decoder layers in order to capture finer details using fewer parameters. We demonstrate a performance improvement on eleven different medical datasets through extensive experimentation. We specifically showcase advancements over the previous state-of-the-art backbones on benchmark challenges like the Medical Segmentation Decathlon and Beyond the Cranial Vault. By showing that the existing inductive bias in Swin can be further improved, our work presents a promising avenue for enhancing the capabilities of sparse vision transformers for both medical and natural image segmentation tasks. Code and pre-trained weights can be accessed at https://github.com/Eiphodos/SwInception.

</details>


### [89] [EVL-ECG: Efficient ECG Interpretation With Multi-Aspect Heterogeneous Knowledge Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29977)
*Dang Hong Nguyen,Nhi Ngoc-Yen Nguyen,Huy-Hieu Pham*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出EVL-ECG框架，通过三种ECG感知的创新方法（多头交叉注意力对齐、基于最优传输的视觉特征匹配、几何架构内关系匹配）实现跨架构知识蒸馏，在减少计算需求的同时提升心电诊断精度，并构建了适合资源受限临床环境的20亿参数高效ECG基础模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高保真心电图解读日益依赖大规模基础模型，但这些模型在临床边缘部署时面临极端计算需求。传统知识蒸馏方法在跨异构架构迁移知识时无法捕捉ECG信号复杂的时空依赖关系。

Method: 提出EVL-ECG框架，包含三项创新：(1)多头交叉注意力对齐，协调架构差异以保留细粒度形态特征；(2)基于最优传输的视觉特征匹配，通过最优传输维护跨导联的全局结构关系；(3)几何架构内关系匹配，蒸馏教师模型的潜在诊断推理逻辑。

Result: 在ECG基准测试上，AUC提升高达2.4%，临床准确率提升1.1%，优于现有基线方法。

Conclusion: EVL-ECG成功建立了高效的20亿参数ECG基础模型，适用于资源受限的临床环境，证明了跨架构蒸馏在心脏诊断逻辑迁移中的有效性。

Abstract: High-fidelity ECG interpretation is increasingly reliant on massive foundation models, yet their deployment in clinical edge-care remains hindered by extreme computational demands. While knowledge distillation (KD) is a promising solution, traditional methods fail to capture the complex spatio-temporal dependencies of ECG signals when transferring knowledge across heterogeneous architectures. In this paper, we propose EVL-ECG, a framework specifically designed for cross-architecture distillation of cardiac diagnostic logic. EVL-ECG introduces three ECG-aware innovations: (1) Multi-Head Cross-Attention Alignment, which harmonizes architectural discrepancies to preserve fine-grained morphological features; (2) Optimal Transport-based Visual Feature Matching, utilizing optimal transport to maintain global structural relationships across ECG leads despite mismatched token representations; and (3) Geometric Intra-Architecture Relation Matching, which distills the latent diagnostic reasoning of the teacher model. Evaluations across ECG benchmarks demonstrate that EVL-ECG yields improvements of up to 2.4% AUC and 1.1% clinical accuracy over existing baselines. Notably, EVL-ECG establishes an efficient 2B-parameter ECG foundation model, suitable for resource-constrained clinical environments.

</details>


### [90] [Genetically Aligned Patient Representations Improve Hematological Diagnosis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29980)
*Muhammed Furkan Dasdelen,Fatih Ozlugedik,Ilaria Looser,Rao Muhammad Umer,Christian Pohlkamp,Carsten Marr*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出GenBloom框架，通过两阶段训练（自监督视觉预训练+遗传监督对比学习）将单张白细胞图像与染色体畸变及体细胞突变对齐，构建多模态患者编码器，显著提升血液肿瘤诊断性能，并具备遗传异常的检索能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 血液肿瘤学中，单细胞视觉评估常与细胞遗传学和分子遗传学结合用于诊断，但现有方法缺乏将单细胞图像与遗传异常进行对齐的框架，无法充分利用多模态信息提升诊断性能。

Method: 两阶段训练策略：(i) 在1500+患者队列上使用iBOT头进行自监督视觉-only预训练，学习Transformer聚合器；(ii) 在急性髓系白血病患者上通过监督对比损失进行遗传对齐，将单细胞图像与核型染色体畸变及靶向基因panel的体细胞突变相映射。

Result: 遗传对齐后的患者编码器在血液学诊断任务中优于基于整张切片的组织病理学基础模型；具备即用型的疾病和遗传异常检索能力；遗传数据的引入提高了患者表示质量。

Conclusion: 该框架与临床诊断工作流程一致，为未来多模态血液学专用AI奠定了基础；代码和模型权重已开源。

Abstract: Multimodal alignment of histopathology encoders with transcriptomic and genomic data has been shown to significantly improve performance in downstream diagnostic tasks. Hematological cytology is unique in that visual single-cell evaluation is often paired with cytogenetics and molecular genetics for blood cancer diagnosis. In this study, we present a framework to align single white blood cell images with chromosomal aberrations (karyotype) and somatic mutations from targeted gene panels. Our training strategy follows a two-stage approach: (i) self-supervised, vision-only pretraining of a transformer aggregator using an iBOT head on a cohort of over 1500 patients, and (ii) genetic alignment via supervised contrastive loss on acute myeloid leukemia patients. Our genetically aligned patient encoder improves hematological diagnostic tasks, outperforming slide-level histopathology foundation models. Additionally, the model provides off-the-shelf retrieval capabilities for diseases and genetic alterations. Incorporating genetic data into patient encoders increases the quality of patient representations, providing a framework that aligns with clinical diagnostic workflows and paves the way for future multimodal hematology-specific AI.
