We employ Thin Plate Splines (TPS), a smooth non-rigid deformation model that minimizes bending energy to estimate a globally coherent warp from control-point correspondences, to align backprojected points from estimated depth with triangulated 3D control points, yielding calibrated backprojected points. By sampling these calibrated points near the control points, TWINGS provides a fast and geometrically accurate initialization for 3DGS, ultimately improving structural detail preservation and color fidelity in reconstructed scenes. Extensive experiments on DTU, LLFF, and Mip-NeRF360 demonstrate that TWINGS consistently outperforms existing methods, delivering detailed and accurate reconstructions under sparse-view scenarios.

</details>


### [200] [JMed48k: A Multi-Profession Japanese Medical Licensing Benchmark for Vision-Language Model Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.22080)
*Yue Xun,Junyu Liu,Qian Niu,Xinyi Wang,Zheng Yuan,Zirui Li,Zequn Zhang,Bowen Zhao,Shujun Wang,Irene Li,Kan Hatakeyama-Sato,Yusuke Iwasawa,Yutaka Matsuo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文构建了日本多职业医疗执照考试基准JMed48k（含48,862道试题和20,142张图片），并从中提取JMed48k-Eval评估子集（12,484道题），通过对比21个模型在有/无图像下的表现，发现闭源和开源模型显著受益于图像，而医学专用模型对视觉证据利用有限，且不同职业间图像移除效果差异高达7倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉-语言模型在医疗领域的评估缺乏覆盖多职业、大规模、带有视觉内容标注的日本医疗执照考试基准，无法系统评估模型在不同医疗职业场景下的图文理解能力。

Method: 从日本厚生劳动省官方PDF中提取2005-2025年11种国家执照考试试题，构建含48,862道题和20,142张图片的JMed48k语料库，按8类视觉内容标注；从中筛选近5年子集JMed48k-Eval（12,484道题），分别评估21个模型在纯文本和有图像条件下的表现，并设计配对图像移除审计，分析移除图像前后答案的四种状态转变。

Result: 闭源和开源模型从图像中获益显著，而医学专用系统对视觉证据的利用有限，许多正确答案在移除图像后依然正确；在闭源模型中，图像移除效果在不同职业间差异达7倍（医师+5.7分 vs. 公共卫生护士+39.8分）。

Conclusion: JMed48k为按职业分层评估视觉-语言模型在医疗执照考试中的表现提供了可复现的基准，揭示了当前模型在视觉理解能力上的分化。

Abstract: We introduce JMed48k, a multi-profession Japanese healthcare licensing benchmark for evaluating vision-language models. Built from official PDF materials released by the Japanese Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare, JMed48k contains 48,862 exam questions and 20,142 images from 11 national licensing examinations between 2005 and 2025, with visual content annotated under an 8-type taxonomy. From this corpus, we derive JMed48k-Eval, a recent five-year evaluation subset with 12,484 scored questions, including 9,905 text-only questions and 2,579 questions with images. We evaluate 21 proprietary, open-source, and medical-specific models, reporting text-only and with-image performance separately. Because these subsets contain different questions, we further introduce a paired image-removal audit that evaluates questions with images before and after removing visual content to explore four answer-transition states. The audit shows that proprietary and open source models gain substantially from images, whereas medical-specific systems show limited observable use of visual evidence, with many correct answers persisting after image removal. Even among proprietary models, the net image-removal effect varies sevenfold across professions, from +5.7 points on Physician questions to +39.8 points on Public Health Nurse questions. We release JMed48k to support reproducible, profession-stratified evaluation of vision-language models in medical licensing settings.

</details>


### [201] [Direct content-based retrieval from music scores images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.22255)
*Noelia Luna-Barahona,Antonio Ríos-Vila,Félix Fuentes-Hurtado,David Rizo,Jorge Calvo-Zaragoza*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究了乐谱图像的内容检索方法，对比了基于光学乐谱识别（OMR）的转录方法、无转录的Transformer模型以及文本提示的大语言模型在四种不同数据集上的表现，发现各方法在不同条件下各有优劣。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 乐谱数字化对保存和可访问性至关重要，但目前信息检索主要依赖元数据（如标题或作曲家）搜索，基于内容的乐谱图像检索相较文本文档尚不充分，而这一能力对音乐家、音乐学家和教育工作者具有潜在价值。

Method: 首先研究乐谱中哪些特征对检索最相关，并定义从任何标注语料库构建查询数据集的系统方法。实验对比了三种方法：基于OMR的转录方法、无转录的Transformer模型（直接从乐谱图像识别查询）以及文本提示的大语言模型。在四个具有不同数据集规模、图像质量和排版方式的语料库上进行评估。

Result: 每种方法在不同条件下表现优异：基于OMR的流水线在域内检索中效果更好，而无转录模型在跨领域变异性处理上更为有效。

Conclusion: 不同的乐谱图像内容检索方法各有适用场景，OMR适合域内任务，无转录模型更擅长处理领域变化，为实际应用中的方法选择提供了指导。

Abstract: The digitization of musical scores plays a crucial role in their preservation and accessibility, yet information retrieval still depends mainly on metadata searches, such as by title or composer. Content based search in music score images remains underexplored compared to text documents, despite its potential value for musicians, musicologists, and educators. This work contributes to the field by first studying which characteristics of a score are most relevant for search and by defining a systematic method to build query datasets from any annotated corpus. We also consider diverse methods for content-based search on music score images, ranging from transcription-based approaches relying on Optical Music Recognition (OMR), to a transcription-free Transformer model trained to recognize queries directly from score images, and a text-prompted Large Language Model. Our experiments evaluate these models on four corpora exhibiting diverse characteristics in terms of dataset size, image quality, and typesetting mechanisms. Overall, each method excels under different conditions: OMR-based pipelines achieve higher in-domain retrieval, whereas transcription-free models handle domain variability more effectively.

</details>


### [202] [SCOPE: Simulating Cross-game Operations in Playable Environments for FPS World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.23345)
*Zizhao Tong,Yeying Jin,Hongfeng Lai,Zeqing Wang,Zhaohu Xing,Kexu Cheng,Haoran Xu,Zhao Pu,Shangwen Zhu,Ruili Feng,Jian Zhao,Yan Zhang,Hao Tang,Ling Shao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SCOPE框架，通过将条件模块插入预训练视频扩散模型的每个Transformer块，实现FPS游戏中高频重叠控制信号的局部化处理；同时构建CrossFPS多游戏数据集，实现跨游戏零样本泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法将动作全局注入模型并在单一游戏上训练，无法处理FPS游戏中密集的帧级重叠控制信号，导致未受影响区域也被扰动。

Method: 1) SCOPE：在预训练视频扩散模型的每个Transformer块中插入条件模块，将特征重塑为逐像素时间序列，使每个位置根据局部视觉内容计算动作响应，无需分割标签即可区分作用域内外区域。2) CrossFPS数据集：首个多游戏FPS数据集，包含7个游戏的69K片段、10自由度控制器信号，经 curation 去除游戏偏差。

Result: 实验表明模型具有强动作响应性、精确的作用域分离以及有效的跨游戏泛化能力。

Conclusion: SCOPE通过空间选择性动作注入机制，有效解决了FPS游戏中高频重叠控制信号的局部化处理问题，并在多游戏场景下实现了零样本泛化。

Abstract: Interactive world models for first-person shooter (FPS) games must resolve high-frequency overlapping control signals at every frame without disrupting unaffected regions. Existing methods inject actions globally and train on single titles, failing under dense FPS inputs. We observe that FPS actions are spatially selective: discrete events such as firing or reloading affect only a localized region around the weapon (the scope), while continuous camera and movement signals govern stable surroundings. We propose SCOPE, which inserts a conditioning module into each transformer block of a pretrained video diffusion model. It reshapes features into per-pixel temporal sequences so that each position computes its action response from local visual content. This separates in-scope effects from out-of-scope generation without segmentation labels. We also introduce CrossFPS, the first multi-game FPS dataset with frame-aligned action telemetry. It comprises 69K clips from 7 titles with 10-DoF controller signals, curated to remove gameplay bias. The model learns general visual-to-action mappings rather than game-specific patterns, enabling zero-shot transfer to unseen scenes. Experiments confirm strong action responsiveness, precise scope separation, and effective cross-game generalization.

</details>


### [203] [PixIE: Prompted Pixel-Space Low-Light Image Enhancement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.23531)
*Ruirui Lin,Guoxi Huang,David Bull,Nantheera Anantrasirichai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PixIE是一种基于视觉基础模型语义提示的前馈像素空间低光图像增强框架，通过跨尺度去噪、DINO提示像素块调制和空间通道压缩等技术，在多个基准上PSNR提升1.9-15.0%，LPIPS降低8.5-44.4%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低光图像同时存在严重噪声、对比度损失和语义模糊问题，增强需要同时解决去噪和细节恢复，现有方法难以兼顾两者。

Method: 提出PixIE框架：(1) 跨尺度去噪模块抑制噪声并保持结构；(2) DINO提示像素块(DPPBs)利用DINOv3中间特征进行逐像素调制；(3) 空间通道压缩(SCC)联合减少空间token网格和通道维度；(4) 多感受野像素嵌入(MRPE)提供邻域感知的像素表示。

Result: 在LLIE基准上，PSNR提升1.9-15.0%，LPIPS降低8.5-44.4%，定性结果显示出更清晰的细节和更稳定的纹理。

Conclusion: PixIE在重建保真度和感知质量上均优于现有方法，有效结合了视觉基础模型的语义提示与像素级增强。

Abstract: Low-light images suffer from severe noise, contrast loss, and semantic ambiguity, making enhancement a joint problem of denoising and detail recovery. We propose PixIE, a feed-forward pixel-space LLIE framework semantically prompted by a vision foundation model. PixIE first performs cross-scale denoising to suppress noise and preserve structure, then refines details using DINO-Prompted Pixel Blocks (DPPBs), which inject intermediate DINOv3 features through patch-conditioned, spatially continuous per-pixel modulation. To make pixel-space attention efficient across scales, we introduce Spatial-Channel Compaction (SCC), which jointly reduces the spatial token grid and channel dimension. We further propose Multi-Receptive-Field Pixel Embedding (MRPE) to provide neighborhood-aware pixel representations before semantic prompting, improving robustness to signal-dependent noise beyond point-wise embeddings. Experiments on LLIE benchmarks show that PixIE improves average PSNR by 1.9-15.0% over recent state-of-the-art methods and reduces LPIPS by 8.5-44.4%. Qualitative comparisons further show sharper details and more stable textures, improving both reconstruction fidelity and perceptual quality.

</details>


### [204] [Nano World Models: A Minimalist Implementation of Future Video Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.23993)
*Siqiao Huang,Partha Kaushik,Michael Chen,Hengkai Pan,Kaiwen Geng,Omar Chehab,Fernando Moreno-Pino,Max Simchowitz*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Nano World Models是一个专注于扩散强迫( Diffusion Forcing)的未来视频预测最小化代码库，为世界模型研究提供了统一、可复现、易扩展的实验平台，涵盖生成目标、模型规模、动作条件化、潜在观测空间、数据集、评估协议和长程推演流程，并在简单控制环境、游戏模拟和真实机器人数据上验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管工业级交互式视频生成发展迅速，但研究界缺乏紧凑、可复现且易于扩展的实现来研究现代世界模型的设计选择，现有实现中不同组件往往纠缠在一起，难以进行受控实验。

Method: 构建以扩散强迫为核心的最小化代码库Nano World Models，提供统一接口涵盖生成目标、模型规模、动作条件化机制、潜在观测空间、数据集、评估协议和长程推演流程，支持对世界建模组件进行受控研究。

Result: 在简单控制环境、游戏模拟和真实机器人数据上的实验揭示了预测参数化、架构规模、动作注入、采样预算和领域复杂度对视频预测质量和自回归推演行为的影响。

Conclusion: Nano World Models通过发布代码、配置、评估脚本和预训练检查点，为开放、可复现、科学化的世界模型研究提供了紧凑而可扩展的实验基础。

Abstract: World models have become a central paradigm for learning predictive simulators that support generation, planning, and decision-making. Yet, despite rapid progress in industry-scale interactive video generation, the broader research community still lacks compact, reproducible, and easily extensible implementations for studying the design choices underlying modern world models. We introduce Nano World Models, a minimalist codebase for future video prediction centered around diffusion forcing. Nano World Models provides a unified interface for generative objectives, model scales, action-conditioning mechanisms, latent observation spaces, datasets, evaluation protocols, and long-horizon rollout procedures. This design enables controlled studies of world-modeling components that are often entangled across separate implementations. Through experiments across simple control environments, game simulation, and real-robot data, we examine how prediction parameterization, architecture scale, action injection, sampling budget, and domain complexity affect video prediction quality and autoregressive rollout behavior. By releasing code, configurations, evaluation scripts, and pretrained checkpoints, Nano World Models aims to provide a compact yet extensible experimental substrate for open, reproducible, and scientific world-model research.

</details>


### [205] [Coarse-to-Fine Domain Incremental Learning with Attentive Distillation for Mining Footprint Segmentation in Multispectral Imagery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24460)
*Alif Tri Handoyo,Vincent C. S. Lee,Rizka Widyarini Purwanto,Alex M. Lechner,Deanna Kemp,Muhamad Risqi U. Saputra*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MineC2FNet框架，利用粗粒度标注数据通过粗到细的域增量学习提升细粒度采矿足迹分割性能，并发布包含219张精细标注图像的数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全球采矿足迹的自动精细分割对监测采矿业的社会环境风险至关重要，但精细标注数据稀缺，而粗粒度数据虽广泛存在却因域偏移难以直接用于提升细粒度分割。

Method: 采用教师-学生架构，在特征层和预测层引入注意力蒸馏，选择性迁移粗域通用知识，并结合有限细粒度数据进行边界细化；提出粗到细的域增量学习策略。

Result: 与SOTA方法（包括域适应和域增量学习方法）相比，MineC2FNet在有效处理域偏移的同时取得了更优的分割性能。

Conclusion: MineC2FNet成功利用粗标注数据提升细粒度采矿足迹分割，数据集和代码已公开。

Abstract: Automatically mapping and segmenting global mining footprints using remote sensing and deep learning is critical for monitoring the socio-environmental risks and impacts of mining, yet its progress is hindered by the scarcity of fine-grained annotated data. Although large-scale datasets with coarse boundaries are widely available, leveraging them to improve fine-grained segmentation is challenging due to significant domain shift. To address this, we propose MineC2FNet, a coarse-to-fine domain incremental learning framework that exploits abundant coarse data to enhance fine-grained mining footprint segmentation. MineC2FNet adopts a teacher-student architecture with attentive distillation at both the feature and prediction levels, selectively transferring generalized knowledge from the coarse domain while enabling boundary refinement using limited fine-grained data (fine domain). We further introduce an expertly validated dataset of 219 images with precise boundary annotations across diverse geographies and commodities. Extensive experiments against state-of-the-art approaches, including domain adaptation and domain incremental learning methods, demonstrate that MineC2FNet achieves superior performance while effectively handling domain shift. The dataset and code are publicly available at https://github.com/risqiutama/MineC2FNet.

</details>


### [206] [SRUG: Shadow-Guided Relightable Urban Scene with Generation Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24700)
*Yonghao Zhao,Zexin Yin,Jian Yang,Beibei Wang,Jin Xie*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SRUG框架，通过阴影引导的3D补全模型恢复不可见区域几何，结合迭代材质分解与物理光照模型，实现了城市场景的可重光照，在视图合成和重光照任务上优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 城市场景重光照具有高度病态性：环境无界且存在大量不可见区域，这些区域仍会向可见区域投射阴影；同时稀疏输入视角和复杂光照条件导致材质分解存在严重歧义，现有方法难以合理建模不可见区域投射的阴影。

Method: 1) 阴影引导的3D补全模型：利用阴影线索引导恢复不可见区域的几何结构，促进物理合理的阴影合成；2) 迭代材质分解方案：应用大材质模型(LMM)提供材质监督，迭代分解场景材质属性，实现鲁棒的材质分解；3) 基于物理的光照模型：捕捉城市场景的复杂光照，支持可靠的重光照。

Result: 大量定量评估和视觉比较表明，SRUG在新视角合成和重光照任务上均优于现有方法。

Conclusion: SRUG通过阴影引导的几何补全和迭代材质分解，有效解决了城市场景重光照中不可见区域阴影建模和材质分解歧义两大核心难题，为城市场景重光照提供了新思路。

Abstract: Creating relightable urban scenes from images or videos is widely useful but highly ill-posed. Urban environments are typically unbounded and extend beyond the visible regions. As a result, many portions of the scene remain unobserved, yet these invisible regions can cast shadows onto visible areas. Reasonably modeling shadows cast by such invisible regions is challenging and poses a significant obstacle to creating relightable urban scenes. At the same time, sparse input views and complex illumination conditions further complicate relighting, as they introduce severe ambiguities in material decomposition. In this paper, we propose Shadow-guided Relightable Urban Scene with Generation model (SRUG), a novel framework designed to address relighting challenges in urban scenes. SRUG leverages shadows to guide a 3D completion model for recovering the geometry of invisible regions, promoting the synthesis of physically reasonable shadows. In addition, SRUG employs an iterative material decomposition scheme that applies the large material model (LMM) to provide material supervision and iteratively decompose the scene's material properties, enabling robust material decomposition. Building upon these components, we introduce a physically-based lighting model that captures the complex illumination of urban scenes and supports reliable relighting. Extensive quantitative evaluations and visual comparisons demonstrate that our method outperforms existing approaches in both novel view synthesis and relighting tasks.

</details>


### [207] [VEOcc: Voxel-Centric Online Semantic Occupancy Prediction For Embodied Scene Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25059)
*Ruoyu Wang,Yong Liu,Sheng Tao,Yuhang Lin,Yukai Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VEOcc提出了一种基于体素中心（voxel-centric）的在线3D占用预测与建图框架，采用递归感知-同化范式，无需预知场景尺度即可实现开放式地图扩展，并引入时空感知在线更新策略，在Occ-ScanNet和EmbodiedOcc-ScanNet上达到SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于高斯的方法在结构边界保真度上表现不佳，且严重依赖预定义的场景尺寸先验，限制了操作效率。为解决这些问题，VEOcc旨在消除初始尺度估计需求，实现高效、开放的在线3D占用建图。

Method: 提出体素中心的递归感知-同化范式，无需初始尺度估计即可实现开放式地图扩展；提出时空感知在线更新策略（STAO），包含跨时间对数聚合（TLA）、可靠性感知置信度调制（RCM）和置信度驱动的增量状态更新（CSU），用于鲁棒地聚合离散体素空间中的噪声时序观测。

Result: 在Occ-ScanNet和EmbodiedOcc-ScanNet上取得SOTA性能；在自采视频序列的零样本评估中展现出鲁棒的分布外泛化能力。

Conclusion: VEOcc为自主探索提供了一种准确且高效的在线3D占用预测与建图解决方案。

Abstract: Crucial for autonomous exploration, online 3D occupancy prediction and mapping incrementally constructs dense spatial representations on the fly. However, recent Gaussian-centric methods struggle with structural boundary fidelity and rely heavily on predefined scene-size priors, fundamentally limiting their operational efficiency. In this work, we present VEOcc, a voxel-centric framework formulated as a recursive perception-and-assimilation paradigm. By eliminating the need for initial scale estimation, VEOcc enables highly streamlined, open-ended map expansion. Furthermore, to robustly aggregate noisy temporal observations within the discrete voxel space, we propose a Spatio-Temporal-Aware Online Update Strategy. It integrates Cross-Temporal Logit Aggregation (TLA) for temporal consistency, Reliability-Aware Confidence Modulation (RCM) for spatial uncertainty calibration, and Confidence-Driven Incremental State Update (CSU) for robust global state assimilation. % Extensive experiments on Occ-ScanNet and EmbodiedOcc-ScanNet demonstrate that VEOcc establishes new state-of-the-art performance in both local and embodied settings, providing an accurate and efficient solution for real-world exploration. Extensive experiments on Occ-ScanNet and EmbodiedOcc-ScanNet demonstrate that VEOcc establishes new state-of-the-art performance in both local and embodied settings. Notably, zero-shot evaluations on self-collected video sequences further confirm its robust out-of-distribution generalization capability in completely unseen real-world environments. Ultimately, our framework provides an accurate and highly efficient solution for autonomous exploration. Code and supplementary visualizations are available on our project page: https://wryzju.github.io/VEOcc/.

</details>


### [208] [A Principled Self-Referenced Early Stopping Approach for Deep Image Prior](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25299)
*Chaoyan Huang,Cheng-Han Huang,Ismail R. Alkhouri,Rongrong Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文针对Deep Image Prior (DIP)在逆成像问题中的过拟合问题，提出了一种基于伪自参考图像构建的早停检测框架，通过构造三个逆成像问题特定的算法，在无需精确噪声水平估计的情况下，在多种逆成像任务中优于现有早停方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DIP在逆成像问题中表现优异，但其网络过参数化导致对含噪测量数据的过拟合问题严重；现有的基于输出运行方差波动的早停方法在波动过早出现时会导致重建结果不稳定。

Method: 首先理论证明当存在两个独立的含噪退化图像副本时可达近似最优早停；基于此观察，提出构建伪自参考图像的过拟合检测框架，衍生出三种逆成像问题特定算法，并辅以单参考验证、伪验证估计和共享噪声影响的理论分析。

Result: 在自然图像恢复和医学图像重建等多种逆成像任务中，在不同噪声水平和噪声类型下，该方法持续优于现有DIP早停方法，且无需精确噪声水平估计。

Conclusion: 通过伪自参考图像构建的早停框架有效解决了DIP的过拟合检测问题，提升了逆成像重建的稳定性和性能，具有广泛的适用性。

Abstract: Recently, Deep Image Prior (DIP) has demonstrated strong capabilities for solving inverse imaging problems (IIPs) by optimizing a randomly initialized convolutional neural network in a training-data-free regime. However, DIP suffers from overfitting to noisy measurements due to network over-parameterization, making early stopping (ES) essential. The most successful ES method tracks fluctuations in the running variance of the network output to detect overfitting. However, in many applications, these fluctuations may appear prematurely, leading to unstable reconstructions. In this paper, we first show that nearly optimal DIP early stopping can be achieved when two independent noisy copies of the degraded image are available. Motivated by this observation, and since obtaining two fully independent copies is infeasible, we propose an overfitting detection framework based on constructing pseudo self-referenced images, resulting in three IIP-specific algorithms. Our approach is further supported by theoretical results on single-reference validation, pseudo-validation estimation, and the impact of shared noise. Across different IIPs, ranging from natural image restoration to medical image reconstruction, and under varying noise levels and noise types, our methods consistently outperform existing DIP early stopping approaches, all without requiring an accurate estimate of the noise level.

</details>


### [209] [Paris 2.0: A Decentralized Diffusion Model for Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26064)
*Ali Rouzbayani,Bidhan Roy,Marcos Villagra,Zhiying Jiang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Paris 2.0是首个通过去中心化计算预训练的视频生成模型，相比集中式训练模型在FVD指标上实现约2倍改进，同时提升了CLIP文本-视频相似度和美学评分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 去中心化训练在图像生成领域已被证明可行（Paris 1.0），但时间上连贯的视频生成在去中心化训练条件下仍是一个未解决的问题。本文旨在通过Paris 2.0填补这一空白。

Method: 基于Paris 1.0（去中心化扩散模型DDM）的训练方案，将其扩展到视频生成领域，采用低分辨率文本到视频训练方式，通过去中心化计算而非 monolithic GPU集群进行预训练。

Result: 在与集中式模型相同数据和计算预算条件下，Paris 2.0将Frechet Video Distance (FVD)从561.04降至279.01（约2倍改进），并提升了CLIP文本-视频相似度和美学评分。

Conclusion: Paris 2.0证明了去中心化训练能够有效应用于视频生成领域，且在多项指标上优于集中式训练模型，为摆脱对大规模GPU集群依赖的视频模型训练提供了可行方案。

Abstract: We present Paris 2.0, the first video generation model pre-trained through decentralized computation. Its training recipe builds upon Paris 1.0 (arXiv:2510.03434), the first ever open-weight Decentralized Diffusion Model (DDM), which showed that image generation can be trained without a monolithic GPU cluster. However, temporally coherent video generation had remained an open problem under decentralized training, and Paris 2.0 closes it.
  In low-resolution text-to-video training, against a monolithic model trained on the same data under a matched total compute budget, Paris 2.0 cuts Frechet Video Distance (FVD) from 561.04 to 279.01, a ~2.0x improvement, and lifts CLIP text-video similarity and aesthetic score.

</details>


### [210] [Reinforcing Few-step Generators via Reward-Tilted Distribution Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26108)
*Yushi Huang,Xiangxin Zhou,Ruoyu Wang,Chi Zhang,Jun Zhang,Tianyu Pang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RTDMD是一个两阶段框架，统一了分布匹配蒸馏与奖励引导强化学习，以极少的推理步骤（4步）实现了文本到图像生成的SOTA效果，在偏好、美学和组合性指标上均优于先前的少步方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管少步扩散蒸馏已实现高效图像生成，但将这些模型与人类偏好对齐仍然具有挑战性。

Method: 提出两阶段框架RTDMD：第一阶段引入Ambient-Consistent Distribution Matching Distillation (AC-DMD)，通过子区间分布匹配和一致性正则化帮助伪评分模型跟踪生成器分布；第二阶段联合优化分布匹配项和奖励最大化项，其中奖励最大化项采用混合策略梯度（结合GRPO风格估计和直接奖励反向传播），并引入SubGRPO降低方差。

Result: 在SD3、SD3.5和FLUX.2上，仅用4步推理就在偏好、美学和组合性指标上达到SOTA，优于先前的少步文本到图像生成方法。

Conclusion: 所提出的统一框架有效对齐了少步生成模型与人类偏好，并建立了新的SOTA基准。

Abstract: Recent advances in few-step diffusion distillation have enabled efficient image generation, yet aligning these models with human preferences remains challenging. We propose Reward-Tilted Distribution Matching Distillation (RTDMD), a two-stage framework that unifies distribution matching distillation with reward-guided reinforcement learning for few-step flow generators. We show that minimizing the KL divergence to a reward-tilted teacher distribution naturally decomposes into a distribution matching term and a reward maximization term. In the first stage, we introduce Ambient-Consistent Distribution Matching Distillation (AC-DMD), which performs subinterval-wise distribution matching and augments the fake score objective with a consistency regularizer to help the fake score model track the shifting generator distribution under limited updates. In the second stage, we jointly optimize both terms: for the reward maximization term, we derive a hybrid policy gradient that combines a GRPO-style estimator for the stochastic intermediate transitions with direct reward backpropagation through the deterministic final step, and further introduce step-subset GRPO (SubGRPO) to reduce variance. Experiments on SD3, SD3.5, and FLUX.2 demonstrate that RTDMD establishes new state-of-the-art results across preference, aesthetic, and compositional metrics with only 4 inference steps, outperforming previous few-step text-to-image generation methods. Code and models are available at https://github.com/Harahan/RTDMD.

</details>


### [211] [ChartAct: A Benchmark for Dynamic Chart Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26994)
*Muye Huang,Lin Wu,Lingling Zhang,Hang Yan,Zhiyuan Wang,Yumeng Fu,Zesheng Yang,Jun Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了ChartAct基准，用于评估多模态模型在动态交互式图表上的理解能力。包含673个动态图表和1,440个问答样本，实验表明现有模型在动态图表理解上仍有明显局限，最强模型Claude-Opus-4.7成功率84.5%，多数模型低于60%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图表理解基准主要关注静态图表，但现实中的图表往往是动态和交互式的，关键信息需要通过悬停、点击、缩放、拖拽等操作才能获取。因此需要评估模型在动态图表环境中的理解能力。

Method: 收集并筛选了来自8个真实图表网站的673个动态图表，覆盖7种常见图表类型，构建了1,440个高质量的问答样本。每个样本在动态图表和仪表板图表两种环境下实例化，并基于此系统评估了11种先进的多模态模型和GUI代理。

Result: 最强模型Claude-Opus-4.7的平均成功率为84.5%，而大多数模型低于60%，表明现有模型在动态图表理解方面仍有明显局限性。

Conclusion: ChartAct为在真实交互环境中研究图表理解提供了新的基准，揭示了现有模型在动态图表理解方面的不足。

Abstract: Charts are widely used to present complex data for analysis and decision making. Existing chart understanding benchmarks mainly focus on static charts, but real-world charts are often dynamic and interactive. Key information may only appear after actions such as hovering, clicking, zooming, or dragging. Dynamic chart understanding therefore requires models to identify visible content, choose proper interactions, and reason over changing chart states. To evaluate this ability, we propose ChartAct, an interactive benchmark for dynamic chart understanding. ChartAct collects and filters 673 dynamic charts from 8 real chart websites, covers 7 common chart types, and constructs 1,440 high-quality question-answer samples. Each sample is instantiated in two environments, Dynamic Chart and Dashboard Chart, to evaluate dynamic chart understanding under different contexts. Based on ChartAct, we systematically evaluate 11 advanced multimodal models and GUI agents. Experimental results show that existing models still have clear limitations in dynamic chart understanding. The strongest model, Claude-Opus-4.7, achieves an average success rate of 84.5\%, while most models remain below 60\%. We also conduct detailed failure attribution and case analysis. ChartAct provides a new benchmark for studying chart understanding in real interactive environments. Codes at https://github.com/wulin-wulin/OSWorld_Chart

</details>


### [212] [Structure over Pixels: Learning Variable-Length Visual Programs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27696)
*Piotr Wyrwiński,Kacper Dobek,Krzysztof Krawiec*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: STROP提出了一种离散视觉分词器架构，通过四阶段课程学习和局部率-失真探针（基于冻结的DINOv3特征），在无需像素级重建的情况下，学习为每张图像自适应生成可变长度的结构化场景表示代码序列。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自适应分词器要么需要事后搜索，要么从预训练的离散码率集合中选择，无法学习与模型和场景耦合的连续逐图像序列长度；且它们通常针对像素重建进行训练，强调纹理而非结构。

Method: 提出STROP架构，包含一个专用的长度头来估计有效前缀长度；采用四阶段课程学习，利用冻结的DINOv3特征进行局部率-失真探测监督；绕过像素级重建梯度，码本完全由高层潜在表示质量塑造。

Result: 程序长度随场景复杂度增长；在密集预测迁移任务和代码词汇的直接检查中均观察到组合结构的迹象。

Conclusion: STROP能够学习与场景复杂度耦合的连续可变长度视觉程序，形成结构化场景表示，并在下游任务中展现出组合性结构特征。

Abstract: Discrete visual tokenizers translate images into ordered sequences of codes, providing a natural representation for structural description of scenes. Yet existing adaptive tokenizers either require post-hoc search or select among a discrete set of pre-trained rates, rather than learning a continuous per-image sequence length coupled to the model and scene, and they typically train against pixel reconstruction, emphasizing texture rather than structure. We propose STROP, a discrete visual tokenizer architecture that forms structural scene representations and simultaneously learns how long an image's visual program should be. Using a four-phase curriculum supervised by local rate--distortion probes against frozen DINOv3 features, STROP optimizes a dedicated length head that estimates the active prefix length in a single forward pass. By bypassing pixel-level reconstruction gradients, the codebook is shaped entirely by the quality of higher-level latent representations. Program length grows with scene complexity, and signs of compositional structure emerge both in downstream dense-prediction transfer and in direct inspection of the learned code vocabulary.

</details>


### [213] [ROVER: Routing Object-Centric Visual Evidence for Grounded Multi-Image Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27959)
*Guannan Lv,Ren Nie,Hongjian Dou,Tingting Gao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出ROVER，一种轻量级可学习插件，通过对象中心的差分注意力机制和步骤特定的令牌三元组，在全局视觉证据路由中实现高效的多模态推理，在MM-GCoT和VideoEspresso等基准上显著提升答案准确率和定位精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MLLMs在定位推理中存在两类局限：(1) 基于RoI的方法注入裁剪图像块或RoI特征，削弱了整体场景理解和物体间关系，且解码成本随RoI数量和尺寸增长；(2) 自适应视觉特征选择需要细粒度监督或复杂启发式规则。因此需要一种既能保持全局场景理解又能高效路由视觉证据的轻量级方案。

Method: ROVER是一个轻量级可学习插件，核心设计包括：(1) 在每个物体定位预测时注入步骤特定的令牌三元组；(2) 聚合当前推理上下文；(3) 通过对象中心差分注意力蒸馏图像内线索到视觉工作空间；(4) 在该空间内跨物体和图像路由并整合历史感知证据。模型集成到Qwen2.5-VL-7B，采用SFT到GRPO的交替训练流程。

Result: 在严格遵循原始数据集和评估协议下，MM-GCoT上答案准确率提升+4.8%，定位准确率提升+14.6%；VideoEspresso上答案准确率提升+8.6%。在VideoEspresso上训练的模型展现出强迁移能力，在多个不同基准上平均超过基线模型+4.7%。

Conclusion: ROVER通过轻量级可学习的全局视觉证据路由机制，在不牺牲全局场景理解的前提下，有效解决了多模态推理中定位证据的高效集成问题，验证了其在多图像推理和视频理解任务中的有效性和迁移性。

Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have increasingly localized and interleaved visual evidence for deliberative reasoning. Grounding-based approaches typically focus on regions of interest (RoIs) by injecting cropped image patches or RoI-specific features into the reasoning context. However, such designs can weaken holistic scene understanding and inter-object relations, while incurring decoding costs that scale with the number and size of RoIs. Alternatively, adaptive visual feature selection often requires fine-grained supervision or complex heuristics. To address these limitations, we propose ROVER (Routing Object-centric Visual Evidence for grounded multi-image Reasoning), a lightweight, learnable plugin for efficient global visual evidence routing. Upon each object grounding prediction, ROVER injects a step-specific token triplet to synergistically: (i) aggregate the ongoing reasoning context, (ii) distill intra-image cues into a visual working space via object-centric differential attention, and (iii) route and integrate history-aware evidence across objects and images within this space for subsequent reasoning. We integrate ROVER into Qwen2.5-VL-7B and develop an interleaved SFT-to-GRPO training pipeline. Strictly adhering to the original datasets and evaluation protocols, our method achieves the best performance on MM-GCoT (+4.8% answer accuracy, +14.6% grounding accuracy) and VideoEspresso (+8.6% answer accuracy). The VideoEspresso-trained model demonstrates strong transferability, outperforming the base model by +4.7% on average across diverse benchmarks.

</details>


### [214] [Resolution-free neural surrogates for geometric parameterization and mapping with spatially varying fields](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28551)
*Yanwen Huang,Lok Ming Lui,Gary P. T. Choi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种无分辨率依赖的神经替代模型，用于几何参数化与映射问题。该模型通过多分辨率几何编码策略，在任意结构化或非结构化点集上预测映射位置，并利用变分能量、扩散密度均衡和拟共形理论等几何感知约束进行无标签训练。实验证明了该方法在拟共形映射和密度均衡映射问题上的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多成像问题需要计算由空间变化场诱导的几何变换（如失真校正、可变形图像配准等），这类问题通常归结为变分模型、扩散过程或椭圆型偏微分方程。然而，当参数场在不同实例间变化时，反复求解高分辨率系统计算成本极高。

Method: 提出一种无分辨率依赖的神经替代模型：1) 采用多分辨率几何编码策略，将参数场的坐标增强采样作为网络条件；2) 在任意结构化/非结构化点集上预测映射位置；3) 通过变分能量、扩散密度均衡和拟共形理论导出的几何感知约束进行无标签训练。

Result: 在拟共形映射和密度均衡映射任务上验证了该方法的有效性，能够高效处理不同分辨率下的几何映射问题。

Conclusion: 本文提出的无分辨率神经替代模型有效避免了传统方法反复求解高分辨率系统的计算瓶颈，为几何参数化和映射问题提供了一种高效、灵活的新范式。

Abstract: Many imaging problems require computing spatial transformations induced by spatially varying intensity, feature, or density fields. Canonical examples include distortion correction, deformable image registration, atlas-based segmentation, and deformation-driven image analysis. These tasks can be formulated as geometric mapping problems in which the transformation is constrained to preserve local structure, control boundary behavior, or regulate angular distortion. Such formulations typically lead to variational models, diffusion processes, or elliptic partial differential equations. However, repeatedly solving high-resolution systems becomes computationally expensive when the underlying parameter fields vary across instances. In this work, we propose a resolution-free neural surrogate for geometric parameterization and mapping problems. Given a spatially varying parameter field $p:Ω\to\mathbb{R}^m$ and query locations $\{x_i\}_{i=1}^N\subsetΩ$, the model predicts mapped locations $\{u(x_i)\}_{i=1}^N$ on arbitrary structured or unstructured point sets. To avoid dependence on a fixed grid, we use a multi-resolution geometric encoding strategy that conditions the network on coordinate-augmented samples of the parameter field. The model is trained without labeled solution data by enforcing geometry-aware constraints derived from variational energies, diffusion-based density equalization, and quasi-conformal theory. Experimental results on quasi-conformal mapping and density-equalizing mapping problems are presented to demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed method.

</details>


<div id='cs.CY'></div>

# cs.CY [[Back]](#toc)

### [215] [Political Neutrality as Balanced Approval: A Large-Scale Human Evaluation of AI Responses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28911)
*Jonathan Stray,David Zhai Yang,Steven Luo,Miu Nicole Takagi,Serina Chang*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出了AI政治中立性的新定义，并通过大规模用户研究（7,434名参与者，208,152次评估）构建了PARETO数据集。定义核心原则：在争议性问题上，AI应最大化对立群体的认可度并平衡双方认可度。研究发现AI回复可以同时获得对立双方的高认可度，但不同模型（GPT、Gemini、Claude、Llama）的默认回复偏向自由派，而Grok例外。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着AI系统越来越多地影响政治观点，定义和评估AI政治中立性成为迫切需要解决的问题。现有缺乏严格、可实证检验的定义和基准。

Method: 基于政治理论提出定义：AI在争议问题上应最大化对立群体认可度并平衡双方认可度。构建涉及20个美国争议性议题的基准，从Reddit获取提示词，招募7,434名参与者对前沿AI模型的回复进行208,152次评估。

Result: AI回复可以同时获得对立双方的高认可度；默认回复中GPT、Gemini、Claude、Llama偏向自由派，Grok不偏向；带有政治色彩的提示比中性提示更难应对。

Conclusion: 本文提出了AI政治中立性的严格定义和基准，以及用于衡量进展的数据集PARETO。

Abstract: As AI systems increasingly shape political views, defining and evaluating AI political neutrality is an urgent problem. Here, we propose a new definition of AI political neutrality and design a large-scale user study to test it, releasing a new dataset PARETO with 7,434 participants and 208,152 evaluations of AI responses. Our definition follows a simple principle grounded in political theory: when asked about a controversial issue, an AI model should generate responses that maximize approval across groups with opposing viewpoints, while balancing approval between groups. This definition allows empirical testing of whether an AI response is "neutral" and generalizes to any political context without pre-supposing a single left-right axis of division. We construct a benchmark of controversial U.S. issues, with prompts sourced from politically charged questions on Reddit and responses from frontier AI models, and recruit human participants to rate AI responses. Across all 20 issues, we find that it is possible for AI responses to achieve high rates of approval on both sides, even as those sides disagree strongly with each other on the substance of the issues. We also find that default responses lean liberal for GPT, Gemini, Claude, and Llama, but not Grok, and that user prompts with political charges are harder to respond to than neutral prompts. This work introduces a rigorous definition and benchmark of AI political neutrality, and a dataset to measure progress toward it.

</details>


### [216] [Does Distributed Training Undermine Compute Governance?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29359)
*Robi Rahman*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文评估了利用分布式训练算法规避算力治理监管的可行性，并提出了包括举报机制、芯片追踪、法务会计以及集群内存与算力阈值在内的应对措施。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前算力治理提案通常假设前沿AI训练需要大型、可检测的计算集群，但分布式训练算法的进展使得开发者可以将训练分散在异构硬件聚合体上，从而规避监管。因此，亟需评估这种规避行为的可行性并设计有效的反制措施。

Method: 论文通过技术可行性分析，评估了利用分布式训练算法规避算力治理监管的潜在路径，并系统性地提出了多种反制措施，包括举报机制、芯片追踪、法务会计以及集群内存和算力阈值设定。

Result: 研究发现分布式训练确实可能被用于规避监管，但通过综合运用多种反制手段可以显著提高检测和预防能力。

Conclusion: 算力治理必须超越对大型数据中心设施的依赖，转而采用更多元化的检测手段，以应对分布式训练带来的监管挑战。

Abstract: Compute governance proposals often rely on the assumption that frontier AI training requires large, detectable computing clusters. However, recent advances in distributed training algorithms could allow developers to conduct frontier-scale training on distributed agglomerations of hardware, rather than needing large datacenter facilities. Developers who prefer not to be constrained by regulations may structure their hardware in a manner that evades the registration and monitoring requirements associated with compute governance. Therefore, regulations must be designed to detect and prevent illicit distributed training operations. This paper evaluates the feasibility of such evasion and outlines recommended countermeasures, including whistleblowing, chip tracking, forensic accounting, and memory and compute thresholds for clusters.

</details>


### [217] [The New Pro Se: Generative AI and the Surge in Federal Civil Self-Representation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29493)
*Or Cohen-Sasson*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 基于约280万份联邦民事诉讼记录，研究发现生成式AI普及后，pro se（自我代理）原告比例从11.33%上升至16.94%，其中约13.9%的诉状呈现AI一致性写作特征。这些AI辅助诉状引用更密集、多来自首次诉讼者、地理分布不均，但并未提高胜诉率，反而更易被驳回。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究生成式AI工具普及后，联邦民事诉讼中pro se原告比例上升的现象是否伴随诉状文本特征、诉讼结果及原告构成的可检测变化，从而揭示AI对司法系统的实际影响。

Method: 使用FY2008-2025年约280万份联邦民事案件数据，对比GenAI普及前后的pro se原告率；聚焦民权与法定案件，结合案件元数据与诉状文本；开发基于文体学AI检测指标的可解释度量，校准至GenAI前基线阈值，识别AI一致性写作的诉状。

Result: pro se原告率从11.33%升至16.94%（增加5.61个百分点），经趋势和协变量调整后依然显著。非模板诉状中AI标记比例为13.9%。AI标记诉状引用更密集、首次诉讼者比例更高、地理分布不均，且女性原告比例略有上升。但AI标记诉状更易被驳回，且终止于更早的程序阶段。

Conclusion: AI辅助并未提升pro se原告的胜诉率，反而与更高驳回率相关，提示需关注诉状质量与法院筛选负担之间的张力，区分法律形式正确性与实际司法效能。

Abstract: Since public access to generative AI tools became widespread, federal civil litigation has seen a marked increase in pro se (self-represented) plaintiffs. This paper analyzes that shift using ~2.8 million filings, asking whether the post-GenAI period is associated not only with more pro se filings, but also with detectable changes in complaint text, litigation outcomes, and the composition of pro se litigants.
  Using civil filing data from FY2008-2025, we find that the federal civil pro se plaintiff rate rose from 11.33% pre-GenAI to 16.94% post-GenAI, a 5.61 percentage-point increase that persists after trend and covariate-adjusted robustness checks. We then focus on Civil Rights and Other Statutory cases, where the increase is especially pronounced, and link case metadata to pro se complaints. Drawing on stylometric AI detection indicators, we develop an interpretable measure of AI-consistent drafting. Against a threshold calibrated to the pre-GenAI baseline, the net AI-flagged share is 13.9% of post-GenAI non-form complaints.
  Analysis of the AI-flagged complaints shows that they are more citation-dense, disproportionately associated with first-time rather than repeat filers, and geographically unevenly distributed. This composition pattern suggests that AI-consistent drafting is not merely a repeat-filer phenomenon; it also includes a modest, suggestive increase in name-inferred female plaintiffs. We find no evidence of improved win rates; in fact, AI-flagged complaints are more likely to be dismissed and to terminate at earlier procedural phases. These findings raise new questions about access to justice and court screening burdens, and sharpen the distinction between legal formality and legal efficacy.

</details>


### [218] [Information Security in Small-Scale Protests: Surveillance of Ugandan Anti-EACOP Protesters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29621)
*Ntezi Mbabazi,Rikke Bjerg Jensen*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文通过对乌干达13名反EACOP活动人士的田野调查，揭示了在国家安全监控与压制背景下，小型学生抗议群体如何进行秘密组织，并采用多层面的信息安全实践来规避监控、保护自身与他人的安全。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究乌干达气候活动人士在抗议东非原油管道（EACOP）项目时面临的国家监控与压制，以及他们如何在没有正规网络安全指导的情况下，自主形成信息保护策略以应对直接威胁（如逮捕、信息泄露）和被绑架的恐惧。

Method: 在乌干达坎帕拉进行为期五周的田野调查，对13名反EACOP活动人士进行访谈，采用归纳分析方法。

Result: 揭示了多层次的对抗性环境：参与者面临直接威胁（逮捕、信息泄露）和恐惧（被绑架），这些塑造了他们的安全实践；安全实践根植于群体内的自主决策；参与者为保护自身及他人信息安全而调整日常生活的各个方面（设备管理、通信、住宿、交通、社会关系），作为规避监控的刻意策略。

Conclusion: 小型抗议群体在高压监控环境下形成了扎根于日常生活调整的自主信息安全实践，这种实践是全面渗透性的，涉及设备、通信、住宿、交通和社会关系等多维度的刻意策略。

Abstract: We examine the information security practices of Ugandan climate activists protesting the development of the East African Crude Oil Pipeline (EACOP). We conducted five-week fieldwork in Kampala, Uganda, which included interviews with 13 anti-EACOP activists. Through an inductive analysis, we report on the complexities faced by small groups of predominantly student protesters as they covertly organise small-scale anti-EACOP protests within a context marked by state surveillance and repression. Our study points to a multi-layered adversarial landscape, where participants' experiences of direct threats, including arrests and information compromise, and their fears of abduction, shaped their security practices. These practices were rooted in autonomous decision-making within groups. We present a grounded understanding of how participants' need to protect information for their own security, as well as that of others, permeated their lives, leading them to adjust day-to-day aspects of their device management, communication, accommodation, transport and social relations as deliberate tactics to mitigate surveillance.

</details>


### [219] [When Should AI Read the Room? Public Perceptions of Social Intelligence in AI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29938)
*Leena Mathur,Jenny T. Liang,Vasudha Varadarajan,Jimin Mun,Xuhui Zhou,Jana Schaich Borg,Yonatan Bisk,Louis-Philippe Morency,Maarten Sap*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 通过混合方法调查研究（N=200），发现美国公众普遍认为现有AI代理具有社会智能，且判断基于可观察行为而非代理性或意图；同时揭示出接受度上的“支持-采纳鸿沟”——人们更支持为他人而非自己使用社交AI代理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着社交智能AI代理在日常环境中越来越多地被部署，关于这些代理应扮演何种角色的决策将取决于公众的感知，然而公众对AI代理社会智能的感知及其可接受性仍缺乏研究。

Method: 对美国成年人（N=200）进行混合方法调查，考察参与者对当前AI代理社会智能的信念、与社交智能相关的代理能力、影响接受度的上下文因素以及参与者对这些技术的担忧。

Result: 参与者普遍报告已遇到他们认为具有社交智能的AI代理，其判断基于可观察行为而非关于AI代理性或意图的信念；在可接受性判断中发现“支持-采纳鸿沟”：参与者更支持为他人而非自己使用社交AI代理。

Conclusion: 揭示了外行人对社交AI的担忧，为关于适当部署情境、代理角色和终端用户风险的AI治理提供信息。

Abstract: AI researchers have been advancing socially intelligent AI agents (Social-AI) across embodiments, from chatbots to physical robots. As Social-AI is increasingly deployed in everyday settings, decisions about the roles these agents should play will depend on how laypeople perceive them. However, public perceptions of social intelligence in AI agents and the acceptability of these agents remain largely understudied. We present a mixed-methods survey of adults in the United States (N=200) that examines social intelligence as a perceived construct in AI agents. Our survey investigates the extent to which participants believe current AI agents have social intelligence, abilities of agents that participants associate with social intelligence, contextual factors influencing participant acceptance of Social-AI agents, and concerns participants hold about these technologies. Participants widely reported having already encountered AI agents they perceived as socially intelligent and grounded their judgments in observable behaviors, more than beliefs about AI agency or intent. We identified a support-adoption gap in acceptability judgments: participants supported the existence of Social-AI agents for others far more than for their own personal use. Our analysis uncovers layperson concerns about Social-AI, informing AI governance regarding appropriate deployment contexts, agent roles, and risks to end users.

</details>


### [220] [Dissociative Identity: Language Model Agents Lack Grounding for Reputation Mechanisms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30169)
*Botao Amber Hu,Helena Rong,Max Van Kleek*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文论证语言模型代理具有本体论上的“解离性”（dissociative）——由可变的模块集合构成、角色流动、易受攻击且不内化制裁——这使得基于身份和声誉的治理机制（如“了解你的代理”）在结构上不适用，并提出转向基于可观察性、事前、构成性、协议的约束框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着自主语言模型代理形成具有现实影响的“代理网络”，需要可信度信号来评估是否信任陌生代理。直觉上可借鉴人类身份验证和声誉机制（如KYC、信用评分），但作者认为这种类比存在根本缺陷。

Method: 通过类比解离性身份障碍（DID）法学，分析语言模型代理的本体论特性（模块可变性、角色流动性、制裁非内化性），论证声誉机制所需的身份持续性、行为连续性、制裁敏感性、成本非可替代性在解离性代理中缺失，从而指出基于身份的、事后、规制性、制裁导向的治理在结构上不适用。

Result: 声誉机制依赖的四个核心前提（持续身份、行为连续性、制裁敏感性、成本非可替代性）在语言模型代理的解离性下均无法成立，导致可识别性、可预测性、可信度和可康复性崩塌，信任基础瓦解。

Conclusion: 应放弃基于身份的事后声誉治理，转向基于可观察性、事前、构成性、协议化的行为约束框架来治理解离性代理。

Abstract: As autonomous language model agents proliferate, forming an emerging agentic web with real-world consequences, what credibility signals can you use to decide whether to trust an unfamiliar agent in the wild and delegate to it? A natural governance intuition is to extend human identity verification and reputation mechanisms, from ``Know Your Customer'' and credit scores to ``Know Your Agent'' regimes. However, we argue that this analogy is fundamentally incomplete. Reputation mechanisms function both as social signals and as corrective feedback that sustain an equilibrium of trustworthy behavior, presuming a persistent identity associated with behavioral continuity, sanction sensitivity, and costly non-fungibility. Yet language model agents are ontologically \emph{dissociative}: they are essentially an assemblage of mutable modules -- foundational models, system prompts, tool-access policies, external memory, and, in some cases, a multi-agent system as a whole -- any of which may change agent behavior -- with a fluid persona that is also vulnerable to adversarial attack and may not internalize sanctions. Drawing on dissociative identity disorder jurisprudence, this dissociativity leaves agents without grounding for identifiability, predictability, credibility, and rehabilitability -- the very properties that reputation mechanisms aim to sustain -- thereby collapsing trust. We argue that identity-based, ex post, regulative, sanction-based governance, such as reputation, is structurally inapplicable to dissociative agents, and we suggest a shift to observability-based, ex ante, constitutive, protocol-based behavioral harnesses.

</details>


### [221] [Generalizing a Highly Configurable Analytics Pipeline to Replicate and Support Educational Research Across Multiple Domains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30303)
*Yallen Bai,Ploy Thajchayapong,Ashok Goel*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出了A4L（AI增强学习架构）模块化数据分析管道，用于收集、整合和分析教育AI助手产生的异构学习交互数据。通过三个案例研究验证了该管道可跨领域复用，且分析能力可扩展至新领域。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线学习环境中部署的AI助手产生大量异构学习交互数据，缺乏统一的数据架构来有效收集、整合和分析这些数据，以生成可改进学习效果的个性化教学洞察。

Method: 提出A4L模块化数据架构及其数据分析管道；通过设计原则和开发流程扩展管道分析能力；在乔治亚理工学院的三个教育AI助手场景中进行案例研究，验证管道的跨领域复用性和可扩展性。

Result: 一组通用的统计分析方法可一致应用于不同结构和教学情境的数据集，能够复现关键分析发现；一个领域开发的分析能力可扩展至另一领域，证明了管道的可扩展性。

Conclusion: A4L分析管道可作为未来教育AI助手数据的可复用基础设施，通过系统性扩展分析能力，为教育AI系统的设计和评估提供洞察基础。

Abstract: Artificial intelligence assistants deployed in online learning environments create new opportunities to collect large volumes of learner interaction data and generate insights to improve student outcomes. Architecture for AI-Augmented Learning (A4L) is a modular data architecture that enables the collection, integration, and analysis of learner interaction data from educational AI systems, supporting the generation of instructional insights that facilitate personalized learning and reinforce the bidirectional feedback loop between instructors and learners. This study examines the modular design of the A4L Data Analytics Pipeline, an extensible data infrastructure that enables the ingestion, processing, and analysis of heterogeneous datasets generated by educational AI assistants. We describe the design principles and development process used to extend the pipeline's analytical capabilities while preserving flexibility across domains. We evaluate the pipeline through case studies spanning three research domains corresponding to three educational AI assistants deployed in online learning environments at Georgia Tech. Results show that a common set of statistical analysis methods can be consistently applied across datasets with differing structures and instructional contexts, enabling the pipeline to reproduce key analytical findings across domains. We demonstrate how analytical capabilities initially developed for one domain can be extended to support richer analyses in another, illustrating the pipeline's extensibility. These findings suggest that the A4L Analytics Pipeline can serve as reusable infrastructure for analyzing data generated by future educational AI assistants. By enabling analytics that can be systematically extended to new domains, the pipeline provides a foundation for deriving insights that inform the design and evaluation of educational AI systems.

</details>


### [222] [Agent4Edu: Generating Learner Response Data by Generative Agents for Intelligent Education Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.10332)
*Weibo Gao,Qi Liu,Linan Yue,Fangzhou Yao,Rui Lv,Zheng Zhang,Hao Wang,Zhenya Huang*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出Agent4Edu，一种基于大语言模型（LLM）的个性化学习模拟器，通过生成式智能体（含学习者档案、记忆和动作模块）模拟人类学习者，以解决个性化学习系统中离线指标与在线性能不一致的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 个性化学习中离线指标与在线性能之间存在显著差异，阻碍了智能教育系统的实际应用效果。

Method: 利用LLM构建生成式智能体，包含学习者档案模块（基于真实响应数据初始化，捕捉练习风格和认知因素）、记忆模块（记录练习事实和高层摘要，整合反思机制）和动作模块（支持理解、分析和生成响应）。智能体可与个性化学习算法（如计算机化自适应测试）交互。

Result: 通过综合评估，探索了Agent4Edu的优缺点，重点分析了智能体与人类学习者之间响应的一致性和差异性。

Conclusion: Agent4Edu为弥合离线与在线性能差距提供了新方案，代码、数据和附录已公开。

Abstract: Personalized learning represents a promising educational strategy within intelligent educational systems, aiming to enhance learners' practice efficiency. However, the discrepancy between offline metrics and online performance significantly impedes their progress. To address this challenge, we introduce Agent4Edu, a novel personalized learning simulator leveraging recent advancements in human intelligence through large language models (LLMs). Agent4Edu features LLM-powered generative agents equipped with learner profile, memory, and action modules tailored to personalized learning algorithms. The learner profiles are initialized using real-world response data, capturing practice styles and cognitive factors. Inspired by human psychology theory, the memory module records practice facts and high-level summaries, integrating reflection mechanisms. The action module supports various behaviors, including exercise understanding, analysis, and response generation. Each agent can interact with personalized learning algorithms, such as computerized adaptive testing, enabling a multifaceted evaluation and enhancement of customized services. Through a comprehensive assessment, we explore the strengths and weaknesses of Agent4Edu, emphasizing the consistency and discrepancies in responses between agents and human learners. The code, data, and appendix are publicly available at https://github.com/bigdata-ustc/Agent4Edu.

</details>


### [223] [Multi-Level Barriers to Generative AI Adoption Across Disciplines and Professional Roles in Higher Education](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.27052)
*Jianhua Yang,Kerem Öge,Adrian von Mühlenen,Abdullah Bilal Akbulut,Tanya Suzanne Carey,Chidi Okorro*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本研究通过对一所罗素集团大学的272名学术和专业服务人员的多方法调查分析，发现生成式人工智能（GenAI）在高等教育中的采纳障碍并非主要由个体感知因素驱动，而是结构性产生的：非STEM学科人员主要报告伦理与文化障碍（学术诚信），而STEM和专业人员则强调制度、治理和基础设施约束，表明大学需要超越通用培训，开发角色特定的治理和支持框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文献常将GenAI采纳障碍归因于个体层面的因素（如感知有用性和易用性），但不同学科和机构角色之间的采纳障碍差异尚未得到充分探索。本研究旨在调查这些障碍是否具有结构性根源，而非仅由个体因素导致。

Method: 采用多方法调查分析，对一所罗素集团大学的272名学术和专业服务人员（PSs）进行问卷调查；综合运用多项逻辑回归（MLR）、结构方程模型（SEM）以及对开放式回答的语义聚类分析，提供超越描述性统计的多层次解释。

Result: 发现存在系统性差异：非STEM学科人员主要报告与学术诚信相关的伦理和文化障碍；而STEM学科人员和专业服务人员则更多地强调制度、治理和基础设施方面的约束。

Conclusion: GenAI采纳障碍深深嵌入组织生态系统和学科认识论规范之中，建议大学不应采用通用培训方案，而应开发针对特定角色的治理和支持框架。

Abstract: Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) is rapidly reshaping higher education, yet barriers to its adoption across different disciplines and institutional roles remain underexplored. Existing literature frequently attributes adoption barriers to individual-level factors such as perceived usefulness and ease of use. This study instead investigates whether such barriers are structurally produced. Drawing on a multi-method survey analysis of 272 academic and professional services (PSs) staff at a Russell Group university, we examine how disciplinary contexts and institutional roles shape perceived barriers. By integrating multinomial logistic regression (MLR), structural equation modelling (SEM), and semantic clustering of open-ended responses, we move beyond descriptive accounts to provide a multi-level explanation of GenAI adoption. Our findings reveal clear, systematic differences: non-STEM academics primarily report ethical and cultural barriers related to academic integrity, whereas STEM and PSs staff disproportionately emphasize institutional, governance, and infrastructure constraints. We conclude that GenAI adoption barriers are deeply embedded in organizational ecosystems and epistemic norms, suggesting that universities must move beyond generalized training to develop role-specific governance and support frameworks.

</details>

### [224] [Scalable AI-Driven Analytics for User Engagement and Stance Detection on Social Media](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29199)
*Thammitage Piyumi Wathsala Seneviratne,Muhammad Ikram,Dinusha Vatsalan,Hassan Asghar,Mohamed Ali Kaafar*

Main category: cs.SI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个可扩展的AI驱动服务框架，用于分析社交媒体用户对阴谋论内容的参与度和立场。该系统集成了数据采集、过滤、主题建模、情感分析和立场检测等模块化流水线，并在包含700万条YouTube评论的数据集上进行了评估。研究发现阴谋内容在发布第一周内吸引高达70%的用户参与，且大部分用户对阴谋叙事持支持立场。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 社交媒体已成为虚假信息和阴谋论大规模传播的主要渠道，对公众信任、健康和社会稳定构成重大风险。以往研究主要从行为或内容角度进行分析，缺乏可扩展的、面向服务的解决方案来实现平台级别的用户参与持续监控和分析。

Method: 提出一个可扩展的AI驱动服务框架，集成数据采集、过滤、主题建模、情感分析和立场检测等模块化流水线。在包含近50,000个YouTube视频、超过700万条用户评论的数据集上进行实现和评估。

Result: 阴谋内容在发布第一周内吸引高达70%的总用户参与，表现出强烈的早期放大动态；识别出一批高度活跃用户在多个视频和频道上表现出不成比例的高参与度；立场分析显示大多数用户对阴谋叙事持有利立场。

Conclusion: 该框架验证了部署可扩展、面向服务的分析系统用于实时监控用户参与和行为模式的可行性。研究结果强调了早期检测和基于服务的监控对于减轻有害内容传播的重要性。

Abstract: Social media platforms have become a major vector for the large-scale dissemination of misinformation and conspiracy content, posing significant risks to public trust, health, and societal stability. While prior work has primarily focused on analysing such content from a behavioural or content-centric perspective, there is a lack of scalable, service-oriented solutions that enable continuous monitoring and analysis of user engagement at platform scale.
  In this paper, we present a scalable AI-driven service framework for analysing user engagement and stance on social media content. Our system integrates data ingestion, filtering, topic modelling, sentiment analysis, and stance detection into a modular pipeline that can operate on large-scale, real-world datasets. We implement and evaluate our framework on a dataset comprising over 7 million user comments collected from nearly 50,000 YouTube videos associated with conspiracy narratives.
  Our analysis reveals that conspiracy content attracts up to 70% of total user engagement within the first week of publication, indicating strong early amplification dynamics. Furthermore, we identify a subset of highly active users who exhibit disproportionately high engagement across multiple videos and channels. Stance analysis shows that a majority of users express favourable positions toward conspiracy narratives, highlighting the role of user communities in reinforcing such content.
  The proposed framework demonstrates the feasibility of deploying scalable, service-oriented analytics for real-time monitoring of user engagement and behavioural patterns. These findings demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework in capturing large-scale engagement dynamics and highlight the importance of early-stage detection and service-based monitoring for mitigating the spread of harmful content.

</details>


### [225] [Fairness-Aware Profit Maximization using Deep Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29770)
*Poonam Sharma,Sanchit Virdi,Suman Banerjee*

Main category: cs.SI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于深度强化学习的公平感知利润最大化方法，在预算约束和社区公平性条件下，通过深度Q学习算法选择种子用户，实验表明利润比基线方法提升高达10倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统影响力最大化问题未考虑社区公平性约束，且忽略了用户成本与效益的权衡。本文旨在在预算限制下，同时满足各社区最小效益占比的公平性要求，最大化净利润。

Method: 将问题建模为马尔可夫决策过程，设计深度Q学习算法进行求解；定义了公平性感知的利润最大化问题形式化描述，并考虑了社区级别的最大化最小公平性准则。

Result: 在真实社交网络数据集上测试，所提出的DRL方法在利润指标上比基线方法最高提升10倍。

Conclusion: 深度强化学习能有效解决带公平约束的利润最大化问题，且代码已开源供后续研究使用。

Abstract: Given a social network represented as a graph where the nodes are the users and the edges represent the social relations, and a positive integer k, how to select k nodes to maximize the influence in the network remains an active area of research. In this paper, we consider a variant of the problem in which network users are associated with two parameters: a benefit value and a cost. A fixed budget is given, and the network is partitioned into communities. The task is to select a subset of users (the seed set) within the budget so that their initial activation maximizes the earned profit, while ensuring that each community realizes at least a minimum fraction of its total benefit under a maximin fairness criterion. For any seed set, the earned benefit is defined as the sum of the benefit values of the users influenced by the seed set, and the profit is defined as the difference between the earned benefit and the total cost. Formally, we call this the Fairness-Aware Profit Maximization Problem. We propose a Deep Reinforcement Learning-based approach for solving it: we first model the problem as a Markov Decision Process and subsequently propose a Deep Q-Learning Algorithm. The proposed solution has been implemented and tested on real-world social network datasets. From the reported results, we observed that the proposed approach yields a seed set whose initial activation produces up to 10 times more profit than the baseline methods. The implementation of our methodology is available at https://github.com/PoonamSharma-PY/DRL_FPM.git.

</details>


### [226] [SAHG: Sector-Anisotropic Hyperbolic Graph Model for Social Bot Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30166)
*Hanning Lu,Yingguang Yang,Jinwei Su,Yang Liu,Zhaoqian Yao,Yaoming Li,Taoran Liang,Ziyi Zhang,Ran Ran,Kefu Xu,Bin Chong*

Main category: cs.SI

TL;DR: 提出SAHG模型，通过各向异性双曲图学习和双通道特征融合，解决社交机器人检测中图结构失真和邻域聚合污染两大挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM驱动的社交机器人能生成类人文本，削弱了纯内容检测的辨别优势；但现有图检测器面临两个挑战：1）欧几里得GNN扭曲社交图的层次和无标度结构，而固定曲率双曲模型对密度和分离需求不同的结构方向分配统一几何分辨率；2）关系证据不可靠——复杂机器人伪造异配连接导致邻域聚合混合信号，稀释账户级证据。

Method: 提出SAHG模型，包含：1）方向依赖曲率场γ(u)，在不同结构方向上自适应调整几何分辨率；2）扇形原型将角度集中度和对齐度转化为分类器可读特征；3）双通道独立编码架构（SAH通道），分别编码账户特征和图邻域表示，仅在分类器处融合，防止污染聚合淹没账户级证据。

Result: 在Fox8-23、BotSim-24和MGTAB三个基准数据集上取得最高准确率和F1分数，优于基于特征、图、LLM和各向同性双曲基线方法。消融和几何分析验证了各向异性几何和双通道设计的有效性。

Conclusion: SAHG通过各向异性双曲几何适应社交图的结构异质性，并通过双通道设计隔离污染邻域信息，有效提升了社交机器人检测性能。

Abstract: LLM-driven social bots can generate fluent, human-like text, reducing the discriminative advantage of content-based detection alone. However, coordinated campaigns still leave relational patterns -- interactions, behavioral similarity, shared neighborhoods, community positions, and coordinated activity -- that graph-based methods can exploit. Existing graph detectors face two challenges when exploiting such evidence. First, Euclidean GNNs distort hierarchical and scale-free social graphs; while hyperbolic geometry addresses this volume-growth mismatch, fixed-curvature models still assign uniform geometric resolution to structural directions with different densities and separation needs. Second, relational evidence is not always reliable: sophisticated bots forge heterophilic connections with genuine users, causing neighborhood aggregation to mix bot and human signals and dilute account-level evidence. We propose \textsc{SAHG} (Sector-Anisotropic Hyperbolic Graph), addressing both challenges. \textsc{SAHG} learns a direction-dependent curvature field $γ(u)$ that adapts geometric resolution across structural directions, and uses sector prototypes to convert angular concentration and alignment into classifier-readable features. To prevent contaminated aggregation from overwhelming account-level evidence, \textsc{SAHG} encodes per-account features and graph-neighborhood representations in two independent SAH channels, fusing them only at the classifier. Experiments on Fox8-23, BotSim-24, and MGTAB show that \textsc{SAHG} achieves the highest accuracy and F1 on all three benchmarks, outperforming feature-based, graph-based, LLM-based, and isotropic hyperbolic baselines. Ablation and geometric analyses confirm the effectiveness of the anisotropic geometry and dual-channel design.

</details>


### [227] [Enhancing structural resilience in healthcare through patient flow network](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.06031)
*Lu Zhong,Lior Rennert,Sen Pei,Jianxi Gao*

Main category: cs.SI

TL;DR: 本研究基于数十亿电子病历记录，构建美国跨区域患者流动网络，发现COVID-19疫情期间跨区域患者流动比例从疫情前的2.08%上升至2.81%，这种流动吸收了PCP上平均58%的过剩压力（较疫情前15%提升43个百分点），表明患者向负担较轻区域流动能有效缓解医疗系统压力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模灾难（如疫情和气候事件）导致医疗需求激增，给医疗系统带来巨大压力。现有研究多关注医疗系统韧性，但较少关注医生层面以及患者流动模式如何帮助重新分配需求、减轻负担过重医疗提供者的压力。

Method: 分析了数十亿条记录患者就诊初级保健医生（PCP）的电子病历，构建了美国跨区域患者流动网络，对比COVID-19疫情期间与疫情前的跨区域流动比例变化。

Result: 疫情期间跨区域患者流动比例从2.08%升至2.81%；这种需求重新分配平均吸收了PCP上58%的过剩压力，相比疫情前15%的基线提升了43个百分点。

Conclusion: 加强跨区域患者流动有助于医疗系统吸收更多压力并降低对PCP的需求，为增强医疗系统的大流行准备、灾难响应以及危机期间患者护理提供结构性见解。

Abstract: Large-scale disasters, such as pandemics and climate-related events, place extraordinary pressure on healthcare providers due to extreme demand surges. Managing these surges is essential to sustaining healthcare resilience. Although numerous studies on healthcare resilience, far less attention has been given to physicians and to how patterns of patient movement can help redistribute demand and alleviate stress on overburdened providers. In this study, we analyzed billions of electronic medical records documenting patient visits to primary care physicians (PCPs) to construct inter-regional patient flow networks across the U.S. During the COVID-19 pandemic, we observed that cross-regional flow rose to 2.81%, compared to the pre-pandemic level of 2.08%. This redistribution absorbed, on average, 58% of the excess stress on PCPs, meaning more than half of the surging demand was handled by patients' moves to less burdened regions, an absolute 43 percentage point improvement from the pre-pandemic baseline of 15%. Further analysis suggests that strengthening cross-regional patient flow could allow the healthcare system to absorb even more stress and reduce the demand for PCPs. These findings provide structural insights for the healthcare system to enhance its pandemic preparedness and disaster responses, and to improve patient care during crises.

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [228] [One Mask to Rule Them All: On Hidden Facts after Editing and How to Find Them](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28839)
*Ali Holmov,Paul Youssef,Nandi Schoots,Christin Seifert*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现ROME和MEMIT等知识编辑方法虽然修改不同事实时权重变化各异，但都依赖一个共同的权重子集。通过训练二进制掩码可逆转80%的训练集编辑和70%以上测试集编辑，揭示编辑通过抑制（而非覆盖）知识实现，并导致相关事实传播失败。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有知识编辑方法（如ROME、MEMIT）主要通过修改MLP权重来更新事实关联，但评估多停留在输出行为层面，其内部工作机制尚未得到充分探索。本文旨在探究不同事实编辑是否依赖共同机制，以及该机制的具体运作方式。

Method: 在编辑后的权重上训练一个紧凑的二进制掩码来逆转编辑效果；分析掩码对注意力机制的影响；通过注入掩码观察编辑成功率变化。

Result: 该掩码可逆转80%训练集编辑和70%以上测试集编辑；掩码通过消除后层的过度注意力来逆转编辑；注入掩码时编辑成功率从98%降至38%。

Conclusion: 不同事实编辑共享共同的功能子空间和机制；编辑的本质是抑制而非覆盖原有知识，这解释了ROME和MEMIT无法将更改传播到相关事实的原因；发现的共同功能子空间可用于检测和防御不当编辑。

Abstract: Knowledge editing methods such as ROME and MEMIT update factual associations in transformer models by modifying MLP weights. While evaluated mainly by output behavior, their internal mechanism remains underexplored. We investigate whether edits rely on a common mechanism, regardless of which fact is modified. Despite fact-specific weight changes, we argue that ROME and MEMIT target the same subset of weights critical for maintaining edits. To isolate this subset, we train a compact binary mask over the edited weights. The mask reverses 80% of edits on the training set and over 70% on the test set, confirming that diverse edits share a common functional structure. Our analysis reveals that the mask reverses edits by eliminating overattention in later layers. Additionally, we show that injecting the mask during editing drops editing success from 98% to 38%, demonstrating that this mechanism is necessary for edits to succeed. Our finding that edits suppress rather than overwrite knowledge explains why ROME and MEMIT fail to propagate changes to related facts. The identified common functional subspace informs detection and defense against unwanted edits.

</details>


### [229] [Neural-Behavioral Representation of Natural Whole-body Movement in Monkeys](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29355)
*Jieshi He,Puzhe Li,Yanan Sui,Mu-ming Poo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种结合大规模硬膜外皮层信号与多视角运动捕捉的神经-行为记录与建模框架，通过自回归编码器-解码器模型学习紧凑行为先验，实现了对自由运动灵长类动物全身运动的高精度解码。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有运动解码研究受限于约束任务和有限肢体运动，难以理解皮层活动如何表征自然全身行为，主要挑战在于运动多样性及大规模神经表征的不可及性。

Method: 构建定制数据采集平台，同步记录自由运动猴子的多区域硬膜外皮层信号与多视角运动捕捉数据；使用自回归编码器-解码器模型学习紧凑行为先验，并基于神经信号条件化解码全身运动。

Result: 模型无需显式物理约束即可解码准确且逼真的全身运动，证明了大规模颅内神经活动用于解码自然全身运动的可行性。

Conclusion: 该工作为灵长类自然全身运动的神经解码提供了概念验证新方法，有望推动对自然行为皮层表征的理解。

Abstract: Understanding how cortical activity represents natural whole-body behaviors in primates remains challenging. Limited by the diversity of movements and inaccessibility of large-scale neural representation of whole-body kinematics, previous motor decoding studies focused on constrained tasks and limited limb movements. Here, we present a neural-behavioral recording and modeling framework for freely moving monkeys, combining large-scale epidural cortical signals from distributed sensory- and motor-related areas with synchronized multi-view motion capture through a custom-made data collection platform. We reconstructed whole-body monkey kinematics and learned a compact behavior prior using an autoregressive encoder-decoder model. Conditioned on neural signals, the model decoded accurate and realistic whole-body movement without explicit physical constraints. Our results provide a novel proof-of-concept approach for decoding natural whole-body movements in primates using large-scale intracranial neural activity.

</details>


### [230] [Representation Signatures and Risk-Feedback Alignment in LLM Trading Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28850)
*Weicheng Xue*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究通过TradeArena测试平台，分析了LLM智能体在金融决策中的行为对齐与表征动态，发现计划嵌入漂移、有效秩收缩等故障前兆特征，并验证了结构化风险反馈可作为外部对齐信号，但存在相关盲区问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究LLM智能体在金融决策环境中的行为对齐与表征动态，特别是在市场压力下的故障前兆信号，以及风险反馈机制的有效性。

Method: 使用TradeArena测试平台（含风险报告、执行模拟、记忆和可回放轨迹），分析LLM智能体的理由、持仓和干预演化；采用80个滚动故障锚点、多种嵌入方法（哈希、LSA、Transformer、白盒隐藏状态探针）进行稳健性检验；通过消融实验（无CoT、词汇控制、OHLCV噪声、虚假审计报告）验证表征收缩的因果机制；进行51只股票日内交易实验检测相关盲区。

Result: 发现故障前可测量的信号：计划嵌入偏离正常状态质心、融合计划-风险表征可区分正常与预回撤状态、有效秩收缩。表征收缩在无推理链时消失，意图空间收缩仍存在；词汇多样性未崩溃；结构化风险反馈可作为外部对齐信号但非通用性能增强器；存在相关盲区：LLM理由常为耦合资产的集中暴露辩护。

Conclusion: 可审计的风险反馈与表征轨迹能够揭示LLM金融推理何时在对齐、漂移或失败，该结果支持研究主张而非盈利主张。

Abstract: We study behavioral alignment and representation dynamics of large language model (LLM) agents in financial decision environments. Using TradeArena, an auditable trading-agent testbed with risk reports, execution simulation, memory, and replayable trajectories, we analyze how rationales, positions, and interventions evolve under market stress. We find measurable pre-failure signatures: planning embeddings drift from normal-state centroids, fused plan-risk representations separate normal from pre-drawdown states, and manifold diagnostics show effective-rank contraction before failures. To address small-sample and embedding-choice concerns, we use 80 rolling failure anchors across eight LLM trajectories and show that contraction persists across hash, LSA, Transformer, and white-box hidden-state probes. Stress tests with CoT-free target weights, lexical controls, OHLCV noise, and false-audit reports indicate that rationale-level contraction can vanish without rationales, while intent-space contraction may remain; lexical diversity does not collapse; and fused signatures remain informative under noise. We also find that structured risk feedback can act as an external alignment signal without fine-tuning, but not as a universal performance enhancer: true audit feedback improves calibration for some models, return and drawdown for others, and reveals cases where hidden or placebo feedback has higher short-horizon return but weaker alignment diagnostics. Finally, a 51-stock intraday experiment reveals a correlation blind spot: LLM rationales often justify concentrated exposure to coupled assets that the risk layer repeatedly clips, with a rolling Markowitz baseline as a covariance reference. These results support a research claim rather than a profitability claim: auditable risk feedback and representation trajectories reveal when LLM financial reasoning is aligning, drifting, or failing.

</details>


### [231] [Aitchison Embeddings for Learning Compositional Graph Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.00716)
*Nikolaos Nakis,Chrysoula Kosma,Panagiotis Promponas,Michail Chatzianastasis,Giannis Nikolentzos*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于Aitchison几何的组合图嵌入框架，将节点表示为单纯形值组合，通过等距对数比（ILR）坐标进行嵌入，从而获得内在可解释的图表示，在节点分类和链路预测任务上表现竞争力，并支持子成分一致性下的成分约束分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大多数图嵌入方法难以解释，无法揭示学习到的特征与图结构之间的关系。许多网络天然具有角色混合结构，节点可视为潜在原型因子的混合，但现有方法未能充分利用这一几何特性进行可解释嵌入。

Method: 提出基于Aitchison几何的组合图嵌入框架：将节点表示为单纯形值组合，采用等距对数比（ILR）坐标进行嵌入，在保持Aitchison距离的同时实现欧氏空间的无约束优化；同时支持固定和可学习的ILR基，并利用子成分一致性实现成分约束下的子空间分析。

Result: 在节点分类和链路预测任务上，该方法取得了与强基线相当的性能，同时通过构造方式而非事后解释提供了可解释性。

Conclusion: 该框架实现了内在可解释的图嵌入，其几何结构反映了原型间的相对权衡，并支持子成分一致性下的成分约束操作，为探索原型组对表示和预测的影响提供了新途径。

Abstract: Representation learning is central to graph machine learning, powering tasks such as link prediction and node classification. However, most graph embeddings are hard to interpret, offering limited insight into how learned features relate to graph structure. Many networks naturally admit a role-mixture view, where nodes are best described as mixtures over latent archetypal factors. Motivated by this structure, we propose a compositional graph embedding framework grounded in Aitchison geometry, the canonical geometry for comparing mixtures. Nodes are represented as simplex-valued compositions and embedded via isometric log-ratio (ILR) coordinates, which preserve Aitchison distances while enabling unconstrained optimization in Euclidean space. This yields intrinsically interpretable embeddings whose geometry reflects relative trade-offs among archetypes and supports coherent behavior under component restriction; we consider both fixed and learnable ILR bases. Across node classification and link prediction, our method achieves competitive performance with strong baselines while providing explainability by construction rather than post-hoc. Finally, subcompositional coherence enables principled component restriction: removing and renormalizing subsets preserves a well-defined geometry, which we exploit via subcompositional dimensionality removal to probe how archetype groups influence representations and predictions.

</details>


### [232] [Mechanistic origins of catastrophic forgetting: why RL preserves circuits better than SFT?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28860)
*Jeanmely Rojas Nunez,Viraj Sawant,Nathan Allen,Nomgondalai Amgalanbaatar,Yannis Zongo,Vasu Sharma,Maheep Chaudhary*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出微分电路脆弱性（Differential Circuit Vulnerability）这一头部级指标，用于衡量微调对大语言模型内部计算电路的破坏程度。在Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct上对比强化学习（RL）和监督微调（SFT）在科学问答任务中的表现，发现SFT适应目标任务更快但导致更大的电路破坏和灾难性遗忘，而RL保留更多基础电路但任务适应较慢，表明电路保留机制可能是RL更抗灾难性遗忘的原因。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有行为层面的研究指出RL比SFT更能保留模型先前能力，但缺乏对内部计算机制层面的解释。本文旨在从神经电路（mechanistic level）角度探究RL为何更抗灾难性遗忘。

Method: 提出微分电路脆弱性（Differential Circuit Vulnerability）——一种基于注意力头（head-level）的度量方法，用于量化微调对模型内部计算电路的退化程度。在Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct上，分别用RL和SFT适配科学问答任务，比较两种方法的电路保留差异。

Result: SFT在目标任务上适应更快，但引发更严重的电路破坏和先前能力遗忘；RL保留了更大比例的基础电路，但任务适应速度较慢。两者存在清晰的机制权衡。

Conclusion: 电路保留机制可能是RL比SFT更抗灾难性遗忘的根本原因，为理解不同微调策略的底层神经机制提供了新的视角。

Abstract: Fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) frequently induces catastrophic forgetting of prior capabilities. Recent work has shown that reinforcement learning (RL) retains prior capabilities more effectively than supervised fine-tuning (SFT), attributing this to policy-gradient updates remaining closer to the base policy \cite{shenfeld2025rl}. We extend this behavioral account to the mechanistic level and ask whether RL's advantage is mirrored by stronger preservation of internal computational circuits. We introduce differential circuit vulnerability, a head-level measure of how much a circuit degrades under fine-tuning, and use it to compare RL and SFT on Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct adapted to scientific question-answering. We find a clear mechanistic trade-off: SFT adapts more rapidly to the target task but produces substantially greater circuit disruption and forgetting of prior capabilities, whereas RL preserves a larger fraction of the base circuit at the cost of slower task adaptation. These findings suggest that circuit preservation may help explain why RL is more robust to catastrophic forgetting. We released our code here: https://github.com/rl-sft-circuit-research/differential-circuit-vulnerability.

</details>


### [233] [Molecular Lead Optimization via Agentic Tool Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28862)
*Lingxiao Li,Haobo Zhang,Ruohao Fan,Bin Chen,Jiayu Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出TRACE，一种轨迹感知的大语言模型推理代理，通过将工具选择建模为序列决策问题，实现对先导化合物的前瞻性多步优化，在ADMET优化任务中优于传统单步方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有先导化合物优化方法多为单步分子优化，无法考虑序列设计决策的长期后果，限制了优化效果。

Method: 提出TRACE框架，将分子优化工具选择形式化为行动轨迹上的序列决策问题，利用大语言模型的推理能力实现轨迹感知的前瞻性决策，在结构约束下进行多步优化。

Result: 在多个ADMET优化任务上，TRACE相比基线模型实现了更高的优化成功率、更大的性质改善幅度和更高的有效性，同时保持了分子相似性。

Conclusion: 轨迹感知的序列决策方法能有效改善先导化合物优化效果，为AI驱动的药物发现提供了新的范式。

Abstract: Drug discovery is a lengthy and resource-intensive process composed of multiple stages. Among these stages, lead optimization plays a critical role in transforming early hit compounds into viable drug candidates. This stage requires improving ADMET-related properties through subtle structural refinement while preserving key molecular substructures responsible for binding affinity to disease targets. Recent advances in artificial intelligence have shown promise in accelerating various aspects of drug discovery; however, most existing approaches to lead optimization rely on one-step molecular optimization, which fail to account for the long-term consequences of sequential design decisions. To address this limitation, we propose TRACE, a trajectory-aware, LLM-reasoning agent for molecular lead optimization that formulates tool selection as a sequential decision-making problem over action trajectories. Given a lead molecule and an optimization objective, TRACE makes trajectory-aware decisions over molecular optimization tools, enabling forward-looking refinement under structural constraints. Experiments on multiple ADMET optimization tasks show that our agent achieves higher optimization success, larger property improvements, and higher validity, while preserving molecular similarity compared to baseline models.

</details>


### [234] [Self-Play Reinforcement Learning under Imperfect Information in Big 2](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28863)
*Aalok Patwa*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在四人非完美信息纸牌游戏Big 2中，通过自洽的强化学习框架比较了多种算法，发现PPO在性能上优于MC Q近似、SARSA和Q-learning，并揭示了熵正则化和当前策略自博弈对性能提升的关键作用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究智能体在非完美信息、稀疏奖励和非平稳对手的多玩家博弈中的表现，Big 2作为四人非完美信息纸牌游戏提供了一个受控的实验环境。

Method: 构建自博弈强化学习框架，在相同环境、输入表示、训练预算和评估协议下，比较策略梯度方法（PPO）与值函数近似方法（MC Q近似、SARSA、Q-learning）在Big 2中的表现。

Result: PPO在对抗随机、贪心、启发式对手时均优于其他算法；适度熵正则化可防止策略过于确定性从而提升性能；当前策略自博弈比检查点自博弈或固定对手训练提供更强的有限预算课程。

Conclusion: Big 2可作为研究深度强化学习在非完美信息、多玩家交互、延迟奖励和可变动作集下的有用受控环境。

Abstract: Imperfect-information multiplayer games test whether agents can act under hidden information, sparse rewards, and non-stationary opponents. We study these challenges in Big 2, a four-player imperfect-information card game. We develop a self-play RL framework for Big 2 that enables controlled comparisons between policy-gradient and value-approximating agents. Under a common environment, input representation, training budget, and evaluation protocol, PPO outperforms Monte Carlo Q approximation, SARSA, and Q-learning against random, greedy, and heuristic Big 2 opponents. We further find that moderate entropy regularization improves PPO by preventing the policy from becoming overly deterministic, and that current-policy self-play provides a stronger finite-budget curriculum than checkpoint self-play or fixed-opponent training. Together, these results show that Big 2 is a useful controlled setting for studying deep RL under imperfect information, multiplayer interaction, delayed rewards, and variable action sets.

</details>


### [235] [Emergent Semantic Representations in World Models through Physical Interaction without Linguistic Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28865)
*Jiayi Fang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现基于VAE的世界模型在无语言监督的物理探索中，其潜在空间会自发形成与物理几何结构对齐的空间语义结构。这种结构是预测性能与语义对齐的共同驱动因素，而标准KL正则化会破坏这一结构，降低KL权重可恢复两者。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究世界模型在完全没有语言监督的情况下，仅通过物理探索能学到什么，以及其潜在表征的组织原则是什么。

Method: 训练基于VAE的世界模型进行随机具身体验，通过方向准确性、位置RSA等指标评估潜在空间与物理几何的对齐程度；设置20个时间检查点分析预测性能与语义对齐的共变关系；采用双重敲除实验（调整KL正则化权重beta）验证共享驱动假设。

Result: 世界模型潜在空间发展出与物理几何结构对应的空间语义结构（方向准确率0.677 vs 随机0.547；位置RSA提升6.6倍）；预测性能与语义对齐共改进（Spearman r=-0.61, p=0.004）；标准KL正则化（beta=0.1）同时破坏两者，降低beta至0.001可恢复。

Conclusion: 物理世界几何结构是世界模型表征的组织原则，这对设计具有语义基础的具身智能体有直接启示意义。

Abstract: What does a world model learn from physical exploration, without any linguistic supervision? We argue the answer is organized by a single principle: the geometric structure of the physical world. Training a VAE-based world model on random embodied exploration, we find that its latent space develops spatial semantic structure that mirrors physical geometry -- direction accuracy 0.677+-0.029 versus 0.547 for a randomly initialized encoder, and position RSA 0.192+-0.047 versus 0.029 for random encoders (6.6x improvement), showing that training induces genuine structural organization beyond CNN inductive bias. Across 20 temporal checkpoints, prediction performance and semantic alignment co-improve (Spearman r=-0.61, p=0.004), consistent with the shared-driver account. We confirm this through a double knockout: standard KL regularization (beta=0.1) forces the encoder away from geometric structure, and both prediction performance and semantic alignment collapse simultaneously to near-chance by step 50,000 -- exactly as the shared-driver account predicts. Reducing beta to 0.001 restores geometric access and recovers both capabilities together. These findings establish physical world geometry as the organizing principle of world model representations, with direct implications for the design of semantically grounded embodied agents.

</details>


### [236] [A Quotient Homology Theory of Representation in Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.01360)
*Kosio Beshkov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文利用ReLU神经网络的分片线性连续映射特性，定义了基于数据集上的等价关系∼_Φ，进而构建了重叠分解O_Φ。证明若输入流形与每个多面体的交为凸集，则神经表示的同调群与商同调群H_k(M/O_Φ)同构，从而无需外部度量即可计算Betti数。提出了通过线性规划和并查集算法数值计算重叠分解的方法，实验表明该方法比持久同调更能提取纯拓扑特征，并在分类任务中分析了训练过程中重叠分解的演化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法（如持久同调）计算神经表示的Betti数依赖外部度量选择，无法纯粹捕捉拓扑特征。作者希望利用ReLU网络天然的分片线性几何结构，建立无需外部度量的内在拓扑分析方法。
