Existing approaches typically modify model parameters, but such updates can be unstable, computationally costly, and limited by local approximations. We introduce Representation Unlearning, a framework that performs unlearning directly in the model's representation space. Instead of modifying model parameters, we learn a transformation over representations that imposes an information bottleneck: maximizing mutual information with retained data while suppressing information about data to be forgotten. We derive variational surrogates that make this objective tractable and show how they can be instantiated in two practical regimes: when both retain and forget data are available, and in a zero-shot setting where only forget data can be accessed. Experiments across several benchmarks demonstrate that Representation Unlearning achieves more reliable forgetting, better utility retention, and greater computational efficiency than parameter-centric baselines.

</details>


### [461] [Bridging Functional and Representational Similarity via Usable Information](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.21568)
*Antonio Almudévar,Alfonso Ortega*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个统一框架，通过"可用信息"的视角量化表征之间的相似性，从功能相似性、表征相似性以及两者关系三个维度进行了严格的理论与实证综合，发现拼接性能与条件互信息存在形式化联系，拼接具有内在不对称性，重建度量和CKA/RSA等标准工具在特定约束下可作为可用信息的估计量，且表征相似性是功能相似性的充分但不必要条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有表征相似性度量方法（如CKA、RSA、拼接分析等）缺乏统一的理论基础，不同方法之间的关系不明，且功能相似性与表征相似性之间的逻辑关联未被严格刻画。作者希望建立一个统一的框架来澄清这些概念之间的关系。

Method: 通过信息论视角，将多种表征相似性度量方法统一到"可用信息"（usable information）框架下，建立了拼接性能与条件互信息之间的形式化联系，并从任务粒度层级角度分析了表征相似性与功能相似性的关系。

Result: 1) 拼接分析本质上度量的是条件互信息，且具有内在不对称性，需要双向分析；2) CKA、RSA等重建基度量在特定约束下是可用信息的估计量；3) 表征相似性是功能相似性的充分但不必要条件，且表征相似性可视为最大粒度（输入重建）下的极限。

Conclusion: 表征相似性是相对的，取决于预测族的容量；任务粒度层级表明，在复杂任务上的相似性可保证在任意粗粒度衍生任务上的相似性；为表征相似性研究提供了统一的理论基础。

Abstract: We present a unified framework for quantifying the similarity between representations through the lens of \textit{usable} information, offering a rigorous theoretical and empirical synthesis across three key dimensions. First, addressing functional similarity, we establish a formal link between stitching performance and conditional mutual information. We further reveal that stitching is inherently asymmetric, demonstrating that robust functional comparison necessitates a bidirectional analysis rather than a unidirectional mapping. Second, concerning representational similarity, we find that reconstruction-based metrics and standard tools (e.g., CKA, RSA) act as estimators of usable information under specific constraints. Crucially, we show that similarity is relative to the capacity of the predictive family: representations that appear distinct to a rigid observer may be identical to a more expressive one. Third, we demonstrate that representational similarity is sufficient but not necessary for functional similarity. We unify these concepts through a task-granularity hierarchy: similarity on a complex task guarantees similarity on any coarser derivative, establishing representational similarity as the limit of maximum granularity: input reconstruction.

</details>


### [462] [Server-Proximal Aggregation for Federated Domain-Incremental Learning under Partial Participation: Task-Uniform Convergence and Backward Transfer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.22274)
*Longtao Xu,Jian Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SPECIAL算法，通过服务器端添加轻量级近端项（锚点）来约束FedAvg中的累积漂移，实现联邦域增量学习（FDIL）中的后向知识迁移保证和首个非凸收敛速率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实联邦系统面临输入分布漂移且不允许共享原始数据，但现有FDIL方法缺乏后向知识迁移（BKT）的理论保证以及部分客户端参与下跨任务序列的收敛率分析。

Method: 在标准FedAvg基础上，服务器端添加一个轻量级近端项（锚点），在每轮通信中将被均匀采样参与客户端的更新向上一轮全局模型方向拉近，从而约束累积漂移；无需回放缓冲区、合成数据或任务特定头，保持通信和模型大小不变。

Result: 理论证明：SPECIAL能限制先前任务损失增长（BKT界），该界限随轮数、本地epoch数和参与客户端数增加而缩小；首次给出FDIL在部分客户端参与下的非凸收敛率O((E/NT)^(1/2))，与单任务FedAvg匹配，且明确分离了优化方差与任务间漂移。

Conclusion: SPECIAL是一种简单、无记忆的FDIL算法，在理论上同时保证了后向知识迁移和学习效率，实验进一步验证了其有效性。

Abstract: Real-world federated systems seldom operate on static data: input distributions drift while privacy rules forbid raw-data sharing. We study this setting as Federated Domain-Incremental Learning (FDIL), where (i) clients are heterogeneous, (ii) tasks arrive sequentially with shifting domains, yet (iii) the label space remains fixed. Two theoretical pillars remain missing for FDIL under realistic deployment: a guarantee of backward knowledge transfer (BKT) and a convergence rate that holds across the sequence of all tasks with partial participation. We introduce SPECIAL (Server-Proximal Efficient Continual Aggregation for Learning), a simple, memory-free FDIL algorithm that adds a single server-side ``anchor'' to vanilla FedAvg: in each round, the server nudges the uniformly sampled participated clients update toward the previous global model with a lightweight proximal term. This anchor curbs cumulative drift without replay buffers, synthetic data, or task-specific heads, keeping communication and model size unchanged. Our theory shows that SPECIAL (i) preserves earlier tasks: a BKT bound caps any increase in prior-task loss by a drift-controlled term that shrinks with more rounds, local epochs, and participating clients; and (ii) learns efficiently across all tasks: the first communication-efficient non-convex convergence rate for FDIL with partial participation, O((E/NT)^(1/2)), with E local epochs, T communication rounds, and N participated clients per round, matching single-task FedAvg while explicitly separating optimization variance from inter-task drift. Experimental results further demonstrate the effectiveness of SPECIAL.

</details>


### [463] [Pushing the Limits of Block Rotations in Post-Training Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.22347)
*Sai Sanjeet,Ian Colbert,Pablo Monteagudo-Lago,Giuseppe Franco,Yaman Umuroglu,Nicholas J. Fraser*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出PeRQ框架，通过在块旋转前引入排列操作重新分布激活值质量，有效抑制量化异常值。理论分析揭示了块Hadamard旋转抑制异常值的本质限制，提出贪心质量扩散算法校准排列。实验表明PeRQ在所有块大小上均能提升精度，在Llama3 1B INT4量化（块大小16）中恢复全向量旋转困惑度的90%，远超无排列时的46%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有块旋转PTQ方法虽降低了全向量旋转的在线开销，但块结构对异常值抑制的影响缺乏理论理解。本文旨在填补这一空白，提供首个系统性非渐近分析，并据此设计更优的量化框架。

Method: 1) 理论分析块Hadamard旋转的异常值抑制界限，揭示其受输入向量几何结构限制；2) 提出PeRQ框架，在旋转前通过排列重新分布激活质量；3) 设计贪心质量扩散算法，通过均衡期望块内ℓ1范数来校准排列；4) 识别Transformer中的排列等变区域，将排列合并到模型权重中以避免推理开销。

Result: PeRQ在所有块大小上均显著提升量化精度。在Llama3 1B INT4量化（块大小16）中，恢复全向量旋转困惑度的90%，而无排列仅恢复46%。

Conclusion: 块旋转抑制异常值的效果受限于输入向量ℓ1范数在块间的分布均匀性。通过排列预均衡块间质量分布，可在不增加推理开销的前提下显著提升PTQ性能。

Abstract: Recent post-training quantization (PTQ) methods have adopted block rotations to diffuse outliers prior to rounding. While this reduces the overhead of online full-vector rotations, the effect of block structure on outlier suppression remains poorly understood. To fill this gap, we present the first systematic, non-asymptotic analysis of outlier suppression for block Hadamard rotations. Our analysis reveals that outlier suppression is fundamentally limited by the geometry of the input vector. In particular, in the deterministic worst case, post-rotation outliers are minimized when the pre-rotation $\ell_1$ norm mass is evenly distributed across blocks. Guided by these insights, we introduce PeRQ (Permute, Rotate, then Quantize), a PTQ framework that redistributes activation mass via permutations prior to rotation. We propose a greedy mass diffusion algorithm to calibrate permutations by equalizing the expected blockwise $\ell_1$ norms. To avoid adding inference overhead, we identify permutation-equivariant regions in transformer architectures to merge these permutations into model weights before deployment. Experiments show that PeRQ consistently improves accuracy across all block sizes, recovering up to 90% of the full-vector rotation perplexity when quantizing Llama3 1B to INT4 with block size 16, compared to 46% without permutations.

</details>


### [464] [Learn from A Rationalist: Distilling Intermediate Interpretable Rationales](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.22531)
*Jiayi Dai,Randy Goebel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出REKD方法，通过知识蒸馏将教师模型的解释性特征选择能力传授给学生RE模型，提升基于小规模神经网络的可解释特征提取框架的预测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有理性提取（RE）框架中，基于小规模神经网络的学生模型在特征选择空间搜索上计算困难，预测性能不足，需要在不牺牲可解释性的前提下提升其预测能力。

Method: REKD方法在原有RE优化目标基础上，增加教师模型（理性主义者）提供的理性（特征选择）和预测结果的蒸馏损失，使学生RE模型同时从自身优化和教师知识中学习，结构上模拟人类从可解释、可验证知识中有效学习的过程。

Result: 在IMDB电影评论、CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100数据集上，基于BERT和ViT变体的实验表明，REKD显著提升了学生RE模型的预测性能。

Conclusion: REKD作为一种与神经网络架构无关的方法，能有效提升基于小规模网络的RE模型性能，验证了可解释知识蒸馏在提高模型预测能力方面的可行性。

Abstract: Because of the pervasive use of deep neural networks (DNNs), especially in high-stakes domains, the interpretability of DNNs has received increased attention. The general idea of rationale extraction (RE) is to provide an interpretable-by-design framework for DNNs via a select-predict architecture where two neural networks learn jointly to perform feature selection and prediction, respectively. Given only the remote supervision from the final task prediction, the process of learning to select subsets of features (or rationales) requires searching in the space of all possible feature combinations, which is computationally challenging and even harder when the base neural networks are not sufficiently capable. To improve the predictive performance of RE models that are based on less capable or smaller neural networks (i.e., the students), we propose REKD (Rationale Extraction with Knowledge Distillation) where a student RE model learns from the rationales and predictions of a teacher (i.e., a rationalist) in addition to the student's own RE optimization. This structural adjustment to RE aligns well with how humans could learn effectively from interpretable and verifiable knowledge. Because of the neural-model agnostic nature of the method, any black-box neural network could be integrated as a backbone model. To demonstrate the viability of REKD, we conduct experiments with multiple variants of BERT and vision transformer (ViT) models. Our experiments across language and vision classification datasets (i.e., IMDB movie reviews, CIFAR 10 and CIFAR 100) show that REKD significantly improves the predictive performance of the student RE models.

</details>


### [465] [Unsupervised Hierarchical Skill Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.23156)
*Damion Harvey,Geraud Nangue Tasse,Benjamin Rosman,Branden Ingram,Steven James*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种无监督的技能分割与层次结构发现方法，基于语法从无标签轨迹中学习技能层次，在Craftax和Minecraft等像素级环境中优于现有基线，并能加速下游强化学习任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有无监督技能分割方法多依赖动作标签、奖励或手工标注，限制了其通用性和可扩展性。

Method: 采用基于语法的方法，对无标签轨迹进行技能分割，并诱导出技能间的层次结构，捕捉底层行为及其向高层技能的组合关系。

Result: 在Craftax和完整版Minecraft等像素级环境中，使用技能分割、复用和层次质量等指标评估，所提方法一致地生成比现有基线更具结构性和语义意义的层次结构。

Conclusion: 所发现的层次结构能够加速并稳定下游强化学习任务的学习过程。

Abstract: We consider the problem of unsupervised skill segmentation and hierarchical structure discovery in reinforcement learning. While recent approaches have sought to segment trajectories into reusable skills or options, most rely on action labels, rewards, or handcrafted annotations, limiting their applicability. We propose a method that segments unlabelled trajectories into skills and induces a hierarchical structure over them using a grammar-based approach. The resulting hierarchy captures both low-level behaviours and their composition into higher-level skills. We evaluate our approach in high-dimensional, pixel-based environments, including Craftax and the full, unmodified version of Minecraft. Using metrics for skill segmentation, reuse, and hierarchy quality, we find that our method consistently produces more structured and semantically meaningful hierarchies than existing baselines. Furthermore, as a proof of concept, we demonstrate that these discovered hierarchies accelerate and stabilise learning on downstream reinforcement learning tasks.

</details>


### [466] [Good SFT Optimizes for SFT, Better SFT Prepares for Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.01058)
*Dylan Zhang,Yufeng Xu,Haojin Wang,Qingzhi Chen,Hao Peng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出PEAR方法，通过在SFT阶段使用重要性采样重新加权损失，解决SFT数据分布与在线RL策略分布不匹配的问题，从而提升后续RL训练效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前SFT-RL流水线存在分布不匹配问题：离线SFT数据分布与在线RL策略自采样数据的分布差异显著，导致更强的SFT checkpoint在RL后反而表现更差。

Method: 提出PEAR方法，在SFT阶段使用重要性采样重新加权损失，有三种变体（token级、block级、sequence级），仅需很少额外训练开销。

Result: 在可验证推理游戏和数学推理任务（Qwen 2.5/3、DeepSeek蒸馏模型）上，PEAR一致提升RL后性能，AIME2025上pass@8提升达14.6%。

Conclusion: PEAR是迈向更整体化LLM后训练的有效步骤，强调应以下游RL为导向来设计和评估SFT，而非孤立优化。

Abstract: Post-training of reasoning LLMs is a holistic process that typically consists of an offline SFT stage followed by an online reinforcement learning (RL) stage. However, SFT is often optimized in isolation to maximize SFT performance alone.
  We show that, after identical RL training, models initialized from stronger SFT checkpoints can significantly underperform those initialized from weaker ones. We attribute this to a mismatch typical in current SFT-RL pipelines: the distribution that generates the offline SFT data can differ substantially from the policy optimized during online RL, which learns from its own rollouts.
  We propose PEAR (Policy Evaluation-inspired Algorithm for Offline Learning Loss Re-weighting), an SFT-stage method that corrects this mismatch and better prepares the model for RL. PEAR uses importance sampling to reweight the SFT loss, with three variants operating at the token, block, and sequence levels. It can be used to augment standard SFT objectives and incurs little additional training overhead once probabilities for the offline data are collected.
  We conduct controlled experiments on verifiable reasoning games and mathematical reasoning tasks on Qwen 2.5 and 3 and DeepSeek-distilled models. PEAR consistently improves post-RL performance over canonical SFT, with pass at 8 gains up to a 14.6 percent on AIME2025. Our results suggest that PEAR is an effective step toward more holistic LLM post-training by designing and evaluating SFT with downstream RL in mind rather than in isolation.

</details>


### [467] [How Far Ahead Do LLMs Plan? Uncovering the Latent Horizon in Chain-of-Thought Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.02103)
*Liyan Xu,Mo Yu,Fandong Meng,Jie Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过提出的Tele-Lens探针方法研究LLM在链式思维推理中的潜在规划能力，发现LLM表现出短视的推理视野（主要进行增量转换而非全局规划），并基于此特性提出利用稀疏关键位置表征整个推理路径不确定性的假设，验证了无需性能损失即可自动识别CoT绕过的可能性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究存在矛盾：隐藏状态在CoT完全展开前就已编码未来推理，但显式步骤对组合性计算任务仍至关重要。为深入理解LLM内部状态与其外显推理轨迹之间的关系，作者希望探究LLM的潜在规划能力。

Method: 提出Tele-Lens探针方法，通过对不同任务领域下LLM的隐藏状态进行探测分析，评估其潜在规划强度。

Result: 1) LLM表现出短视的推理视野，主要进行增量式转换而非精确的全局规划；2) 验证了稀疏关键位置可以有效表征整个推理路径的不确定性；3) 实现了无需性能损失的自动CoT绕过识别。

Conclusion: LLM的潜在规划能力是短视的，基于此特性可以利用CoT动态来改进不确定性估计，并实现自动识别CoT绕过而不降低性能。

Abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning has become a central mechanism for eliciting multi-step reasoning in Large Language Models (LLMs). Yet recent evidence presents a tension: hidden states appear to already encode future reasoning before CoT fully unfolds, while explicit steps still remain crucial for tasks requiring compositional computation. To deepen the understanding between LLM's internal states and its verbalized reasoning trajectories, we investigate the latent planning strength of LLMs, through our probing method, Tele-Lens, applying to hidden states across diverse task domains. Our empirical results indicate that LLMs exhibit a myopic horizon, primarily conducting incremental transitions without precise global planning. Leveraging this characteristic, we propose a hypothesis on enhancing uncertainty estimation of CoT, which we validate that a sparse set of pivot positions can effectively represent the uncertainty of the entire path. We further underscore the significance of exploiting CoT dynamics, and demonstrate that automatic recognition of CoT bypass can be achieved without performance degradation. Our code, data and models are released at https://github.com/lxucs/tele-lens.

</details>


### [468] [Achieving Linear Speedup for Composite Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.03357)
*Kun Huang,Shi Pu,Karl Henrik Johansson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出FedNMap，一种基于法向映射的复合联邦学习方法，用于处理包含光滑损失和可能非光滑正则项的目标函数。该方法采用法向映射更新机制处理非光滑项，并结合局部校正策略缓解客户端数据异质性问题。在标准假设下，FedNMap在非凸损失下实现了客户端数量和本地更新次数的线性加速，这是首个在非凸复合联邦学习中建立线性加速的算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有联邦学习算法在处理复合目标（光滑损失+非光滑正则项）的非凸优化问题时，缺乏线性加速的理论保证。本文旨在填补这一空白，提出一种能够在非凸复合联邦学习场景下实现线性加速的算法。

Method: FedNMap算法包含两个核心组件：(1) 基于法向映射（normal map）的更新方案，用于处理目标函数中的非光滑正则项；(2) 局部校正策略，用于减轻跨客户端数据异质性带来的影响。

Result: 在标准假设下，FedNMap在非凸损失下（无论是否满足Polyak-Łojasiewicz条件）均实现了关于客户端数量和本地更新次数的线性加速。数值实验验证了理论发现，展示了FedNMap的线性加速性能。

Conclusion: FedNMap是首个在非凸复合联邦学习中建立线性加速的算法，为处理包含非光滑正则项的联邦学习问题提供了有效的理论框架和实用方法。

Abstract: This paper proposes FedNMap, a normal map-based method for composite federated learning, where the objective consists of a smooth loss and a possibly nonsmooth regularizer. FedNMap leverages a normal map-based update scheme to handle the nonsmooth term and incorporates a local correction strategy to mitigate the impact of data heterogeneity across clients. Under standard assumptions, including smooth local losses, weak convexity of the regularizer, and bounded stochastic gradient variance, FedNMap achieves linear speedup with respect to both the number of clients and the number of local updates for nonconvex losses, both with and without the Polyak-Łojasiewicz condition. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first algorithm establishing linear speedup for nonconvex composite federated learning. Numerical experiments corroborate our theoretical findings and demonstrate the linear speedup of FedNMap.

</details>


### [469] [Optimization and Generation in Aerodynamics Inverse Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.03582)
*Huaguan Chen,Ning Lin,Luxi Chen,Jiacheng Cen,Rui Zhang,Wenbing Huang,Chongxuan Li,Hao Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种概率框架，将视觉特征保持与空气动力学优化统一为目标函数，通过学习视觉设计分布并用气动成本重新加权，实现了保视觉特征的减阻优化（车辆减阻5.8%，飞机阻力-升力目标降低28.8%）以及视图引导的低阻力3D生成（车辆减阻3.0%，飞机阻力-升力目标降低68.6%），并通过风洞实验验证了结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的CFD驱动优化虽准确但速度慢，而现有的基于学习的方法大多仅关注性能驱动，缺乏一个能够统一优化、生成和视觉一致性的连贯目标。实际车辆设计中，减阻优化需同时保留与设计语言、品牌识别和用户感知相关的视觉特征。

Method: 将视觉保持与气动改进形式化为单一概率目标：定义与参考形状或视图一致的视觉设计分布，并用气动代价函数重新加权。优化过程将初始几何形状向低成本、高概率的设计迭代，而引导式生成则从相同输入视图采样低成本的3D候选形状。

Result: 保视觉优化使车辆阻力降低5.8%，飞机阻力-升力目标降低28.8%；视图引导生成使车辆阻力降低3.0%，飞机阻力-升力目标降低68.6%，同时保持视觉一致性。风洞实验提供了独立的尾流级验证。

Conclusion: 该工作为保视觉特征的空气动力学优化与早期3D设计探索提供了概率基础与实用途径。

Abstract: Aerodynamic inverse design can improve vehicle and aircraft efficiency, but practical design rarely seeks performance alone: vehicle refinement must reduce drag while preserving visual features linked to design language, brand recognition and user perception. Traditional CFD-driven optimization is accurate but slow for broad exploration, and current learning-based methods are still largely performance-driven and lack a coherent target linking optimization, generation and visual consistency. Here we formulate visual preservation and aerodynamic improvement as one probability target. Designs consistent with a reference shape or view define a learned visual design distribution, which is reweighted by aerodynamic cost. Optimization then refines an initial geometry toward a low-cost, high-probability design, whereas guided generation samples lower-cost 3D candidates from the same input view. OpenFOAM evaluation shows that visual-feature-preserving optimization reduces vehicle drag by 5.8\% relative to the initial vehicle and reduces the best valid aircraft drag-to-lift objective by 28.8\% relative to the initial aircraft while preserving input visual features. For view-based generation, guidance reduces vehicle drag by 3.0\% and the aircraft drag-to-lift objective by 68.6\% relative to direct generation from the same view, while maintaining visual consistency. Wind-tunnel tests with 3D-printed vehicle prototypes provide an independent wake-level check, and controlled analyses explain the distributional mechanisms behind these results. This work provides a probabilistic foundation and practical route for visual-feature-preserving aerodynamic refinement and early-stage 3D design exploration.

</details>


### [470] [Selecting Hyperparameters for Tree-Boosting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.05786)
*Floris Jan Koster,Fabio Sigrist*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过59个回归与分类数据集，系统比较了多种树提升超参数优化方法，发现SMAC方法显著优于其他方法，并得出若干重要结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 树提升模型的超参数对其泛化精度影响很大，但现有超参数优化方法缺乏系统的实证比较，研究者难以选择最佳调参策略。

Method: 在59个回归和分类数据集上，实证比较了随机网格搜索、TPE、基于高斯过程的贝叶斯优化、Hyperband、SMAC以及确定性全网格搜索等多种超参数优化方法。

Result: SMAC方法在所有候选方法中表现最优；超过100次的试验对于准确调参是必要的；默认超参数会导致非常不准确的模型；所有超参数对精度均有显著影响，不存在少数关键超参数；对于回归任务，使用早停法选择迭代次数比将其纳入搜索空间更准确。

Conclusion: 推荐使用SMAC进行树提升模型的超参数优化，并建议采用足够多的试验次数、避免使用默认参数、以及在回归任务中使用早停法而非优化迭代次数。

Abstract: Tree-boosting is a widely used machine learning technique for tabular data. However, its out-of-sample accuracy is critically dependent on multiple hyperparameters. In this article, we empirically compare several popular methods for hyperparameter optimization for tree-boosting including random grid search, the tree-structured Parzen estimator (TPE), Gaussian-process-based Bayesian optimization (GP-BO), Hyperband, the sequential model-based algorithm configuration (SMAC) method, and deterministic full grid search using $59$ regression and classification data sets. We find that the SMAC method clearly outperforms all the other considered methods. We further observe that (i) a relatively large number of trials larger than $100$ is required for accurate tuning, (ii) using default values for hyperparameters yields very inaccurate models, (iii) all considered hyperparameters can have a material effect on the accuracy of tree-boosting, i.e., there is no small set of hyperparameters that is more important than others, and (iv) choosing the number of boosting iterations using early stopping yields more accurate results compared to including it in the search space for regression tasks.

</details>


### [471] [Discrete diffusion samplers and bridges: Off-policy algorithms and applications in latent spaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.05961)
*Arran Carter,Sanghyeok Choi,Kirill Tamogashev,Víctor Elvira,Esmeralda S. Whitammer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出将离策略训练技术引入离散扩散采样器，并首次将离散扩散采样器推广至任意分布间的Schrödinger桥接任务，在合成基准和图像生成模型的离散潜在空间后验采样中验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 连续空间中的扩散采样器已被广泛研究并取得显著成功，但离散空间中的扩散采样器尚未充分利用连续空间中成熟的训练技术，性能存在提升空间。

Method: 1) 引入离策略训练技术优化离散扩散采样器；2) 将离散扩散采样器推广至任意两个分布之间的桥接任务，首次提出离散域的数据到能量Schrödinger桥训练方法。

Result: 离策略训练技术提升了离散采样器在已有和新合成基准上的性能；离散Schrödinger桥训练方法实现了离散域中任意分布间的桥接采样。

Conclusion: 离散扩散采样器可通过引入连续空间中的先进训练技术获得性能提升，并能推广至更一般的分布桥接任务，在图像生成模型的离散潜在空间后验采样中具有实际应用价值。

Abstract: Sampling from a distribution $p(x) \propto e^{-\mathcal{E}(x)}$ known up to a normalising constant is an important and challenging problem in statistics. Recent years have seen the rise of a new family of amortised sampling algorithms, commonly referred to as diffusion samplers, that enable fast and efficient sampling from an unnormalised density. Such algorithms have been widely studied for continuous-space sampling tasks; however, their application to problems in discrete space remains largely unexplored. Although some progress has been made in this area, discrete diffusion samplers do not take full advantage of ideas commonly used for continuous-space sampling. In this paper, we propose to bridge this gap by introducing off-policy training techniques for discrete diffusion samplers. We show that these techniques improve the performance of discrete samplers on both established and new synthetic benchmarks. Next, we generalise discrete diffusion samplers to the task of bridging between two arbitrary distributions, introducing data-to-energy Schrödinger bridge training for the discrete domain for the first time. Lastly, we showcase the application of the proposed diffusion samplers to data-free posterior sampling in the discrete latent spaces of image generative models.

</details>


### [472] [Rare Event Analysis of Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.06791)
*Jake McAllister Dorman,Edward Gillman,Dominic C. Rose,Jamie F. Mair,Juan P. Garrahan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个用于系统分析大语言模型中罕见事件的端到端框架，涵盖理论、高效生成策略、概率估计和误差分析，并通过具体示例进行说明。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型在推理过程中会产生罕见但重要的事件，由于模型使用规模巨大，开发阶段未观察到的事件在部署中可能变得显著，但缺乏系统性的分析框架。

Method: 提出了一个端到端框架，包括理论构建、高效生成策略（用于采样罕见事件）、概率估计方法以及误差分析机制，并通过具体案例进行验证。

Result: 提供了一个实用的系统性分析框架，能够有效识别、生成和估计LLM中的罕见事件，并展示了其在具体示例中的应用效果。

Conclusion: 该框架具有通用性，可扩展应用于其他模型和上下文，所提出的概念和技术具有广泛适用性。

Abstract: Being probabilistic models, during inference large language models (LLMs) display rare events: behaviour that is far from typical but highly significant. By definition all rare events are hard to see, but the enormous scale of LLM usage means that events completely unobserved during development are likely to become prominent in deployment. Here we present an end-to-end framework for the systematic analysis of rare events in LLMs. We provide a practical implementation spanning theory, efficient generation strategies, probability estimation and error analysis, which we illustrate with concrete examples. We outline extensions and applications to other models and contexts, highlighting the generality of the concepts and techniques presented here.

</details>


### [473] [Gradient Preconditioning for Efficient and Reliable Reward-Guided Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.08646)
*Jisung Hwang,Minhyuk Sung*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种梯度预处理方法，通过将奖励梯度投影到精心设计的白高斯噪声可行集上，使一步生成模型的奖励引导生成既高效又可靠，在FLUX模型上以30%的时间达到可比的美学分数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 测试时噪声优化可以实现更好的奖励引导生成，但容易出现奖励破解（质量下降）且速度太慢，不适用于实际应用。

Method: 将奖励梯度投影到具有块状范数约束的紧凑谱集（白高斯噪声可行集）上，该投影是闭式解，复杂度为O(N log N)，与FFT相当。

Result: 在FLUX模型上使用四种奖励模型，仅用基于正则化的SOTA方法30%的墙钟时间即可达到可比的美学分数。

Conclusion: 该方法使一步生成模型的奖励引导生成兼具高效性和可靠性，有效防止奖励破解。

Abstract: We propose a gradient preconditioning method that makes reward-guided generation with one-step generative models both efficient and reliable. Test-time noise optimization can unlock substantially better reward-guided generations from pretrained generative models, but it is prone to reward hacking that degrades quality and is often too slow for practical use. We precondition reward gradients by projecting them onto a carefully designed white Gaussian noise feasible set, a compact spectral set with blockwise norm constraints that tightly captures the statistics and spatial uncorrelatedness of white Gaussian noise. This preconditioning reshapes each gradient update into a noise-aligned direction, driving faster and more effective reward ascent while preventing reward hacking. The projection is closed-form and matches the $O(N \log N)$ complexity of FFT, adding negligible overhead in practice. In experiments on FLUX with four reward models, our approach reaches a comparable Aesthetic Score using only 30% of the wall-clock time required by the state-of-the-art regularization-based method.

</details>


### [474] [Computationally Efficient Replicable Learning of Parities and Applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.09499)
*Moshe Noivirt,Jessica Sorrell,Eliad Tsfadia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了可复现PAC学习与差分隐私、统计查询模型之间的计算关系。主要贡献是提出了首个针对任意分布上奇偶性问题的计算高效可复现学习算法，证明了可复现学习在计算能力上严格超越SQ学习且更接近差分隐私。此外，基于该算法证明了从可复现性到纯差分隐私的转换需要样本复杂度的严格损失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究可复现学习（replicable learning）与其他稳定性概念（差分隐私、统计查询模型）之间的计算关系，特别是此前高效可复现学习算法仅限于SQ可学习任务或受限分布，而差分隐私学习在计算上更强大。本文试图填补这一计算鸿沟。

Method: 提出一个高效且可复现的算法，给定一组向量，输出覆盖大部分向量的线性张量子空间。基于该构建块，设计了首个针对任意分布上奇偶性（parities）可实况学习的计算高效可复现算法。

Result: 1) 首个在任意分布上奇偶性问题的高效可复现学习算法，该任务在SQ模型下困难但在差分隐私下可行；2) 证明了若RP≠NP，从可复现性到纯差分隐私的转换需要样本复杂度的严格损失。

Conclusion: 可复现学习在计算能力上严格超越SQ学习，更接近差分隐私学习，尽管两者之间存在计算分离。可复现性与差分隐私之间的计算关系仍有深层结构待探索。

Abstract: We study the computational relationship between replicability (Impagliazzo et al. [STOC `22], Ghazi et al. [NeurIPS `21]) and other stability notions. Specifically, we focus on replicable PAC learning and its connections to differential privacy (Dwork et al. [TCC 2006]) and to the statistical query (SQ) model (Kearns [JACM `98]). Statistically, it was known that differentially private learning and replicable learning are equivalent and strictly more powerful than SQ-learning. Yet, computationally, all previously known efficient (i.e., polynomial-time) replicable learning algorithms were confined to SQ-learnable tasks or restricted distributions, in contrast to differentially private learning.
  Our main contribution is the first computationally efficient replicable algorithm for realizable learning of parities over arbitrary distributions, a task that is known to be hard in the SQ-model, but possible under differential privacy. This result provides the first evidence that efficient replicable learning over general distributions strictly extends efficient SQ-learning, and is closer in power to efficient differentially private learning, despite computational separations between replicability and privacy. Additionally, we leverage our parity learner to prove that, assuming $RP \neq NP$, converting replicability to pure differential privacy requires a strict loss in sample complexity. Our main building block is a new, efficient, and replicable algorithm that, given a set of vectors, outputs a subspace of their linear span that covers most of them.

</details>


### [475] [Prioritize the Process, Not Just the Outcome: Rewarding Latent Thought Trajectories Improves Reasoning in Looped Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.10520)
*Jonathan Williams,Esin Tureci*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出RLTT框架，通过轨迹级信用分配解决循环语言模型（LoopLM）中标准强化学习方法（如GRPO）仅奖励最终潜在状态、无法有效训练内部推理过程的问题。RLTT将奖励分布到整个潜在推理轨迹上，无需外部验证器，在数学推理基准上显著优于GRPO（1.4B模型+5.8%，2.6B模型+10.9%），并能迁移至非数学推理任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准强化学习方法（如GRPO）仅对循环语言模型的最终潜在状态分配奖励，与模型内部多步推理的计算过程不匹配，导致无法有效提升模型推理能力。

Method: 提出RLTT（Reward Latent Thought Trajectories），一种将奖励分布到整个潜在推理轨迹的强化学习框架，实现密集的轨迹级信用分配，无需外部验证器，可直接替代GRPO且额外开销可忽略。

Result: 在MATH-500、AIME24/26和BeyondAIME基准上，RLTT相比GRPO在1.4B规模平均提升+5.8%，在2.6B规模平均提升+10.9%；且在非数学推理基准上表现出有效迁移。

Conclusion: 轨迹级信用分配是提升循环语言模型强化学习效果的有效方法，RLTT能够更好地对齐模型内部推理过程，显著提升推理性能并跨任务泛化。

Abstract: Looped Language Models (LoopLMs) perform multi-step latent reasoning prior to token generation and outperform conventional LLMs on reasoning benchmarks at smaller parameter budgets. However, attempts to further improve LoopLM reasoning with reinforcement learning have failed - standard objectives such as Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) only assign credit to the final latent state, creating a fundamental mismatch with the model's internal computation. To resolve this, we introduce RLTT (Reward Latent Thought Trajectories), a reinforcement learning framework which distributes reward across the full latent reasoning trajectory. RLTT provides dense, trajectory-level credit assignment without relying on external verifiers and can directly replace GRPO with negligible overhead. Across extensive experiments with Ouro-1.4B/2.6B-Thinking under identical training and inference conditions, RLTT yields statistically significant improvements over GRPO on challenging mathematical reasoning benchmarks, improving mean accuracy over MATH-500, AIME24/26, and BeyondAIME by +5.8% on the 1.4B scale, and +10.9% on the 2.6B scale. Despite being trained exclusively on mathematics, RLTT also transfers effectively to non-mathematical reasoning benchmarks, demonstrating the effectiveness of trajectory-level credit assignment for reinforcement learning in LoopLMs. Code is available at https://github.com/jonwill8/RLTT.git.

</details>


### [476] [Coarse-Grained Boltzmann Generators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.10637)
*Weilong Chen,Bojun Zhao,Jan Eckwert,Julija Zavadlav*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出粗粒化玻尔兹曼生成器（CG-BGs），将基于流的生成模型与重要性采样相结合，在粗粒化坐标空间中实现平衡分子构象采样，通过增强采样力匹配学习平均力势（PMF），显著降低计算成本并捕获溶剂介导的相互作用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统玻尔兹曼生成器（BGs）可结合精确似然生成模型与重要性采样从玻尔兹曼分布中采样，但实际可扩展性有限；而粗粒化代理虽能通过降维建模更大系统，但缺乏确保渐进正确统计量的重加权过程。因此，本文旨在提出一种既能降维又能保证统计正确性的框架。

Method: 提出粗粒化玻尔兹曼生成器（CG-BGs）框架：在粗粒化坐标空间中，使用基于流的生成模型生成样本，并通过学习得到的平均力势（PMF）对样本进行重加权；PMF通过增强采样力匹配方法从快速收敛的轨迹中学习。

Result: 实验表明，CG-BGs能够在高度简化的表示中捕获溶剂介导的相互作用，同时相比原子级BGs显著降低计算成本，为更大分子系统的平衡采样提供了实用途径。

Conclusion: CG-BGs有效结合了粗粒化建模的降维优势与重要性采样的统计保证，实现了高效且渐进正确的平衡分子构象采样，提升了玻尔兹曼生成器的可扩展性。

Abstract: Sampling equilibrium molecular configurations from the Boltzmann distribution is a longstanding challenge. Boltzmann Generators (BGs) address this by combining exact-likelihood generative models with importance sampling, but practical scalability is limited. Meanwhile, coarse-grained surrogates enable the modeling of larger systems by reducing effective dimensionality, yet often lack a reweighting procedure required to ensure asymptotically correct statistics. In this work, we propose Coarse-Grained Boltzmann Generators (CG-BGs), a framework for reduced-order generative modeling with importance sampling in coarse-grained coordinate space. CG-BGs generate samples using a flow-based model and reweight them using a learned potential of mean force (PMF). We show that the PMF can be learned from rapidly converged trajectories via enhanced sampling force matching. Experiments demonstrate that CG-BGs capture solvent-mediated interactions in highly reduced representations while substantially reducing computational cost relative to atomistic BGs, providing a practical route toward equilibrium sampling of larger molecular systems.

</details>


### [477] [Collaborative Threshold Watermarking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.10765)
*Tameem Bakr,Anish Ambreth,Nils Lukas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种(t,K)-门限水印方法，让K个客户端在联邦学习中协同嵌入共享水印，只有至少t个客户端组成的联盟才能重建水印密钥并验证模型，解决了客户端数量增加时水印稀释和单个客户端可独立验证并移除水印的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习中多个客户端联合训练模型，需要机制来证明模型的出处（provenance）。现有水印方法存在两个问题：一是每客户端独立水印随K增大而稀释；二是单个客户端可独立验证并可能移除水印。

Method: 使用秘密共享（secret-sharing）将水印密钥τ分割，使得少于t个客户端无法重建密钥；通过协作训练嵌入共享水印；验证过程不暴露τ明文。在白盒设置下实现，在图像分类（IID和非IID分区）以及语言模型微调上评估。

Result: 在K=128规模下仍可检测水印，精度损失极小；在包括自适应微调（使用最多20%训练数据）的攻击下，检测z值仍≥4，高于检测阈值。

Conclusion: 该方法有效解决了联邦学习中的模型溯源问题，支持可扩展的协作水印嵌入与门限验证，且对多种攻击具有鲁棒性。

Abstract: In federated learning (FL), $K$ clients jointly train a model without sharing raw data. Because each participant invests data and compute, clients need mechanisms to later prove the provenance of a jointly trained model. Model watermarking embeds a hidden signal in the weights, but naive approaches either do not scale with many clients as per-client watermarks dilute as $K$ grows, or give any individual client the ability to verify and potentially remove the watermark. We introduce $(t,K)$-threshold watermarking: clients collaboratively embed a shared watermark during training, while only coalitions of at least $t$ clients can reconstruct the watermark key and verify a suspect model. We secret-share the watermark key $τ$ so that coalitions of fewer than $t$ clients cannot reconstruct it, and verification can be performed without revealing $τ$ in the clear. We instantiate our protocol in the white-box setting and evaluate it on image classification tasks on both IID and non-IID partitions, as well as language models fine-tuning setting. Our watermark remains detectable at scale ($K=128$) with minimal accuracy loss and stays above the detection threshold ($z\ge 4$) under attacks including adaptive fine-tuning using up to 20% of the training data. Code is available at https://github.com/tameemalaa/collaborative-threshold-watermark.

</details>


### [478] [Size Transferability of Graph Transformers with Convolutional Positional Encodings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.15239)
*Javier Porras-Valenzuela,Zhiyang Wang,Xiaotao Shang,Yusu Wang,Alejandro Ribeiro*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从图序列流形极限模型的视角，建立了带有GNN位置编码的图Transformer（GT）与流形神经网络（MNN）之间的理论联系，证明了GT继承了GNN的可迁移性保证，即在小图上训练的GT可以在温和假设下泛化到大图，并通过实验验证了GT的可扩展性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图Transformer作为基于注意力机制的图结构数据架构取得了显著成功，但其在不同规模图上的泛化能力缺乏理论理解。现有研究多关注GNN的可迁移性，而GT是否具有类似的性质仍不清楚。

Method: 通过流形极限模型将GT与MNN建立理论联系，利用GNN在流形收敛下的可迁移性结果，证明GT的泛化边界由其GNN位置编码的可迁移性决定。理论分析后辅以标准图基准实验及地形最短路径距离估计的实际应用验证。

Result: GT继承了GNN位置编码的可迁移性保证，在温和假设下小图上训练的GT可泛化到大图。实验表明GT在标准图基准上表现出与GNN相当的可扩展性，在地形最短路径距离估计任务中验证了可迁移GT的效率。

Conclusion: 该工作为理解GT的跨规模泛化能力提供了新理论视角，并为大规模场景下高效训练GT提供了实用指导方向。

Abstract: Transformers have achieved remarkable success across domains, motivating the rise of Graph Transformers (GTs) as attention-based architectures for graph-structured data. A key design choice in GTs is the use of Graph Neural Network (GNN)-based positional encodings to incorporate structural information. In this work, we study GTs through the lens of manifold limit models for graph sequences and establish a theoretical connection between GTs with GNN positional encodings and Manifold Neural Networks (MNNs). Building on transferability results for GNNs under manifold convergence, we show that GTs inherit transferability guarantees from their positional encodings. In particular, GTs trained on small graphs provably generalize to larger graphs under mild assumptions. We complement our theory with extensive experiments on standard graph benchmarks, demonstrating that GTs exhibit scalable behavior on par with GNNs. To further show the efficiency in a real-world scenario, we implement GTs for shortest path distance estimation over terrains to better illustrate the efficiency of the transferable GTs. Our results provide new insights into the understanding of GTs and suggest practical directions for efficient training of GTs in large-scale settings.

</details>


### [479] [GICDM: Mitigating Hubness for Reliable Distance-Based Generative Model Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.16449)
*Nicolas Salvy,Hugues Talbot,Bertrand Thirion*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 生成模型评估受高维嵌入中的枢纽现象影响，导致距离度量偏差。本文提出GICDM方法修正邻域估计，消除枢纽偏差并恢复可靠度量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高维嵌入空间中的枢纽现象扭曲了最近邻关系，使基于距离的生成模型评估指标产生偏差，现有方法未能有效解决此问题。

Method: 基于经典ICDM提出生成式ICDM（GICDM），对真实数据和生成数据进行邻域估计修正，并引入多尺度扩展以改善经验行为。

Result: 在合成和真实基准上的广泛实验表明，GICDM解决了枢纽现象导致的评估失效，恢复了可靠的度量行为，并与人类评估的对齐度得到提升。

Conclusion: GICDM有效消除了枢纽现象对生成模型评估的负面影响，为距离度量提供了更稳健的替代方案。

Abstract: Generative model evaluation commonly relies on high-dimensional embedding spaces to compute distances between samples. We show that dataset representations in these spaces are affected by the hubness phenomenon, which distorts nearest-neighbor relationships and biases distance-based metrics. Building on the classical Iterative Contextual Dissimilarity Measure (ICDM), we introduce Generative ICDM (GICDM), a method to correct neighborhood estimation for both real and generated data. We introduce a multi-scale extension to improve empirical behavior. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real benchmarks demonstrate that GICDM resolves hubness-induced failures, restores reliable metric behavior, and improves alignment with human assessment.

</details>


### [480] [RAT+: Train Dense, Infer Sparse -- Recurrence Augmented Attention for Dilated Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.18196)
*Xiuying Wei,Caglar Gulcehre*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: RAT+是一种密集预训练架构，通过在注意力中增强全序列递归和主动递归学习，使得单个模型在推理时可灵活切换为不同膨胀率的稀疏注意力模式（如膨胀注意力、局部窗口、混合层/头组合），无需为每种配置重新训练。在1.5B参数规模下，D=16时接近密集精度，D=64时仅下降2-3个百分点；在更大规模（2.6B和7.6B）上表现更优，可实现64倍注意力FLOPs和KV缓存压缩下仅1个点的精度损失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的结构化膨胀注意力虽能通过膨胀因子D降低计算量和KV缓存大小，但之前的工作需要为每种配置从头训练；直接对预训练密集模型进行稀疏化会导致严重精度下降，无法灵活复用。因此需要一种能灵活切换推理时稀疏模式的密集预训练架构。

Method: RAT+架构在注意力中增强全序列递归（full-sequence recurrence）和主动递归学习（active recurrence learning）。模型先进行密集预训练，然后在推理时通过短时间（1B token）的分辨率适应（resolution adaptation），即可灵活切换到膨胀注意力（可选局部窗口）或混合层/头组合。

Result: 1.5B参数模型在100B token上训练后，D=16时接近密集精度，D=64时在常识推理和LongBench任务上仅下降2-3个百分点。扩展到2.6B和7.6B参数时表现更优，64倍注意力FLOPs和KV缓存压缩下平均精度损失仅1个百分点。

Conclusion: RAT+实现了单个密集预训练模型在推理时灵活切换不同稀疏注意力模式，大幅降低计算和存储开销的同时保持精度，为高效推理部署提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Structured dilated attention has an appealing inference-time efficiency knob: it reduces the FLOPs of attention and the KV cache size by a factor of the dilation size D, while preserving long-range connectivity. While prior work studies it by training each configuration from scratch, directly sparsifying a pretrained attention model into a dilated pattern leads to severe accuracy degradation, preventing flexible reuse across inference scenarios. We introduce RAT+, a dense-pretraining architecture that augments attention with full-sequence recurrence and active recurrence learning. A single RAT+ model is pretrained densely once and can then be flexibly switched at inference time to dilated attention (optionally with local windows) or hybrid layer/head compositions, requiring only a short 1B-token resolution adaptation rather than retraining separate sparse models. At 1.5B parameters trained on 100B tokens, RAT+ closely matches dense accuracy at D = 16, and drops by about 2-3 points at D = 64 on commonsense reasoning and LongBench tasks. We further scale to 2.6B and 7.6B parameters and observe even more promising performance (e.g., a 1-point average accuracy loss with a 64x reduction in attention FLOPs and KV cache size). Code is available at https://github.com/wimh966/rat-plus.

</details>


### [481] [Is Your Diffusion Sampler Actually Correct? A Sampler-Centric Evaluation of Discrete Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.19619)
*Luhan Tang,Longxuan Yu,Shaorong Zhang,Greg Ver Steeg*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 离散扩散语言模型（dLLMs）的评估存在根本性问题：现有指标混淆了去噪器近似误差与采样动力学引入的误差。通过引入基于Oracle的框架，作者证明即使使用理想去噪器，少数步的离散扩散采样器也无法实现分布正确性，且负对数似然、生成困惑度或MAUVE等指标的改善并不意味着采样正确。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离散扩散语言模型的评估面临挑战：现有指标将去噪器近似误差与采样动力学引入的误差混为一谈，这一问题在自回归模型中不会出现，因为其自回归采样精确反映了学得的概率模型。需要一种能隔离采样器引入误差的评估框架。

Method: 提出一种以采样器为中心的Oracle框架：用精确的隐马尔可夫模型后验（从真实马尔可夫链导出）替代学得的去噪器，从而在受控设置中隔离采样器引入的误差。

Result: 即使使用Oracle去噪器，少数步离散扩散采样器在分布上仍不正确，存在转移级别的不匹配，这种不匹配只有在步数接近序列长度时才会消失。此外，负对数似然、生成困惑度或MAUVE等指标的改善并不意味着采样是正确的。

Conclusion: 现有离散扩散语言模型的评估指标无法反映采样器的真实分布正确性，需要开发更合适的评估方法。

Abstract: Discrete diffusion language models (dLLMs) provide a fast and flexible alternative to autoregressive models (ARMs) via iterative denoising with parallel updates. However, their evaluation is challenging: existing metrics conflate denoiser approximation error with sampler-induced error from the sampling dynamics, a problem that does not arise for ARMs whose autoregressive sampling exactly reflects the learned probability model. We introduce a sampler-centric oracle framework that replaces learned denoisers with an exact Hidden Markov Model posterior derived from a ground-truth Markov chain, isolating sampler-induced error in a controlled setting. We show that few-step discrete diffusion samplers are not distributionally correct even under an oracle denoiser, with transition-level mismatch that vanishes only as the number of steps approaches the sequence length. Moreover, improvements in negative log-likelihood (NLL), generative perplexity (GenPPL), or MAUVE do not imply correct sampling. Code is available at https://luhantang.github.io/dllm_sampler

</details>


### [482] [Routing by Reaching: Composition of Pre-trained GFlowNets for Multi-Objective Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.21565)
*Seokwon Yoon,Youngbin Choi,Seunghyuk Cho,Seungbeom Lee,MoonJeong Park,Dongwoo Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种在推理时组合预训练GFlowNets的框架，无需重新训练即可适应多目标奖励组合，涵盖线性和非线性算子，并理论证明了线性情况下的精确性及非线性情况下的近似质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有GFlowNets在多目标设置下需要为每个目标组合联合训练，目标集变更时必须从头重新训练，缺乏灵活性和可组合性。

Method: 提出推理时组合预训练GFlowNets的框架，支持从线性标量化到复杂非线性算子的多种奖励组合方式，并引入了非线性算子的失真因子来量化近似质量。

Result: 在合成2D网格和真实分子生成任务上，该方法达到了与基线相当的性能。

Conclusion: 该方法能够在不微调或重训的情况下快速适应新的多目标组合，为GFlowNets在多目标场景下的灵活部署提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets) learn to sample diverse candidates in proportion to a reward function, making them well-suited for scientific discovery, where exploring multiple promising solutions is crucial. Further extending GFlowNets to multi-objective settings has attracted growing interest as real-world applications often involve multiple, conflicting objectives. However, existing approaches require joint training for each combination of objectives, meaning that any change in the objective set necessitates retraining from scratch. We propose a framework that composes pre-trained GFlowNets at inference time, enabling rapid adaptation without fine-tuning or retraining. Importantly, our framework is flexible, capable of handling diverse reward combinations ranging from linear scalarization to complex nonlinear operators, which are often handled separately in previous literature. We prove that our method exactly recovers the target distribution for linear scalarization, and quantify the approximation quality for nonlinear operators through a distortion factor. Experiments on a synthetic 2D grid and real-world molecule generation tasks demonstrate that our approach achieves performance comparable to baselines.

</details>


### [483] [Improving Full Waveform Inversion in Large Model Era](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.00377)
*Yinan Feng,Peng Jin,Yuzhe Guo,Yinpeng Chen,Youzuo Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明，通过协调扩展模型容量、数据多样性和训练策略三个维度，一个完全在简单合成数据上训练的十亿参数模型能够显著泛化到复杂、未见过的地质结构，在OpenFWI和多个真实地质基准上取得最优性能（SSIM从0.5844提升至0.7669），大幅缩小了数据驱动全波形反演的泛化差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有数据驱动的全波形反演方法受限于数据集规模小、地质多样性不足和空间范围有限，导致模型过拟合严重，在合成数据上表现良好但无法泛化到更真实的地质结构，亟需一种能实现跨复杂地质结构泛化的解决方案。

Method: 提出了一种三轴协调扩展策略：(1) 模型容量：采用十亿参数级的大模型；(2) 数据多样性：在模拟的简单合成数据上进行训练；(3) 训练策略：协调优化训练过程。模型完全在合成简单数据上训练，不接触目标复杂地质数据。

Result: 在OpenFWI上达到最优性能；在Marmousi、2D SEG/EAGE Salt、Overthrust、2004 BP、Sigsbee和SEAM Phase I六个挑战性地球物理基准上，SSIM从0.5844提升至0.7669，成功推断出训练集中不存在的复杂结构。

Conclusion: 通过恰当的扩展策略，在简单合成数据上训练的大模型能够实现对更复杂、更真实地质结构的显著泛化能力，有效缩小了数据驱动FWI的泛化差距。

Abstract: Full Waveform Inversion (FWI) is a highly nonlinear and ill-posed problem that aims to recover subsurface velocity maps from surface-recorded seismic waveforms data. Existing data-driven FWI typically uses small models, as available datasets have limited volume, geological diversity, and spatial extent, leading to substantial concerns about overfitting. Although they perform well on synthetic datasets, current methods fail to generalize to more realistic geological structures. In this work, we show that a model trained entirely on simulated and relatively simple data can generalize remarkably well to challenging and unseen geological benchmarks. We provide a working recipe that tames a billion-parameter model for FWI through coordinated scaling across three axes: model capacity, data diversity, and training strategy. Our model achieves state-of-the-art performance on OpenFWI and significantly narrows the generalization gap in data-driven FWI. Across six challenging geophysical benchmarks, including Marmousi, 2D SEG/EAGE Salt and Overthrust, 2004 BP, Sigsbee, and SEAM Phase I, it infers complex structures absent from the training set and delivers significant performance improvements (SSIM from 0.5844 to 0.7669). Overall, our results demonstrate that with an appropriate scaling strategy, large models trained on simple synthetic data can achieve substantial generalization to more complex and realistic geological structures.

</details>


### [484] [Rooted Absorbed Prefix Trajectory Balance with Submodular Replay for GFlowNet Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.00454)
*Xi Wang,Wenbo Lu,Shengjie Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出RapTB（根吸收前缀轨迹平衡）目标函数和SubM（子模重放刷新）策略，解决GFlowNets微调大语言模型时的模式坍塌问题（前缀崩溃和长度偏差），在分子生成任务中提升了优化性能和多样性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GFlowNets在微调LLM时容易出现模式坍塌（前缀崩溃和长度偏差），原因是：(i) 早期前缀的信用分配薄弱，(ii) 有偏重放导致训练流分布偏移且不具代表性。

Method: 提出RapTB（根吸收前缀轨迹平衡），在根节点锚定子轨迹监督，通过吸收后缀备份将终端奖励传播到中间前缀，提供密集的前缀级学习信号；提出SubM（子模重放刷新），通过子模最大化策略同时促进高奖励和多样性，缓解重放引起的分布偏移。

Result: 在基于SMILES字符串的分子生成任务中，RapTB结合SubM在优化性能和分子多样性上持续提升，同时保持高有效性。

Conclusion: RapTB和SubM有效缓解了GFlowNets微调LLM时的模式坍塌问题，为前缀级信用分配和重放分布偏移提供了可行解决方案。

Abstract: Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets) enable fine-tuning large language models to approximate reward-proportional posteriors, but they remain prone to mode collapse, manifesting as prefix collapse and length bias. We attribute this to two factors: (i) weak credit assignment to early prefixes, and (ii) biased replay that induces a shifted, non-representative training flow distribution. We propose Rooted absorbed prefix Trajectory Balance RapTB, an objective that anchors subtrajectory supervision at the root and propagates terminal rewards to intermediate prefixes via absorbed suffix-based backups, providing dense prefix-level learning signals. To mitigate replay-induced distribution shift, we further introduce SubM, a submodular replay refresh strategy that promotes both high reward and diversity. Empirically, on tasks such as molecule generation with LLM using SMILES strings, RapTB combined with SubM consistently improves optimization performance and molecular diversity while preserving high validity.

</details>


### [485] [Relational In-Context Learning via Synthetic Pre-training with Structural Prior](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.03805)
*Yanbo Wang,Jiaxuan You,Chuan Shi,Muhan Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出RDB-PFN，首个完全基于合成数据训练的关系型基础模型。通过关系先验生成器从零构造多样化关系数据库，在200多万个合成任务上预训练后，模型可通过上下文学习直接适应任意新数据库。在19个真实关系预测任务上，RDB-PFN以轻量架构和快速推理超越现有表格基础模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 关系数据库缺乏像文本和视觉领域那样的基础模型，主要障碍在于高质量关系数据库私有、稀缺且结构异构，无法进行互联网规模预训练。为克服数据稀缺问题，提出完全基于合成数据训练的关系基础模型。

Method: 受Prior-Data Fitted Networks (PFNs)启发（使用结构因果模型生成合成数据实现单表推理），设计关系先验生成器(Relational Prior Generator)从零创建无限多样的关系数据库流。在超过200万个合成单表和多表关系任务上预训练，使模型能通过真正的上下文学习适应任意新数据库。

Result: 在19个真实世界关系预测任务上达到强少样本性能，在相同DFS线性化输入上超越现有最先进的表格基础模型，同时使用轻量级架构并实现快速推理。

Conclusion: RDB-PFN证明了完全通过合成数据训练关系基础模型的可行性，为关系数据库领域的基础模型研究开辟了新路径，且代码已开源。

Abstract: Relational Databases (RDBs) are the backbone of modern business, yet they lack foundation models comparable to those in text or vision. A key obstacle is that high-quality RDBs are private, scarce, and structurally heterogeneous, making internet-scale pre-training infeasible. To overcome this data scarcity, we introduce RDB-PFN, the first relational foundation model trained purely via synthetic data. Inspired by Prior-Data Fitted Networks (PFNs), where synthetic data generated from Structural Causal Models (SCMs) enables reasoning on single tables, we design a Relational Prior Generator to create an infinite stream of diverse RDBs from scratch. Pre-training on over 2 million synthetic single-table and relational tasks, RDB-PFN learns to adapt to any new database instantly via genuine in-context learning. Experiments show that RDB-PFN achieves strong few-shot performance on 19 real-world relational prediction tasks, outperforming state-of-the-art tabular foundation models evaluated on the same DFS-linearized inputs, while using a lightweight architecture and fast inference. The code is available at https://github.com/MuLabPKU/RDBPFN.

</details>


### [486] [Non-Euclidean Gradient Descent Operates at the Edge of Stability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.05002)
*Rustem Islamov,Michael Crawshaw,Jeremy Cohen,Robert Gower*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过方向光滑性（Directional Smoothness）将边缘稳定性（EoS）现象推广到非欧几里得范数下的梯度下降方法，定义了广义锐度，并通过实验证明非欧几里得GD同样表现出渐进锐化及阈值振荡，为广泛梯度方法提供了几何感知的谱诊断工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 边缘稳定性（EoS）在深度学习中广泛存在，但其理论基础尚不完整，且现有研究主要局限于欧几里得范数下的标准梯度下降，缺乏对非欧几里得梯度方法的EoS分析。

Method: 基于方向光滑性（Directional Smoothness）框架，将EoS解释推广到任意范数下的非欧几里得GD，定义广义锐度；通过实验验证非欧几里得GD（如ℓ∞-descent、Block CD、Spectral GD及其归一化版本）中的EoS现象。

Result: 非欧几里得GD在广义锐度下同样表现出渐进锐化（progressive sharpening）以及锐度在阈值2/η附近或之上的振荡；该方法统一了标准GD和预条件GD等已有特例。

Conclusion: 本文为EoS现象提供了更通用的理论解释，并将谱诊断工具扩展到非欧几里得梯度方法家族，具有实践意义。

Abstract: The Edge of Stability (EoS) is a phenomenon where the sharpness (largest eigenvalue) of the Hessian approaches and then hovers near the stability threshold $2/η$ during gradient descent (GD) with step size $η$. Despite (apparently) violating classical smoothness assumptions, EoS has been widely observed in deep learning, but its theoretical foundations remain incomplete. We provide an interpretation of EoS through the lens of Directional Smoothness [Mishkin et al., 2024]. This interpretation naturally extends to non-Euclidean norms, which we use to define generalized sharpness under an arbitrary norm. Our generalized sharpness measure includes previously studied vanilla GD and preconditioned GD as special cases, as well as methods for which EoS has not been studied, such as $\ell_{\infty}$-descent, Block CD, Spectral GD, and their normalized versions. Through experiments on neural networks, we show that non-Euclidean GD with our generalized sharpness also exhibits progressive sharpening followed by oscillations around or above the threshold $2/η$. Practically, our framework provides a geometry-aware spectral diagnostic that can be applied across a broad class of non-Euclidean gradient methods.

</details>


### [487] [Sparse Scheduled Diffusion Guidance for Inverse Problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.07860)
*Abduragim Shtanchaev,Albina Ilina,Yazid Janati,Arip Asadulaev,Martin Takac,Eric Moulines*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Spin提出了一种稀疏调度引导扩散逆问题求解方法，通过从中等时间步后验边际采样启动，并仅在调度的时间步施加轻量级像素空间校正，无需通过去噪器反向传播，实现了在FFHQ和ImageNet上2倍到50倍的加速，同时降低内存开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有扩散模型作为贝叶斯逆问题先验时，后验采样成本高昂，因为数据一致性引导需要在完整的反向轨迹中密集应用；现有方法虽避免了向量-雅可比积，但仍依赖密集引导或昂贵的内循环求解。

Method: Spin首先在中间时间步t_*处从后验时间边际分布采样，以此作为引导反向扩散过程的暖启动；引导阶段仅在调度的时间步施加轻量级像素空间校正，无需通过去噪器或解码器反向传播，从而将先验细化与数据一致性解耦。

Result: 在线性和非线性逆问题上，Spin在FFHQ和ImageNet数据集上实现了与现有方法竞争的重建质量，同时在像素空间模型上快2倍，在潜在扩散模型上快50倍，且内存开销更低。

Conclusion: 通过解耦先验细化与数据一致性，Spin显著降低了后验采样的计算和内存成本，实现了高效高质量的逆问题求解。

Abstract: Pretrained diffusion models are effective priors for Bayesian inverse problems, but posterior sampling with these priors is often costly because data-consistency guidance is applied throughout the full reverse trajectory. Existing methods have shown that vector-Jacobian products through the denoiser can sometimes be avoided, yet they typically still rely on dense guidance through the full trajectory or expensive inner solves. We introduce Sparse Scheduled Diffusion Guidance for Inverse Problems (Spin), a solver that avoids starting posterior sampling from pure noise. Spin first samples from a posterior time-marginal at an intermediate timestep $t_*$, and then uses that state as a warm start for a guided reverse diffusion process. At guidance time, instead of enforcing the measurement constraint at every denoising step, Spin applies lightweight corrections only at scheduled timesteps where the denoiser can still clean up artifacts. The resulting procedure decouples prior refinement from data consistency: the prior supplies denoising, while lightweight pixel-space optimization enforces the measurement constraint without backpropagation through the denoiser or decoder. Across linear and nonlinear inverse problems on FFHQ and ImageNet, Spin achieves competitive reconstruction quality with a substantially better runtime--memory profile, running 2x faster on pixel-space models and up to 50x faster on latent diffusion models, with lower memory costs.

</details>


### [488] [Muscle Synergy Priors Enhance Biomechanical Fidelity in Predictive Musculoskeletal Locomotion Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.10474)
*Ilseung Park,Eunsik Choi,Jangwhan Ahn,Jooeun Ahn*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种生理启发的强化学习框架，通过肌肉协同约束（低维协同基作为动作空间）实现三维肌肉骨骼模型的预测性行走仿真，在0.7-1.8 m/s速度和±6°坡度及不平坦地形上生成稳定步态，相比无约束控制减少了非生理性膝关节运动，地面反作用力与实验数据高度相关，肌肉激活时序在个体间变异范围内。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人体运动源于高维神经肌肉控制，使得预测性肌肉骨骼仿真极具挑战性，需要一种能够结合神经生理结构的方法来提升仿真生物力学 fidelity 和泛化能力。

Method: 从少量地面行走 trials 的逆肌肉骨骼分析中提取低维协同基，将其作为强化学习的动作空间，训练一个肌肉驱动的三维模型在变速度、坡度和不平坦地形上行走。

Result: 协同约束控制器在0.7-1.8 m/s和±6°坡度上生成稳定步态，减少了非生理性膝关节运动，关节力矩在实验范围内，地面反作用力与实测强相关，肌肉激活时序在个体间变异范围内。

Conclusion: 将神经生理结构嵌入强化学习可以在有限实验数据下提高预测性人体运动仿真的生物力学保真度和泛化能力。

Abstract: Human locomotion emerges from high-dimensional neuromuscular control, making predictive musculoskeletal simulation challenging. We present a physiology-informed reinforcement-learning framework that constrains control using muscle synergies. We extracted a low-dimensional synergy basis from inverse musculoskeletal analyses of a small set of overground walking trials and used it as the action space for a muscle-driven three-dimensional model trained across variable speeds, slopes and uneven terrain. The resulting controller generated stable gait from 0.7-1.8 m/s and on $\pm$ 6$^{\circ}$ grades and reproduced condition-dependent modulation of joint angles, joint moments and ground reaction forces. Compared with an unconstrained controller, synergy-constrained control reduced non-physiological knee kinematics and kept knee moment profiles within the experimental envelope. Across conditions, simulated vertical ground reaction forces correlated strongly with human measurements, and muscle-activation timing largely fell within inter-subject variability. These results show that embedding neurophysiological structure into reinforcement learning can improve biomechanical fidelity and generalization in predictive human locomotion simulation with limited experimental data.

</details>


### [489] [Jailbreak Scaling Laws for Large Language Models: Polynomial-Exponential Crossover](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.11331)
*Indranil Halder,Annesya Banerjee,Cengiz Pehlevan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现，对抗性提示注入攻击可使大语言模型的安全攻击成功率从无注入时的多项式增长转变为指数增长（随推理采样次数增加）。作者通过自旋玻璃理论模型解释这一现象：短注入对应弱磁场产生幂律缩放，长注入对应强磁场产生指数缩放。在3B-70B参数规模的多模型、多攻击方法（GCG/AutoDAN）和多基准（AdvBench/HarmBench）上观察到一致性行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 揭示对抗性提示注入攻击如何影响安全对齐大语言模型的行为，特别是攻击成功率随推理采样次数增长的缩放规律从多项式变为指数的机制。

Method: 先通过少量假设建立两种缩放律的统计机制，再提出基于自旋玻璃系统的理论生成模型（副本对称破缺机制），将不安全生成定义为低能、大小偏倚的簇，通过注入提示的磁场强度（短/长注入）解释幂律与指数缩放的转变。实验在3B-70B模型上验证GCG和AutoDAN等方法在AdvBench和HarmBench上的表现。

Result: 短注入（弱磁场）下攻击成功率随样本数呈幂律缩放，长注入（强磁场）下呈指数缩放；该趋势在3B-70B参数规模的多种LLM、不同攻击方法和基准数据集上均稳定一致。

Conclusion: 对抗性提示注入攻击的缩放行为可由自旋玻璃理论统一解释，为理解LLM安全漏洞的统计机制提供了理论基础。

Abstract: Adversarial attacks can reliably steer safety-aligned large language models toward unsafe behavior. Empirically, we find that adversarial prompt-injection attacks can amplify attack success rate from the slow polynomial growth observed without injection to exponential growth with the number of inference-time samples. We first identify a minimal statistical mechanism for these two regimes by giving a small set of assumptions on the distribution of safe generation across contexts under which both scaling laws follow. To explain this phenomenon further, we propose a theoretical generative model of proxy language in terms of a spin-glass system operating in a replica-symmetry-breaking regime, where generations are drawn from the associated Gibbs measure and a subset of low-energy, size-biased clusters is designated unsafe. We analytically show how this model naturally realizes the minimal assumptions. Short injected prompts correspond to a weak magnetic field aligned towards unsafe cluster centers and yield a power-law scaling of attack success rate with the number of inference-time samples, while long injected prompts, i.e., strong magnetic field, yield exponential scaling. We observe qualitatively consistent behavior across a broad range of large language models, spanning parameter scales from 3B to 70B. In particular, the main trends remain stable across multiple attack methods, such as GCG and AutoDAN, as well as across benchmark datasets such as AdvBench and HarmBench.

</details>


### [490] [Enhancing LLM Training via Spectral Clipping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.14315)
*Xiaowen Jiang,Andrei Semenov,Sebastian U. Stich*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SPECTRA框架，通过对更新进行谱后裁剪（约束谱范数）和对梯度进行谱前裁剪（抑制噪声尖峰），改善大语言模型训练中的稳定性和泛化性。实验表明该框架能统一提升AdamW、Signum、Mars、AdEMAMix等多种优化器的验证损失，达到最优结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准自适应优化器（如AdamW）未考虑权重和梯度的谱结构，导致两个问题：(i) 优化器更新的谱范数过大，可能破坏训练稳定性并损害泛化；(ii) 随机梯度噪声存在稀疏的谱尖峰，少数奇异值远大于其余部分。

Method: 提出SPECTRA框架，包含两个核心组件：(i) 后谱裁剪（post-spectral clipping）：对优化器更新施加谱范数约束；(ii) 前谱裁剪（pre-spectral clipping）：对梯度进行预处理以抑制稀疏谱噪声尖峰。采用Newton-Schulz迭代实现高效的软谱裁剪，避免昂贵的SVD分解。

Result: 在大语言模型预训练实验中，SPECTRA统一提升了AdamW、Signum、Mars、AdEMAMix等多种优化器的验证损失，最佳变体达到最优结果。训练后的模型权重范数更小，证实了谱裁剪与正则化之间的关联。

Conclusion: 后谱裁剪可被证明是一种具有谱范数约束和权重正则化的Composite Frank-Wolfe方法；前谱裁剪能有效缓解稀疏谱尖峰问题。SPECTRA提供了一种通用的、计算高效的谱感知优化框架。

Abstract: While spectral-based optimizers like Muon operate directly on the spectrum of updates, standard adaptive methods such as AdamW do not account for the spectral structure of weights and gradients, leaving them vulnerable to two empirical issues in large language model (LLM) training: (i) the optimizer updates can have large spectral norms, potentially destabilizing training and degrading generalization; (ii) stochastic gradient noise can exhibit sparse spectral spikes, with a few dominant singular values much larger than the rest. We propose SPECTRA, a general framework addressing these by (i) post-spectral clipping of updates to enforce spectral-norm constraints (ii) optional pre-spectral clipping of gradients to suppress spectral noise spikes. We prove that post-clipping constitutes a Composite Frank-Wolfe method with spectral-norm constraints and weight regularization. We further analyze how pre-clipping mitigates sparse spectral spikes. We propose efficient soft spectral clipping via Newton-Schulz iterations, avoiding expensive SVD. Experiments on LLM pretraining show SPECTRA uniformly improves validation loss for various optimizers, including AdamW, Signum, Mars, and AdEMAMix, with the best-performing variants achieving state-of-the-art results. Models trained with SPECTRA exhibit smaller weight norms, confirming the link between spectral clipping and regularization.

</details>


### [491] [Maximizing Mutual Information Between Prompt and Response Improves LLM Performance With No Additional Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.19294)
*Hyunji Nam,Haoran Li,Natasha Jaques*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出互信息偏好优化（MIPO）方法，通过对比数据增强构建偏好对（基于正确提示生成正样本、基于无关提示生成负样本），利用直接偏好优化最大化提示与响应的点互信息。在1-7B参数的Llama和Qwen模型上，MIPO在个性化任务上提升3-51%，在数学和多项选择题等可验证领域无需额外数据即可提升1-20%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的后训练方法严重依赖人工标注数据或外部验证器，已有数据已被充分利用，新数据收集成本高昂，且真正的智能远超可验证任务范畴。因此需要一种对外部信号依赖更少、能广泛适用于可验证和不可验证领域的自我提升框架。

Method: 提出MIPO（互信息偏好优化），一种对比数据增强方法：通过条件于正确提示生成正样本响应，条件于随机无关提示生成负样本响应，构建偏好对；然后使用直接偏好优化（DPO）学习该配对数据，从而最大化基础LLM下提示与响应的点互信息（PMI）。

Result: 在1-7B参数的Llama和Qwen指令模型上，个性化任务相对提示基线提升3-16%（Qwen2.5-1B-Instruct提升51%）；在数学和多项选择题等可验证领域，无需额外数据或外部监督即可带来1-20%的性能提升。

Conclusion: MIPO为自我提升提供了一条有前景的方向——利用对比数据对中衍生的内在信号，减少对外部标注的依赖，同时适用于可验证和不可验证领域。

Abstract: While post-training has successfully improved large language models (LLMs) across a variety of domains, these gains heavily rely on human-labeled data or external verifiers. Existing data has already been exploited, and new data is expensive to collect. Moreover, true intelligence goes far beyond verifiable tasks. Therefore, we need self-improvement frameworks that are less dependent on external signals and more broadly applicable to both verifiable and non-verifiable domains. We propose **Mutual Information Preference Optimization (MIPO)**, a contrastive data augmentation method that constructs preference pairs by generating a positive response conditioning on the correct prompt, and a negative response by conditioning on a random, unrelated prompt. We show that using Direct Preference Optimization to learn from this paired data maximizes pointwise mutual information *under the base LLM* between prompts and model responses. Experiments with with 1-7B parameter Llama and Qwen instruct models show that MIPO achieves 3-16% gains (and 51% increase for Qwen2.5-1B-Instruct) on personalization compared to prompting baselines. Surprisingly, MIPO can also be useful in verifiable domains, such as math and multiple-choice question answering, yielding 1-20% gains *without any additional data or external supervision*. These results suggest a promising direction for self-improvement using intrinsic signals derived from contrastive data pairs.

</details>


### [492] [Path-Space Mirror Descent for On-Policy Reinforcement Learning under the Generalized Schrödinger Bridge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.21621)
*Yuehu Gong,Zeyuan Wang,Yulin Chen,Shutong Ding,Qingyuan Zhou,Yanwei Fu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了GSB-MDPO方法，通过将基于策略的生成策略优化形式化为广义薛定谔桥问题，利用路径空间KL散度作为近端项，解决了扩散/流模型策略与基于似然的近端更新之间的不匹配问题，在连续控制任务上验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典on-policy算法（如PPO）使用高斯策略表达力有限，而扩散/流模型生成策略具有更强表达力但其终态动作密度通常不可计算，导致与基于似然的on-policy近端更新不匹配。

Method: 将on-policy生成策略优化形式化为广义薛定谔桥（GSB）问题，通过镜像下降策略优化（MDPO）实例化路径测度更新；利用GSB路径空间KL散度作为MDPO中的近端项，同时上界约束终态动作KL散度。

Result: 在Playground和Gym-MuJoCo的14个连续控制任务上验证了GSB-MDPO的有效性，支持路径空间正则化作为多步生成策略的合理近端更新。

Conclusion: 路径空间正则化可作为一种原则性的近端更新方法用于多步生成策略，无需显式计算终态动作似然，有效弥合了生成策略与on-policy近端更新之间的鸿沟。

Abstract: Classical on-policy algorithms such as PPO and mirror descent policy optimization provide stable proximal policy updates through tractable action likelihoods, but are typically instantiated with simple Gaussian policies whose expressiveness can be limited in complex continuous-control tasks. Generative policies based on diffusion and flow models provide more expressive action distributions, but they naturally define distributions over multi-step denoising paths whose terminal action density is often intractable, creating a mismatch with likelihood-based on-policy proximal updates. To address this mismatch, we introduce \textbf{GSB-MDPO} (\emph{Generalized Schrödinger Bridge Mirror Descent Policy Optimization}), which formulates on-policy generative policy optimization as a Generalized Schrödinger Bridge problem over state-conditioned generation paths and instantiates the resulting path-measure update through mirror descent policy optimization. The key insight is that the GSB path-space KL plays the role of the proximal term in MDPO while upper-bounding the terminal action KL, enabling direct control of the executed action distribution without explicit terminal action likelihood evaluation. Experiments on 14 continuous-control tasks across Playground and Gym-MuJoCo demonstrate the empirical effectiveness of GSB-MDPO and support path-space regularization as a principled proximal update for multi-step generative policies.

</details>


### [493] [Learning Safely Without Knowing the World:COMPASS-Hedge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.22348)
*Ting Hu,Luanda Cai,Emmanouil-Vasileios Vlatakis-Gkaragkounis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出COMPASS-Hedge算法，首次在全信息在线学习场景中同时实现对抗性环境下的极小化最优遗憾、随机环境下的实例最优遗憾（基于间隔），以及相对于固定基准策略的$\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(1)$遗憾，无需预知环境类型或问题参数，突破了"三重困境"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有在线学习算法难以同时兼顾对抗性环境下的最坏情况鲁棒性、随机环境下的实例最优性以及相对于固定基准的安全性，三者之间存在根本性权衡。现有方法最多只能实现"两好"，无法在不牺牲最优速率或依赖先知参数的情况下统一三者。

Method: 提出COMPASS-Hedge算法，核心创新包括：自适应伪遗憾缩放（adaptive pseudo-regret scaling）、基于阶段的激进策略（phase-based aggression）以及比较器感知的混合策略（comparator-aware mixing strategy），三者协同实现无参数、任意时间的"三好"保证。

Result: 在全信息设定下，COMPASS-Hedge同时实现：(i) 对抗性环境下极小化最优遗憾（对数因子内）；(ii) 随机环境下基于间隔的实例最优遗憾；(iii) 相对于指定基准策略的$\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(1)$遗憾。这是首个"三好"保证。

Conclusion: 本文证明了基准安全性不必以牺牲最坏情况鲁棒性或随机效率为代价，为在线学习中的"三重困境"提供了首个统一解决方案。

Abstract: Online learning algorithms often face a fundamental trilemma: balancing regret guarantees between adversarial and stochastic settings and providing baseline safety against a fixed comparator. While existing methods excel in one or two of these regimes, they typically fail to unify all three without sacrificing optimal rates or requiring oracle access to problem-dependent parameters. In this work, we bridge this gap by introducing COMPASS-Hedge. To the best of our knowledge, our algorithm is the first full-information anytime method to simultaneously achieve, up to logarithmic factors: i) minimax-optimal regret in adversarial environments; ii) instance-optimal, gap-dependent regret in stochastic environments; and iii) $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(1)$ regret relative to a designated baseline policy. Crucially, COMPASS-Hedge is parameter-free and requires no prior knowledge of the environment's nature or the magnitude of the stochastic suboptimality gaps. Our approach hinges on a novel integration of adaptive pseudo-regret scaling and phase-based aggression, coupled with a comparator-aware mixing strategy. To the best of our knowledge, this provides the first "best-of-three-world" guarantee in the full-information setting, establishing that baseline safety does not have to come at the cost of worst-case robustness or stochastic efficiency.

</details>


### [494] [Graph Memory Transformer (GMT)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.23862)
*Nicola Zanarini,Niccolò Ferrari,Evelina Lamma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出图记忆Transformer（GMT），将解码器-only Transformer中的前馈网络（FFN）子层替换为显式学习的记忆图，包含可学习的质心集和有向转移矩阵，实现基于图的记忆导航而非密集变换。在82.2M参数设置下，验证了该架构的可行性和可解释性，虽在验证损失和困惑度上低于103M密集基线，但零样本基准表现接近。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索能否将解码器-only Transformer中的FFN子层替换为显式学习的记忆图结构，以提升模型的结构可解释性，同时保持自回归架构的有效性。

Method: 提出GMT架构，保留因果自注意力，将每个token的FFN变换替换为基于质心记忆库和有向转移矩阵的图记忆单元，包含引力源路由、条件目标选择和门控位移读出机制，返回从源记忆状态向目标记忆状态的移动向量。

Result: 82.2M参数的GMT v7在验证损失（3.5995）和困惑度（36.58）上低于103M密集GPT基线（3.2903/26.85），但零样本基准表现接近；训练稳定，且质心使用、转移结构和源-目标移动等量可直接检查。

Conclusion: 用图介导的记忆导航替代密集的token内变换是可行的且具有结构可解释性，但非SOTA声明；更大规模扩展、优化内核和更广泛基准评估留待后续工作。

Abstract: We investigate whether the Feed-Forward Network (FFN) sublayer in a decoder-only transformer can be replaced by an explicit learned memory graph while preserving the surrounding autoregressive architecture. The proposed Graph Memory Transformer (GMT) keeps causal self-attention intact, but replaces the usual per-token FFN transformation with a memory cell that routes token representations over a learned bank of centroids connected by a learned directed transition matrix. In the base GMT v7 instantiation studied here, each of 16 transformer blocks contains 128 centroids, a 128 * 128 edge matrix, gravitational source routing, token-conditioned target selection, and a gated displacement readout. The cell therefore returns movement from an estimated source memory state toward a target memory state, rather than a retrieved value. The resulting model is a fully decoder-only language model with 82.2M trainable parameters and no dense FFN sublayers, compared with a 103.0M-parameter dense GPT-style baseline used in the evaluation. The base v7 model trains stably and exposes centroid usage, transition structure, and source-to-target movement as directly inspectable quantities of the forward computation. It remains behind the larger dense baseline in validation loss and perplexity (3.5995/36.58 vs. 3.2903/26.85), while showing close zero-shot benchmark behavior under the evaluated setting. These results are not intended as a state-of-the-art claim; they support the viability and structural interpretability of replacing dense within-token transformation with graph-mediated memory navigation. Broader scaling, optimized kernels, and more extensive benchmark evaluation are left for subsequent work.

</details>


### [495] [Negative Ontology of True Target for Machine Learning: Towards Evaluation and Learning under Democratic Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.24824)
*Yongquan Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从哲学角度审视了关于真实目标（TT）存在性假设的转变如何为机器学习预测建模带来新视角，并基于TT不存在的负本体论立场，提出了民主监督下的评估与学习知识体系，通过多不准确真实目标（MIATTs）构建了EL-MIATTs框架，并在教育领域进行了应用验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前主流机器学习范式均假设真实目标（TT）客观存在，但这一假设在哲学上值得商榷。作者试图通过转变这一基本假设（承认TT不存在），为ML预测建模开辟新的理论视角和方法路径。

Method: 采用负本体论立场（认为TT在现实世界中不客观存在），基于此定义民主监督；提出多不准确真实目标（MIATTs）作为民主监督的实例级实现；推导了MIATTs的逻辑驱动生成与评估原则、逻辑评估公式以及不可定义真实目标学习机制；最终构建了EL-MIATTs框架。

Result: 建立了一个完整的EL-MIATTs框架，涵盖逻辑驱动的MIATTs生成与评估、基于MIATTs的逻辑评估公式，以及不可定义真实目标学习方法。实际应用案例展示了该框架在教育与个体专业发展领域的潜力。

Conclusion: 通过否定TT的客观存在性并引入民主监督概念，本文为ML预测建模提供了新的哲学基础和可行框架；EL-MIATTs在教育和职业发展领域展现出应用价值，与民主监督的先前讨论相一致。

Abstract: This article philosophically examines how shifts in assumptions regarding the existence and non-existence of the true target (TT) give rise to new perspectives and insights for machine learning (ML)-based predictive modeling and, correspondingly, proposes a knowledge system for evaluation and learning under Democratic Supervision. By systematically analysing the existence assumption of the TT in current mainstream ML paradigms, we explicitly adopt a negative ontology perspective, positing that the TT does not objectively exist in the real world, and, grounded in this non-existence assumption, define Democratic Supervision for ML. We further present Multiple Inaccurate True Targets (MIATTs) as an instance-level realization of Democratic Supervision. Building upon MIATTs, we derive principles, for the logic-driven generation and assessment of MIATTs, a logical assessment formulation for evaluation with MIATTs, and undefinable true target learning for learning with MIATTs. Based on these components, we establish the evaluation and learning with MIATTs (EL-MIATTs) framework for ML-based predictive modelling. A real-world application demonstrates the potential of the proposed EL-MIATTs framework in supporting education and professional development for individuals, aligning with prior discussions of Democratic Supervision in the fields of education and professional development.

</details>


### [496] [Advancing multi-site emission control: A physics-informed transfer learning framework with mixture of experts for carbon-pollutant synergy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.26571)
*Yuxuan Ying,Hanqing Yang,Kaige Wang,Yu Hu,Zhiming Zheng,Yunliang Jiang,Xiaoqing Lin,Xiaodong Li,Jun Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出碳-污染物混合专家模型（CPMoE），通过物理守恒约束、运行工况异质性和碳-污染物耦合关系的联合建模，实现了跨异构垃圾焚烧厂的排放控制关系迁移；在13个工厂中源域R²达0.668-0.970，迁移至12个目标厂后仍保持0.610-0.970，并通过数字孪生优化实现3.6-6.3%的风险指数降低和94-100%的污染物协同减排。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 城市生活垃圾焚烧（MSWI）在实现能源回收的同时排放多种污染物，不同设施间的排放控制关系难以迁移，因为单厂数据驱动模型缺乏物理约束和工况级结构，无法泛化至新工厂。

Method: 提出碳-污染物混合专家模型（CPMoE），在物理守恒正则化约束下将过程观测路由至工况特定的专家网络，并结合物理知识迁移学习将参考模型适配至新工厂。

Result: 13个工厂上源域R²为0.668-0.970；迁移至12个目标厂后R²为0.610-0.841；数字孪生优化实现风险指数降低3.6-6.3%，94-100%样本实现污染物协同减排。

Conclusion: 研究表明，通过物理约束与工况级结构设计，跨工厂排放控制关系是可迁移的，为实现异构垃圾焚烧网络中的碳-污染物协同控制提供了可行的决策支持路径。

Abstract: Municipal solid waste incineration (MSWI) converts urban waste to energy but simultaneously emits carbon dioxide, carbon monoxide and multiple regulated air pollutants whose formation is tightly coupled within a single combustion system. Controlling these emissions across a network of diverse facilities poses a fundamentally different challenge from optimising a single plant: data-driven models trained at one site capture local statistical patterns that rarely survive transfer to another, because they lack the physical constraints and regime-level structure needed to generalise. Here we show that shared emission-control relationships can be identified across heterogeneous MSWI plants when physical conservation laws, operating-regime heterogeneity and carbon-pollutant coupling are treated jointly. We develop a carbon-pollutant mixture-of-experts (CPMoE) model that routes process observations through regime-specific expert networks under conservation-based regularisation, and combine it with physics-informed transfer learning to adapt a reference model to new facilities. Across 13 plants, CPMoE predicts six major pollutants and a composite system-level risk index with source-domain R2 of 0.668-0.904 and 0.666-0.970, respectively; after transfer to 12 target plants these values remain 0.661-0.842 and 0.610-0.841. Expert-utilisation patterns show that adaptation proceeds through structured regime re-weighting rather than re-learning from scratch. Embedding the transferred model in an offline digital twin and screening candidate operating adjustments against historical process records yields consistent risk-index reductions of 3.6-6.3% with simultaneous pollutant co-reductions in 94-100% of evaluated samples. These findings suggest a practical route toward transferable, system-level decision support for carbon-pollutant co-control in heterogeneous waste-to-energy networks.

</details>


### [497] [CompleteRXN: Toward Completing Open Chemical Reaction Databases](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.00222)
*Gabriel Vogel,Minouk Noordsij,Evgeny Pidko,Jana M. Weber*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CompleteRXN是一个大规模监督基准，用于在真实缺失数据条件下进行化学反应补全任务。研究提出了带约束解码的反应补全模型CRB，在基准测试中达到99.20%（随机划分）和91.12%（极端分布外划分）的等价准确率，但所有方法在非基准的完整USPTO数据上性能显著下降，揭示了基准性能与实际鲁棒性之间的差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有化学反应数据集（如USPTO）普遍存在副产物、共反应物和化学计量系数缺失的问题，严重限制了其在下游应用中的可用性和可靠性。因此需要构建一个能够反映真实缺失数据条件的反应补全基准。

Method: 通过将USPTO记录与经过整理的机理反应进行对齐，构建了对齐的不完整反应与原子平衡反应的数据集。提出了带约束解码的编码器-解码器反应补全模型CRB（Constrained Reaction Balancer），并与SynRBL等基线方法进行比较。

Result: CRB在随机划分上达到99.20%等价准确率，在极端分布外划分上达到91.12%。SynRBL能生成平衡且化学合理的补全结果，但准确率较低。所有方法随不完整性增加性能下降，且在完整未整理的USPTO数据上性能大幅下降。

Conclusion: CompleteRXN基准揭示了现有反应补全方法在受控基准与真实场景之间存在显著性能差距，表明当前方法在实际应用中的鲁棒性不足，需要未来进一步研究。

Abstract: Chemical reaction datasets such as USPTO suffer from substantial incompleteness, frequently missing byproducts, co-reactants, and stoichiometric coefficients. This limits their applicability and reliability in downstream applications. Here, we introduce CompleteRXN, a large-scale supervised benchmark for reaction completion under realistic missing-data conditions. We construct a dataset of aligned incomplete and atom-balanced reactions by mapping USPTO records to curated mechanistic reactions. We evaluate representative baselines, including a novel encoder-decoder reaction completion model with constrained decoding, the Constrained Reaction Balancer (CRB), and a recent algorithmic method, SynRBL. On our CompleteRXN benchmark, the CRB achieves high performance across splits of increasing difficulty, reaching 99.20% equivalence accuracy on the random split and 91.12% on the extreme out-of-distribution split. SynRBL produces many balanced and chemically plausible completions, but with lower accuracy on the benchmark test splits. Across all methods, performance degrades with increasing incompleteness. We observe a substantial drop when evaluating on reactions outside the benchmark (full uncurated USPTO), highlighting the gap between benchmark performance and practical robustness and motivating future work.

</details>


### [498] [Stable-GFlowNet: Toward Diverse and Robust LLM Red-Teaming via Contrastive Trajectory Balance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.00553)
*Minchan Kwon,Sunghyun Baek,Minseo Kim,Jaemyung Yu,Dongyoon Han,Junmo Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Stable-GFN (S-GFN)，通过消除配分函数Z估计、采用成对比较和鲁棒掩码机制解决GFN在红队测试中的训练不稳定和模式坍塌问题，同时引入流畅度稳定器避免生成无意义文本，在保持最优策略的同时实现稳定训练，实验证明其攻击性能和多样性均优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM红队测试需要有效且多样的攻击，但现有GFN方法存在训练不稳定和模式坍塌问题，尤其是不稳定奖励会加速模式坍塌，亟需一种稳定的生成方法。

Method: 1) 消除配分函数Z估计，通过成对比较替代；2) 采用鲁棒掩码机制应对噪声奖励；3) 提出流畅度稳定器防止模型陷入生成无意义文本的局部最优。

Result: 在各种设置下，S-GFN展现出压倒性的攻击性能和多样性。

Conclusion: S-GFN在保持GFN最优策略的同时实现了更稳定的训练，为LLM红队测试提供了一种高效且多样的攻击生成方法。

Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) Red-Teaming, which proactively identifies vulnerabilities of LLMs, is an essential process for ensuring safety. Finding effective and diverse attacks in red-teaming is important, but achieving both is challenging. Generative Flow Networks (GFNs) that perform distribution matching are a promising methods, but they are notorious for training instability and mode collapse. In particular, unstable rewards in red-teaming accelerate mode collapse. We propose Stable-GFN (S-GFN), which eliminates partition function $Z$ estimation in GFN and reduces training instability.
