S-GFN avoids Z-estimation through pairwise comparisons and employs a robust masking methodology against noisy rewards. Additionally, we propose a fluency stabilizer to prevent the model from getting stuck in local optima that produce gibberish. S-GFN provides more stable training while maintaining the optimal policy of GFN. We demonstrate the overwhelming attack performance and diversity of S-GFN across various settings.

</details>


### [499] [Statistical Consistency and Generalization of Contrastive Representation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.02116)
*Yuanfan Li,Xiyuan Wei,Tianbao Yang,Yiming Ying*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文建立了对比表示学习（CRL）的统一统计学习理论，证明了对比损失对最优排序具有统计一致性，并推导出随负样本数增加而改善的泛化界（$O(1/m + 1/\sqrt{n})$和$O(1/\sqrt{m} + 1/\sqrt{n})$），解释了大规模负样本集的经验优势，同时揭示了负样本数$m$与锚点数$n$之间的显式权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有CRL理论分析存在三个关键缺陷：(i) CRL的统计一致性尚不清楚；(ii) 现有的泛化界随负样本数增加而变差，与实证结果矛盾；(iii) CRL的检索性能缺乏理论关注。本文旨在填补这些空白。

Method: 针对下游任务，采用AUC型群体准则评估检索质量，证明对比损失与最优排序统计一致，并建立标度不等式定量关联对比风险与检索次优性。针对上游训练，分别对有监督和自监督对比目标推导泛化界，揭示$m$与$n$的权衡关系。

Result: 有监督对比学习的泛化界为$O(1/m + 1/\sqrt{n})$，自监督对比学习的泛化界为$O(1/\sqrt{m} + 1/\sqrt{n})$。这些界随$m$增大而改善，与经验观察一致。大规模视觉-语言模型实验验证了理论预测。

Conclusion: 本文为CRL提供了统一的统计学习理论，解决了统计一致性、负样本规模悖论和检索性能理论分析等关键问题，为大规模对比学习的实践提供了理论支撑。

Abstract: Contrastive representation learning (CRL) underpins many modern foundation models. Despite recent theoretical progress, existing analyses suffer from several key limitations: (i) the statistical consistency of CRL remains poorly understood; (ii) available generalization bounds deteriorate as the number of negative samples increases, contradicting the empirical benefits of large negative sets; and (iii) the retrieval performance of CRL has received limited theoretical attention. In this paper, we develop a unified statistical learning theory for CRL. For downstream tasks, we evaluate retrieval quality using an AUC-type population criterion and show that the contrastive loss is \emph{statistically consistent} with optimal ranking. We further establish a \emph{calibration-style inequality} that quantitatively relates excess contrastive risk to excess retrieval suboptimality. For upstream training, we study both supervised and self-supervised contrastive objectives and derive generalization bounds of order $O(1/m + 1/\sqrt{n})$ and $O(1/\sqrt{m} + 1/\sqrt{n})$, respectively, where $m$ denotes the number of negative samples and $n$ the number of anchor points. These bounds not only explain the empirical advantages of large negative sets but also reveal an explicit trade-off between $m$ and $n$. Extensive experiments on large-scale vision--language models corroborate our theoretical predictions.

</details>


### [500] [Transformed Latent Variable Multi-Output Gaussian Processes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05133)
*Xiaoyu Jiang,Xinxing Shi,Sokratia Georgaka,Magnus Rattray,Mauricio A Álvarez*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出T-LVMOGP框架，通过 Lipschitz 正则化神经网络构建深度多输出核，结合随机变分推断，将多输出高斯过程扩展到超万维输出空间，在气候建模和空间转录组学等任务中优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MOGP方法在处理高维输出时面临可扩展性瓶颈，通常依赖低秩或可分离和核等限制性假设，牺牲了表达能力。需要一种既能扩展到大量输出又能保持捕捉输出间复杂依赖关系的框架。

Method: 提出Transformed Latent Variable MOGP (T-LVMOGP)，利用Lipschitz正则化神经网络将输入和输出特定的潜变量映射到嵌入空间，构建灵活的多输出深度核；结合随机变分推断实现高效推理。

Result: 在超过10,000个输出的气候建模和零膨胀空间转录组学数据等多个基准上，T-LVMOGP在预测精度和计算效率两方面均优于基线方法。

Conclusion: T-LVMOGP成功将MOGP扩展到海量输出场景，同时保持了捕捉有意义输出间依赖关系的能力，为高维输出空间的概率建模提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Multi-Output Gaussian Processes (MOGPs) provide a principled probabilistic framework for modelling correlated outputs but face scalability bottlenecks when applied to datasets with high-dimensional output spaces. To maintain tractability, existing methods typically resort to restrictive assumptions, such as employing low-rank or sum-of-separable kernels, which can limit expressiveness. We propose the Transformed Latent Variable MOGP (T-LVMOGP), a novel framework that scales MOGPs to a massive number of outputs while preserving the capacity to capture meaningful inter-output dependencies. T-LVMOGP constructs a flexible multi-output deep kernel by mapping inputs and output-specific latent variables into an embedding space using a Lipschitz-regularised neural network. Combined with stochastic variational inference, our model effectively scales to high-dimensional output settings. Across diverse benchmarks, including climate modelling with over 10,000 outputs and zero-inflated spatial transcriptomics data, T-LVMOGP outperforms baselines in both predictive accuracy and computational efficiency.

</details>


### [501] [Uncertainty Estimation via Hyperspherical Confidence Mapping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05964)
*Eunseo Choi,Ho-Yeon Kim,Jaewon Lee,Taeyong jo,Myungjun lee,Heejin Ahn*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种名为超球面置信映射（HCM）的无采样、无分布假设的不确定性估计框架，通过将网络输出分解为幅度和归一化方向向量并约束在单位超球面上，将不确定性解释为几何约束的违反程度，在多个任务上以更低推理成本达到了与集成方法和证据方法相当或更优的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有不确定性估计方法通常依赖昂贵的采样过程或严格的分布假设，难以在自动驾驶、医疗等高风险领域高效部署，亟需一种简单、无采样、无分布假设且具有可解释性的不确定性估计方案。

Method: 将神经网络输出分解为幅度和约束在单位超球面上的归一化方向向量，通过度量方向向量偏离单位超球面约束的程度（几何约束违反度）来定义不确定性，实现确定性（单次前向传播）且无需分布假设的不确定性估计，适用于回归与分类任务。

Result: 在多个标准基准和真实工业任务上，HCM以远低于集成方法的推理成本，在不确定性估计的准确性和置信度-误差对齐方面匹配或超越了集成方法和证据方法。

Conclusion: 几何结构为不确定性估计提供了强大的归纳偏置，HCM作为一种通用且高效的替代方案，有望成为传统不确定性估计技术的重要补充。

Abstract: Quantifying uncertainty in neural network predictions is essential for high-stakes domains such as autonomous driving, healthcare, and manufacturing. While existing approaches often depend on costly sampling or restrictive distributional assumptions, we propose Hyperspherical Confidence Mapping (HCM), a simple yet principled framework for sampling-free and distribution-free uncertainty estimation. HCM decomposes outputs into a magnitude and a normalized direction vector constrained to lie on the unit hypersphere, enabling a novel interpretation of uncertainty as the degree of violation of this geometric constraint. This yields deterministic and interpretable estimates applicable to both regression and classification. Experiments across diverse benchmarks and real-world industrial tasks demonstrate that HCM matches or surpasses ensemble and evidential approaches, with far lower inference cost and stronger confidence-error alignment. Our results highlight the power of geometric structure in uncertainty estimation and position HCM as a versatile alternative to conventional techniques.

</details>


### [502] [SMolLM: Small Language Models Learn Small Molecular Grammar](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06322)
*Akhil Jindal,Harang Ju*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出53K参数权重共享变换器SMolLM，在ZINC-250K基准上以95%有效性生成SMILES，超越10倍参数标准GPT；机制上，相同模块按固定层级解决SMILES约束（括号→环→化合价），消融实验分离出括号匹配头，实现了紧凑、可机械解释的分子生成器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有分子设计语言模型规模已达数亿参数，但对其如何学习化学语法（如SMILES形式语言的约束规则）的机制理解甚少，亟需一个既紧凑又可机械解释的模型来研究迭代计算过程。

Method: 训练了一个仅53K参数的权重共享变换器SMolLM，在ZINC-250K药物分子数据集上生成新颖SMILES；通过错误分类和线性探针分析模型内部表示，并进行了消融实验以隔离关键注意力头。

Result: SMolLM以95%的有效性生成新颖SMILES，性能超过10倍参数的标准GPT；机制上发现同一模块在不同前向传递中以固定层级解决SMILES约束：先是括号匹配，然后是环结构，最后是化合价约束；消融实验确认了括号匹配头的关键作用。

Conclusion: 构建了一个紧凑且机械可解释的分子生成器，为研究形式语言领域的迭代计算提供了良好测试平台，同时验证了权重共享与特定注意力头的组合可以高效学习化学语法。

Abstract: Language models for molecular design have scaled to hundreds of millions of parameters, yet how they learn chemical grammar is poorly understood. We train SMolLM, a 53K-parameter weight-shared transformer, to generate novel SMILES with 95% validity on the ZINC-250K drug-like-molecule benchmark, outperforming a standard GPT with 10 times more parameters. Mechanistically, the same block resolves SMILES constraints across passes in a fixed hierarchy: brackets first, rings second, and valence last, as shown by error classification and linear probing, with ablation isolating the bracket-matching head. Together, these results yield a compact, mechanistically interpretable molecular generator and a testbed for studying iterative computation in formal-language domains.

</details>


### [503] [Order-Agnostic Autoregressive Modelling with Missing Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06355)
*Ignacio Peis,Pablo M. Olmos,Jes Frellsen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文重新审视了顺序无关自回归模型在缺失数据场景下的应用，提出了缺失感知的顺序无关自回归模型（MO-ARM），该模型在完全观测数据上通过随机缺失机制隐式执行插补，并首次提出了在不完整数据上训练的原则性框架，同时利用其摊销条件密度估计进行主动信息获取。在多个真实世界基准测试中，MO-ARM持续优于现有的插补基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 顺序无关自回归模型在深度生成建模中表现出色，但它们在缺失数据场景下的应用尚未被充分探索。本文旨在填补这一空白，重新审视并利用这些模型处理不完整数据。

Method: 首先证明标准训练过程在完全随机缺失机制下隐式执行插补；其次提出首个在缺失数据上直接训练的原理性框架，适用于一般缺失机制；最后利用摊销条件密度估计对最信息量的缺失变量进行主动序贯选择。

Result: 在多个真实世界基准测试中，MO-ARM模型持续优于已有的插补基线方法。

Conclusion: MO-ARM在缺失数据处理方面具有显著优势，能够更鲁棒地处理高缺失率场景，并为主动信息获取提供了有效工具。

Abstract: Order-Agnostic autoregressive models have demonstrated strong performance in deep generative modeling, yet their use in settings with incomplete data remains largely unexplored. In this work, we reinterpret them through the lens of missing data. First, we show that their standard training procedure on fully observed data implicitly performs imputation under a missing completely at random mechanism, resulting in robust out-of-sample imputation performance in settings with high missingness. Second, we introduce the first principled framework for training them directly on incomplete datasets under general missingness mechanisms. Third, we leverage their amortized conditional density estimation to perform active information acquisition, i.e., sequentially selecting the most informative missing variables for downstream prediction or inference. Across a suite of real-world benchmarks, our Missingness-Aware Order-Agnostic Autoregressive Model (MO-ARM) consistently outperforms established imputation baselines.

</details>


### [504] [Prune-OPD: Efficient and Reliable On-Policy Distillation for Long-Horizon Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07804)
*Zhicheng Yang,Zhijiang Guo,Yifan Song,Minrui Xu,Yongxin Wang,Yiwei Wang,Xiaodan Liang,Jing Tang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Prune-OPD通过动态检测学生与教师推理轨迹的漂移，实时截断无效生成并重分配计算资源，在保持或提升性能的同时减少37.6%-68.0%的训练时间，解决了On-policy蒸馏在长程任务中因前缀发散导致教师奖励不可靠的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: On-policy蒸馏在长程推理任务中面临关键缺陷：学生生成的前缀不可避免地偏离教师思维过程，导致教师的密集奖励失去局部可剥削性，继续生成和评估这些"漂移"轨迹不仅降低奖励质量，还造成巨大计算浪费。

Method: Prune-OPD框架通过持续监控学生与教师预测之间的局部兼容性（如top-k重叠），实时检测前缀漂移事件。一旦检测到严重漂移，单调降低后续不可靠奖励的权重并触发动态截断，从而停止无效生成并将计算重新分配给可靠的教师监督。

Result: 在不同教师-学生组合下，Prune-OPD在AMC、AIME、HMMT等挑战性基准上减少37.6%-68.0%的训练时间，同时保持甚至提升性能。当师生兼容性高时，自动通过扩展训练窗口保留长上下文监督。

Conclusion: Prune-OPD改进OPD的方式不是盲目缩短生成轨迹，而是将计算重新分配给局部可剥削的教师奖励，证明了动态对齐训练预算与监督质量的有效性。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) leverages dense teacher rewards to enhance reasoning models. However, scaling OPD to long-horizon tasks exposes a critical flaw: as the student's generated prefix inevitably diverges from the teacher's thought process, the teacher's dense reward loses local exploitability. Continuing to generate and evaluate tokens on these ``drifted'' trajectories not only degrades reward quality but also incurs massive computational waste. To address this, we introduce \textbf{Prune-OPD}, a framework that dynamically aligns training budgets with supervision quality. By continuously monitoring the local compatibility between student and teacher predictions (e.g., via top-$k$ overlap), Prune-OPD detects prefix-drift events in real time. Upon detecting severe drift, it monotonically down-weights subsequent unreliable rewards and triggers dynamic rollout truncation. This allows the training process to halt futile generation and reallocate compute strictly to reliable teacher supervision. Across diverse teacher-student combinations, Prune-OPD consistently aligns computation with supervision reliability. When prefix drift makes dense teacher rewards unreliable, it reduces training time by 37.6\%--68.0\% while preserving, and often improving, performance on challenging benchmarks (AMC, AIME, HMMT). When student-teacher compatibility remains high, it automatically preserves long-context supervision by expanding the training window. These results suggest that Prune-OPD improves OPD not by blindly shortening rollouts, but by reallocating computation toward locally exploitable teacher rewards.

</details>


### [505] [PRIM: Meta-Learned Bayesian Root Cause Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.08786)
*Christopher Lohse,Anish Dhir,Amadou Ba,Bradley Eck,Marco Ruffini,Jonas Wahl*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PRIM是一种基于因果元学习的根因分析方法，通过贝叶斯推断和MACE Transformer神经过程，实现对复杂系统（最多100变量）的零样本根因识别，推理仅需17毫秒，在合成和真实基准上达到与已知因果图结构的方法竞争的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 复杂系统中的根因分析面临三个主要挑战：变量间错误传播、需要结构因果知识、以及测试时推理的计算成本高。现有方法要么依赖已知因果图，要么计算开销大。

Method: 将RCA形式化为因果模型的合成先验上的贝叶斯推断任务；使用MACE（Model-Averaged Causal Estimation）Transformer神经过程，联合关注观测样本、异常样本和节点的因果结构；采用基于模拟的元学习范式（前拟合网络）进行训练。

Result: PRIM在17毫秒内完成对最多100变量的零样本推理；在合成基准和PetShop、CausRCA两个真实基准上与已知因果图结构的方法竞争，优于不依赖图结构的方法；轻量级微调可进一步提升性能。

Conclusion: PRIM通过元学习框架实现了无需测试时模型拟合和显式统计检验的根因分析，在效率和效果之间取得了良好平衡，尤其适用于缺乏完整因果图先验知识的复杂系统。

Abstract: Root cause analysis (RCA) in complex systems is challenging due to error propagation across multiple variables, the need for structural causal knowledge, and the computational cost of inference at test time. We introduce PRIM (Prior-fitted Root cause Identification with Meta-learning), a causal meta-learning approach that frames RCA as a Bayesian inference task over a synthetic prior of causal models. By marginalising out structural uncertainty, PRIM implicitly identifies changes in the data-generating mechanism between baseline and anomalous periods. In doing so, PRIM infers distributional differences without explicit statistical testing, and implicitly learns causal structure without model fitting at test time. Following the simulation-based meta-learning paradigm of prior-fitted networks, PRIM uses a Model-Averaged Causal Estimation (MACE) transformer neural process that jointly attends over observational and anomalous samples and the causal structure of nodes, enabling zero-shot inference in 17,ms for systems with up to 100 variables. Across synthetic benchmarks and two realistic benchmark datasets, PetShop and CausRCA, PRIM is competitive with methods that are aware of the system's causal graphical structure a priori while outperforming graph-unaware methods on several tasks. Lightweight fine-tuning to specific domains and data dynamics improves performance further.

</details>


### [506] [Inpainting physics: self-supervised learning for context-driven fluid simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.08832)
*Jonas Weidner,Yeray Martin-Ruisanchez,Daniel Rueckert,Benedikt Wiestler,Julian Suk*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出将稳态CFD推理重构为基于上下文条件的修复问题，通过自监督先验和局部邻域分词器，在颅内动脉瘤血流动力学场景中实现了超越传统监督神经代理的泛化性能，支持边界条件变化和局部几何编辑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统神经代理模型作为前向算子训练，与训练时的条件变量（如几何、边界条件）紧密耦合，在边界条件变化或局部几何修改时难以复用，缺乏泛化能力。

Method: 将稳态CFD推理视为修复问题：学习速度场的自监督先验，推理时仅通过固定已知区域（入口、出口或未变化区域）施加边界约束；引入局部邻域分词器将高分辨率速度场表示为紧凑空间潜在token，并在这些token上训练潜在流匹配模型和掩码自编码器。

Result: 在颅内动脉瘤血流动力学中，该方法能从稀疏边界上下文重建完整速度场；在边界条件和数据集偏移下优于监督神经代理；支持通过复用未改变的仿真上下文进行局部几何编辑。

Conclusion: 将CFD推理视为上下文条件修复，可以将神经代理从任务特定的预测器转变为可复用的流场先验。

Abstract: Neural surrogate models for computational fluid dynamics (CFD) are typically trained as forward operators that map explicit problem specifications, such as geometry and boundary conditions, to solution fields. This ties the model to the conditioning variables seen during training and limits reuse under boundary-condition shifts or local geometry changes. We propose to reformulate steady CFD inference as an inpainting problem: instead of training on explicit boundary conditions, we learn a self-supervised prior over velocity fields and impose boundary constraints only during inference by fixing known regions such as inlet, outlet or unchanged regions from previous simulations. To scale this idea to large 3D meshes, we introduce a local neighbourhood tokeniser that represents high-resolution velocity fields as compact spatial latent tokens and train latent flow-matching and masked-autoencoder models on these tokens. On intracranial aneurysm hemodynamics, our method reconstructs full velocity fields from sparse boundary context, outperforms supervised neural surrogates under boundary-condition and dataset shift and enables local geometry editing by reusing unchanged simulation context. These results suggest that viewing CFD inference as context-conditioned inpainting can turn neural surrogates from task-specific predictors into reusable flow priors.

</details>


### [507] [TopoGeoScore: A Self-Supervised Source-Only Geometric Framework for OOD Checkpoint Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.08870)
*Farid Hazratian,Ali Zia,Hien Duy Nguyen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出TopoGeoScore，一种仅利用源域表征的几何评分器，用于无标签的OOD鲁棒性检查点选择，无需目标域样本或标签。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在目标域标签不可用的情况下，难以诊断OOD鲁棒性。现有方法通常需要目标域样本，本文探索更严格的仅源域变体，即仅使用源域表征进行无监督精度估计和鲁棒检查点选择。

Method: 构建类条件互k近邻图，提取三种可解释信号：类流形全局复杂度（约化拉普拉斯对数行列式）、局部邻域正则性（Ollivier-Ricci曲率）、高阶拓扑摘要（碎片化连通性、环路、全局-局部不一致性）。通过自监督目标学习非负线性评分，强制在近似保几何的嵌入视图下保持不变性，并与破坏结构的视图分离。

Result: 在CIFAR系列损坏和分布偏移基准、ImageNet-C、MNLI→HANS迁移、OGBN-Arxiv上的实验表明，源域表征包含可测量的全局-局部-拓扑鲁棒性证据，支持部署前的实用检查点选择。

Conclusion: 源域表征本身蕴含可用于评估OOD鲁棒性的几何与拓扑信号，TopoGeoScore提供了一种无需任何目标域样本或标签的可解释检查点评分方法。

Abstract: Out-of-distribution (OOD) robustness is difficult to diagnose when target-domain labels are unavailable. We consider a more restrictive source-only variant of unsupervised accuracy estimation: selecting robust checkpoints using only source-domain representations, with no target samples or target labels. We propose \textbf{TopoGeoScore}, a source-only geometric scorer for label-free OOD checkpoint selection. Given a trained checkpoint, we construct class-conditional mutual $k$-nearest-neighbour graphs from source embeddings and extract three interpretable signals: a torsion-inspired reduced Laplacian log-determinant for global class-manifold complexity, Ollivier--Ricci curvature for local neighbourhood regularity, and higher-order topological summaries for fragmented connectivity, loops, and global--local inconsistency. Instead of fixing their weights by hand, TopoGeoScore learns a non-negative linear score through a self-supervised objective that enforces invariance under approximately geometry-preserving embedding views and separation from structure-breaking views. The score remains interpretable and uses no target-domain samples or labels. Results across CIFAR-based corruption and distribution-shift benchmarks, ImageNet-C, MNLI$\to$HANS transfer, and OGBN-Arxiv suggest that source representations contain measurable global--local--topological evidence of robustness, supporting practical checkpoint selection before deployment under distribution shift.

</details>


### [508] [Nearly-Optimal Algorithm for Adversarial Kernelized Bandits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10299)
*Shogo Iwazaki*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了对抗环境下核化bandits（高斯过程bandits）问题，其中RKHS中的奖励函数可被对手任意选择。证明指数权重算法可实现$\tilde{O}(\sqrt{T γ_T})$的对抗遗憾，对SE和Matérn核给出算法无关下界以证明最优性，并提出基于Nyström近似的计算高效变体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将核化bandits从随机环境扩展到对抗环境，解决奖励函数由对手任意选取时的最优学习问题。

Method: 采用指数权重（exponential-weight）算法；为提升计算效率，引入Nyström近似技术。

Result: 实现了$\tilde{O}(\sqrt{T γ_T})$的对抗遗憾界；对SE和Matérn核给出了算法无关的遗憾下界，证明算法在多项式对数因子内最优；Nyström近似变体保持了近乎最优的遗憾保证。

Conclusion: 指数权重算法在对抗环境下对核化bandits问题有效且最优，Nyström近似可实现高效计算而不牺牲统计效率。

Abstract: This paper studies kernelized bandits (also known as Gaussian process bandits) in an adversarial environment, where the reward functions in a known reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS) may be adversarially chosen at each round. We show that the exponential-weight algorithm achieves $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{T γ_T})$ adversarial regret, where $T$ and $γ_T$ denote the number of total rounds and the maximum information gain, respectively. For squared exponential (SE) and $ν$-Matérn kernels, we also show algorithm-independent lower bounds that guarantee the optimality of our algorithm up to polylogarithmic factors. Furthermore, we present a computationally efficient variant of our algorithm using Nyström approximation while maintaining nearly optimal regret guarantees.

</details>


### [509] [Teacher-Guided Policy Optimization for On-Policy Reasoning Distillation under Large Policy Divergence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13230)
*Xinyu Liu,Kechen Jiao,Chunyang Xiao,Runsong Zhao,Junhao Ruan,Bei Li,Jiahao Liu,Qifan Wang,Xin Chen,Jingang Wang,Chenglong Wang,Tong Xiao,JingBo Zhu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对现有在线策略蒸馏（OPD）方法在师生策略分歧大时无效的问题，提出教师引导策略优化（TGPO），通过教师直接指导学生语境下的token级生成并结合RLVR轨迹奖励，显著提升推理性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的基于反向KL散度的在线策略蒸馏方法在师生策略分歧较大时，RL驱动的探索常产生教师分布之外的轨迹，导致无信息的负反馈，模型无法有效学习。

Method: 提出TGPO方法：1）教师直接对学生生成的上下文进行token级生成指导；2）结合RLVR风格的轨迹级奖励，引导探索朝向更优的延续方向。

Result: 在推理基准测试上，TGPO一致优于现有RKL-based OPD方法，且在不同教师模型下均保持鲁棒性。

Conclusion: TGPO通过教师对token级的直接指导，有效解决了大策略分歧下OPD失效问题，是一种更鲁棒的在线推理蒸馏方法。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) has become a promising paradigm for reasoning-oriented post-training of large language models (LLMs), especially when combined with reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR). Existing OPD methods rely on reverse KL (RKL)-based teacher supervision over trajectories sampled from the student policy. However, we identify a critical limitation: under large teacher--student policy divergence, RL-driven exploration often produces trajectories outside the teacher distribution, resulting in uninformative negative feedback. To address this, we propose Teacher-Guided Policy Optimization (TGPO), an on-policy reasoning distillation method that remains effective under large policy divergence settings. Rather than relying solely on evaluative supervision, TGPO uses teacher to directly guide token level generation conditioning on student-generated contexts; together with RLVR-style trajectory level rewards, TGPO steers exploration toward improved continuations. Experiments on reasoning benchmarks show that TGPO consistently outperforms existing RKL-based OPD methods and remains robust across different teacher models.

</details>


### [510] [TabPFN-3: Technical Report](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13986)
*Léo Grinsztajn,Klemens Flöge,Oscar Key,Felix Birkel,Philipp Jund,Brendan Roof,Mihir Manium,Shi Bin Hoo,Magnus Bühler,Anurag Garg,Dominik Safaric,Jake Robertson,Benjamin Jäger,Simone Alessi,Adrian Hayler,Vladyslav Moroshan,Lennart Purucker,Philipp Singer,Alan Arazi,Julien Siems,Jan Hendrik Metzen,Georg Grab,Nick Erickson,Siyuan Guo,Eliott Kalfon,Simon Bing,David Salinas,Clara Cornu,Lilly Charlotte Wehrhahn,Diana Kriuchkova,Kursat Kaya,Lydia Sidhoum,Marie Salmon,Jerry Chen,Madelon Hulsebos,Yann LeCun,Samuel Müller,Bernhard Schölkopf,Sauraj Gambhir,Noah Hollmann,Frank Hutter*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TabPFN-3是一个专为表格数据设计的基础模型，在百万级数据集上实现SOTA性能，训练和推理速度相比前代提升20倍，并通过测试时计算扩展进一步优化性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表格数据支撑着科学和工业中大多数高价值预测问题，但现有方法在大规模数据集上存在性能和效率瓶颈。TabPFN虽然开启了表格数据的基础模型革命，但在扩展到百万级训练样本以及降低训练和推理时间方面仍有提升空间。

Method: TabPFN-3完全使用先验分布生成的合成数据进行预训练，引入了测试时计算扩展（test-time compute scaling），并通过减少KV缓存和行分块技术（row-chunking）实现在单个H100上扩展到100万行数据。同时提供了专门针对时间序列的TabPFN-TS-3检查点。

Result: 在TabArena基准上，单次前向传播显著优于所有其他模型（包括调参和集成基线）；在速度/性能前沿上占帕累托支配地位。TabPFN-3-Plus（Thinking）在TabArena上以超过200 Elo击败所有非TabPFN模型，在大数据子集上领先420 Elo；比AutoGluon 1.5 extreme快10倍。在关系数据（RelBenchV1新SOTA）、表格文本数据（TabSTAR SOTA）和时间序列（fev-bench第2名）上均取得领先性能。SHAP值计算加速达120倍。

Conclusion: TabPFN-3通过在合成数据上预训练并结合测试时计算扩展，在表格数据预测任务上大幅推进了性能前沿，同时在速度、规模和多模态扩展方面取得了显著进步，为表格基础模型树立了新标杆。

Abstract: Tabular data underpins most high-value prediction problems in science and industry, and TabPFN has driven the foundation model revolution for this modality. Designed with feedback from our users, TabPFN-3 builds on this foundation to scale state-of-the-art performance to datasets with 1M training rows and substantially reduce training and inference time. Pretrained exclusively on synthetic data from our prior, TabPFN-3 dramatically pushes the frontier of tabular prediction and brings substantial gains on time series, relational, and tabular-text data. On the standard tabular benchmark TabArena, a forward pass of TabPFN-3 outperforms all other models, including tuned and ensembled baselines, by a significant margin, and pareto-dominates the speed/performance frontier. On more diverse datasets, TabPFN-3 ranks first on datasets with many classes, and beats 8-hour-tuned gradient-boosted-tree baselines on datasets up to 1M training rows and 200 features. TabPFN-3 introduces test-time compute scaling to tabular foundation models. Our API offering TabPFN-3-Plus (Thinking) exploits this to beat all non-TabPFN models by over 200 Elo on TabArena, rising to 420 Elo on the largest data subset, and outperforms AutoGluon 1.5 extreme while being 10x faster, without using LLMs, real data, internet search or any other model besides TabPFN. TabPFN-3 extends the capabilities of our models, enabling SOTA prediction on relational data (new SOTA foundation model on RelBenchV1) and tabular-text data (SOTA on TabSTAR via TabPFN-3-Plus); and improves existing integrations: a specialized checkpoint, TabPFN-TS-3, ranks 2nd on the time-series benchmark fev-bench, and SHAP-value computation is up to 120x faster. TabPFN-3 achieves this performance while being up to 20x faster than TabPFN-2.5. In addition, a reduced KV cache and row-chunking scale to 1M rows on one H100 with fast inference speed.

</details>


### [511] [Latency-Quality Routing for Functionally Equivalent Tools in LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14241)
*Kexin Chu,Dawei Xiang,Wei Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出LQM-ContextRoute，一种面向同功能工具提供商的上下文赌博机路由器，通过延迟-质量匹配机制替代传统加性奖励，在运行时负载下实现更优的路由决策，在多个基准测试上显著优于SW-UCB。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工具增强型LLM智能体在运行时面临多个功能等价但延迟、可靠性和答案质量各异的同功能提供商，需要解决无金牌标签条件下的提供商路由问题。

Method: 采用上下文赌博机框架，核心设计是延迟-质量匹配：将延迟视为服务容量而非加性奖励中的抵消项，按每个服务周期内的预期答案质量对提供商排序，结合查询特定的质量估计和LLM-as-judge反馈，实现在线自适应。

Result: 在web搜索负载基准上F1提升2.18 pp；在StrategyQA高异质性场景下准确率提升18 pp；在异构检索器池上NDCG提升2.91-3.22 pp。

Conclusion: 同功能工具路由应将延迟视为服务容量而非奖励组成部分，尤其在运行时压力与提供商质量异质性并存时，延迟-质量匹配机制能有效避免加性奖励崩溃，提升路由决策质量。

Abstract: Tool-augmented LLM agents increasingly access the same tool type through multiple functionally equivalent providers, such as web-search APIs, retrievers, or LLM backends exposed behind a shared interface. This creates a provider-routing problem under runtime load: the router must choose among providers that differ in latency, reliability, and answer quality, often without gold labels at deployment time. We introduce LQM-ContextRoute, a contextual bandit router for same-function tool providers. Its key design is latency-quality matching: instead of letting low latency offset poor answers in an additive reward, the router ranks providers by expected answer quality per service cycle. It combines this capacity-aware score with query-specific quality estimation and LLM-as-judge feedback, allowing it to adapt online to both load changes and provider-quality differences. On the main web-search load benchmark, LQM-ContextRoute improves F1 by +2.18 pp over SW-UCB while staying on the latency-quality frontier. In a high-heterogeneity StrategyQA setting, LQM-ContextRoute avoids additive-reward collapse and improves accuracy by up to +18 pp over SW-UCB; on heterogeneous retriever pools, it improves NDCG by +2.91--+3.22 pp over SW-UCB. These results show that same-function tool routing benefits from treating latency as service capacity, especially when runtime pressure and provider-quality heterogeneity coexist.

</details>


### [512] [Turning Stale Gradients into Stable Gradients: Coherent Coordinate Descent with Implicit Landscape Smoothing for Lightweight Zeroth-Order Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14373)
*Chen Liang,Xiatao Sun,Qian Wang,Daniel Rakita*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Coherent Coordinate Descent (CoCD)，一种确定性的、样本高效且预算感知的零阶优化器。CoCD通过利用历史梯度信息实现每步O(1)查询复杂度，等价于带"热启动"的块循环坐标下降，并发现大步长有限差分具有隐式平滑效应。实验表明，CoCD在样本效率和收敛稳定性上显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有零阶优化方法面临两难困境：标准有限差分样本效率低，而随机子空间方法因随机估计导致高方差。亟需一种既样本高效又低方差的确定性零阶优化方法。

Method: 提出Coherent Coordinate Descent (CoCD)，一种确定性零阶优化器。理论形式化了梯度相干性概念，证明CoCD等价于带"热启动"的块循环坐标下降，将历史（过时）梯度转化为计算资产，实现每步O(1)查询复杂度。此外，推导了误差界，揭示大步长有限差分通过降低有效光滑常数产生隐式平滑效应。

Result: 在MLP、CNN和ResNet架构（多达27万参数）上，CoCD在样本效率和收敛损失/准确率上显著优于BCCD，且比随机化零阶方法具有更优的稳定性。

Conclusion: 确定性的、结构感知的更新策略是轻量级零阶优化中优于随机化的选择。

Abstract: Zeroth-Order (ZO) optimization is pivotal for scenarios where backpropagation is unavailable, such as memory-constrained on-device learning and black-box optimization. However, existing methods face a stark trade-off: they are either sample-inefficient (e.g., standard finite differences) or suffer from high variance due to randomized estimation (e.g., random subspace methods). In this work, we propose Coherent Coordinate Descent (CoCD), a deterministic, sample-efficient, and budget-aware ZO optimizer. Theoretically, we formalize the notion of gradient coherence and demonstrate that CoCD is equivalent to Block Cyclic Coordinate Descent (BCCD) with ``warm starts,'' effectively converting historical (stale) gradients from a liability into a computational asset. This mechanism enables $O(1)$ query complexity per step while maintaining global descent directions. Furthermore, we derive error bounds revealing a counter-intuitive insight: larger finite-difference step sizes can induce an implicit smoothing effect on the optimization landscape by reducing the effective smoothness constant, thereby improving convergence stability. Experiments on MLP, CNN, and ResNet architectures (up to 270k parameters) demonstrate that CoCD significantly outperforms BCCD in terms of sample efficiency and convergence loss/accuracy, and exhibits superior stability over randomized ZO methods. Our results suggest that deterministic, structure-aware updates offer a superior alternative to randomization for lightweight ZO optimization.

</details>


### [513] [DualKV: Shared-Prompt Flash Attention for Efficient RL Training with Large Rollouts and Long Contexts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.15422)
*Jiading Gai,Shuai Zhang,Xiang Song,Bernie Wang,George Karypis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DualKV是一种新型FlashAttention内核变体，通过消除RL训练中共享提示的复制冗余，在Qwen3-8B GRPO训练中实现1.63-2.09倍策略更新加速，MFU从36%提升至76%，30B MoE规模下实现3.82倍加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代RL后训练方法（如GRPO、DAPO）在长上下文大规模 rollout 训练中，标准FlashAttention会对共享提示（prompt）的P个token在所有N个响应序列中重复复制，导致前向和反向传播中大量计算和内存冗余。在N≥16、P≥8K的场景下，这种冗余主导了策略更新的成本。

Method: (1) 融合CUDA前向和反向内核，在单次内核启动中迭代两个独立的KV区域——共享上下文和每个序列的响应；(2) 在veRL中重新设计数据流水线，将N(P+R)个token重新打包为P+NR个token每微批，将token缩减从注意力扩展到整个模型，压缩因子ρ= N(P+R)/(P+NR)。

Result: Qwen3-8B GRPO训练（8×H100, N=32, 8K上下文）：1.63-2.09倍策略更新加速，支持2倍更大微批，MFU从36%提升至76%。DAPO：2.47倍加速，77% MFU。30B MoE规模（16×H100）：3.82倍策略更新加速，3.38倍端到端步加速（超越需要4路Ulysses序列并行才能避免OOM的FlashAttention）。

Conclusion: DualKV是首个在RL训练中消除共享提示复制的FlashAttention内核变体，数学等价于标准注意力且无近似，显著提升了长上下文大规模RL训练的计算效率。

Abstract: Modern RL post-training methods such as GRPO and DAPO train on $N$ response sequences of $R$ tokens sampled from a shared prompt of $P$ tokens, but standard FlashAttention replicates all $P$ prompt tokens $N$ times across both forward and backward passes -- duplicating compute and memory on identical hidden states. In large-rollout, long-context RL training ($N{\geq}16$, $P{\geq}8\text{K}$), this redundancy dominates the policy update cost. We observe that in decoder-only models, causal masking makes prompt representations invariant across sequences at every layer, so all per-token operations (norms, projections, MLP) and attention can process the prompt once -- a property not yet exploited at the kernel level for training. We propose \textbf{DualKV}, the first FlashAttention kernel variant that eliminates shared-prompt replication during RL training, via (1)~fused CUDA forward and backward kernels that iterate over two disjoint KV regions -- shared context and per-sequence response -- in a single kernel launch, and (2)~a data-pipeline redesign in veRL that repacks $N(P{+}R)$ tokens into $P{+}NR$ tokens per micro-batch, extending the token reduction from attention to the entire model by a factor $ρ= N(P{+}R)/(P{+}NR)$. DualKV is mathematically equivalent to standard attention and introduces no approximation. On Qwen3-8B GRPO training with 8$\times$H100 GPUs ($N{=}32$, 8K-context), DualKV achieves $1.63$--$2.09\times$ policy-update speedup, enables $2\times$ larger micro-batches, and raises MFU from $36\%$ to $76\%$. Similar gains hold for DAPO ($2.47\times$ speedup, $77\%$ MFU). At 30B MoE scale on 16$\times$H100, DualKV achieves $3.82\times$ policy-update and $3.38\times$ end-to-end step speedup over FlashAttention (which requires 4-way Ulysses sequence parallelism to avoid OOM).

</details>


### [514] [To MRL or not to MRL: Text Embeddings are Robust to Truncation Without Matryoshka Learning, Except In Heavy Truncation Scenarios](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16608)
*Sotaro Takeshita,Yurina Takeshita,Simone Paolo Ponzetto,Daniel Ruffinelli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究比较了使用MRL（套娃表示学习）训练和未使用MRL训练的文本编码器在向量截断方面的表现。结果表明，除非进行重度截断（减少至少80%），否则非MRL模型的截断嵌入与MRL模型竞争力相当甚至更优，说明截断鲁棒性可能并非来自MRL，选择是否使用MRL取决于是否需要重度截断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有研究显示随机截断文本嵌入对下游性能影响很小（除非减少至少70%），表明嵌入本身就对截断具有鲁棒性，但尚无工作将随机截断与MRL进行直接比较，因此不清楚两种方法作为嵌入缩减方式的效果差异。

Method: 将MRL使用的相同截断方法分别应用于使用MRL训练和未使用MRL训练的模型，在多个模型和下游任务上进行对比实验。

Result: 除非进行重度截断（减少至少80%），非MRL模型的截断嵌入与MRL模型竞争力相当，且往往表现更优。

Conclusion: 截断鲁棒性可能并非源于MRL训练；是否值得花费MRL的额外训练成本取决于是否需要进行重度截断。

Abstract: Matryoshka Representation Learning (MRL) is a widely adopted approach for training text encoders so they provide useful text representations at various sizes, available by simply truncating the resulting vectors at sizes pre-determined at training time. Recent works have shown that randomly truncating text embeddings has minimal impact in downstream performance unless vectors are reduced in size by at least 70%, suggesting that embeddings are already robust to truncation without the use of MRL. However, no prior work has compared random truncation to MRL, so it is unclear how the two methods compare as effective embedding reduction methods. In this paper, we study this by applying the same truncation used by MRL to models trained with and without MRL. Our results across several models and downstream tasks show that, unless heavily truncating embeddings (i.e. reducing their size by at least 80%), truncated embeddings of non-MRL models are competitive with, and often outperform models trained with MRL. This suggests that truncation robustness may not necessarily come from MRL, and that the choice of spending the additional training cost of MRL depends on whether heavy truncation is desired. We make our code available for reproduction.

</details>


### [515] [Matryoshka Concept Bottleneck Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20612)
*Ziye Chen,Hongbin Lin,Jie Li,Lijie Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出马特罗什卡概念瓶颈模型（MCBM），通过嵌套层次化概念组织，将测试时干预成本从线性降低到对数级别 O(log K)，无需重新训练即可实现自适应概念粒度推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有概念瓶颈模型（CBM）在实际部署中面临测试时干预成本高昂的问题：单一静态概念集迫使专家穷举标注所有概念，而训练多个不同预算的模型则带来巨大的计算和维护开销。亟需一种统一的架构，能够在不重新训练的前提下实现自适应概念利用，降低干预成本。

Method: 受马特罗什卡表示学习启发，将概念组织成基于最大相关性和最小冗余度的嵌套层次结构，使得单一模型能够支持多种概念粒度的推理，无需重新训练。

Result: 理论上证明MCBM将期望干预成本从线性降低到对数级别 O(log K)，并保证性能单调提升。实验表明MCBM在性能上与独立训练的模型相当，同时实现了动态高效的专家交互。

Conclusion: MCBM通过统一架构解决了CBM在测试时干预成本与模型灵活性之间的权衡，为可解释深度学习在实际场景中的部署提供了更实用的方案。

Abstract: Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) have emerged as a prominent paradigm for interpretable deep learning, learning by grounding predictions in human-understandable concepts. However, their practical deployment is hindered by the high cost of test-time intervention, as correcting model errors typically requires human experts to manually inspect and verify a large set of predicted concepts. Existing approaches suffer from a fundamental structural limitation: they either adopt a single static concept set, forcing experts to exhaustively annotate concepts and incurring prohibitive intervention costs, or train multiple models tailored to different concept budgets, resulting in substantial computational and maintenance overhead. To address this challenge, we propose the Matryoshka Concept Bottleneck Model (MCBM), a unified architecture that enables adaptive concept utilization within a single model. Inspired by Matryoshka Representation Learning, MCBM organizes concepts into a nested hierarchy based on maximum relevance and minimum redundancy, allowing inference at multiple levels of conceptual granularity without retraining. Theoretically, we show that MCBM reduces the expected intervention costs from linear to logarithmic order, $O(\log K)$, while guaranteeing monotonic performance improvement. Empirically, extensive experiments demonstrate that MCBM matches the performance of independently trained models while enabling dynamic and efficient expert interaction.

</details>


### [516] [A Tutorial on Diffusion Theory: From Differential Equations to Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.22586)
*Jiayi Fu,Yuxia Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提供了一个统一的、基于微分方程视角的扩散模型教程，从条件高斯加噪过程出发，推导了ODE/SDE表示、正向边缘动力学、反向时间SDE和概率流ODE，阐明了分数匹配与去噪目标的关系，并将DDPM、DDIM、流匹配、基于分数的SDE以及扩散语言模型纳入统一框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型的数学基础（扩散概率模型、基于分数的建模、随机微分方程、数值采样方法）往往被分开阐述，缺乏统一视角，给学习者和研究者带来理解障碍。本文旨在从微分方程角度提供一个自洽的统一教程，架起扩散过程分析基础与现代生成算法之间的桥梁。

Method: 从条件高斯加噪过程出发，推导ODE和SDE表示；推导正向边缘动力学；推导反向时间SDE和概率流ODE；利用分数匹配推导去噪目标函数（噪声预测参数化）；将DDPM、DDIM、流匹配、基于分数的SDEs置于同一框架下；扩展到连续嵌入空间的扩散语言模型及离散掩码token扩散。

Result: 统一了扩散模型的多种数学视角，证明了反向采样中的核心未知量是边际分数，阐明了分数匹配如何成为标准去噪目标，系统讨论了反向时间采样和引导技术。

Conclusion: 该教程作为扩散过程分析基础与现代生成算法之间的桥梁，为理解和进一步研究扩散模型提供了统一的数学框架。

Abstract: Diffusion models have emerged as a dominant framework for generative modeling, but their mathematical foundations are often presented separately through diffusion probabilistic models, score-based modeling, stochastic differential equations, and numerical sampling methods. We write this tutorial to provide a unified and self-contained account of these viewpoints from the perspective of differential equations. Starting from a conditional Gaussian noising process, we derive ordinary differential equation (ODE) and stochastic differential equation (SDE) representations, pass to the corresponding marginal forward dynamics, and then obtain the reverse-time SDE and probability-flow ODE that make generation possible. We show that the central unknown quantity in reverse sampling is the marginal score, explain how score matching becomes the standard denoising objective under a noise-prediction parameterization, and discuss practical reverse-time sampling and guidance. We further place DDPM, DDIM, flow matching, and score-based SDEs in a common framework, and conclude with diffusion language models in continuous embedding space together with a brief discussion of discrete masked-token diffusion. The tutorial is intended as a bridge between the analytical foundations of diffusion processes and the modern generative algorithms built upon them.

</details>


### [517] [The Distillation Game: Adaptive Attacks & Efficient Defenses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.22737)
*Youssef Allouah,Mahdi Haghifam,Sanmi Koyejo,Reza Shokri*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过最小最大博弈框架研究模型蒸馏攻击与防御的权衡，提出自适应评估规则（学生侧加权高价值样本）和教师侧PoE防御（前向传播、结合教师与代理学生）。实验表明自适应学生能显著恢复被防御模型的能力，缩小了昂贵防御与PoE的鲁棒性差距，而PoE更便宜且保留更高质量推理轨迹。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 蒸馏攻击为模型提供者带来部署权衡：使模型更有用的输出同时也使其更易被模仿。作者希望系统研究这种权衡，并提出可操作的防御与评估方法。

Method: 构建效用约束的教师与自适应学生之间的最小最大博弈；推导学生侧自适应评估规则（对高价值样本重新加权）和教师侧防御模板（抑制最利于蒸馏的输出）；基于样本价值的廉价代理，提出PoE防御（前向传播、教师与代理学生联合解码）。

Result: 自适应评估揭示了较大的被动-自适应差距：在SOTA防御上，自适应学生比被动评估恢复更多能力（GSM8K和MATH）。PoE与昂贵防御的鲁棒性差距缩小，且PoE更便宜、推理轨迹质量更高。

Conclusion: 强蒸馏仍然难以阻止；反蒸馏进展应基于自适应学生而非被动学生进行评估。

Abstract: Distillation attacks create a deployment trade-off for model providers: the same outputs that make a model more useful can also make it easier to imitate. We study this trade-off through a minimax game between a utility-constrained teacher and an adaptive student. Our framework yields tractable one-sided response rules: an adaptive evaluation rule in which the student reweights high-value examples, and a teacher-side defense template that suppresses outputs most useful for distillation. From a cheap proxy for example value, we derive Product-of-Experts (PoE), a simple forward-pass-only defense that combines the teacher with a proxy student during generation. Empirically, adaptive evaluation reveals a large passive--adaptive gap: on state-of-the-art defenses, adaptive students recover substantially more capability than passive evaluation suggests on GSM8K and MATH. Under this stronger evaluation, the apparent robustness gap between expensive defenses and PoE narrows considerably, while PoE remains substantially cheaper and preserves higher-quality reasoning traces. Overall, our results suggest that strong distillation remains difficult to stop, and that progress on antidistillation should be judged against adaptive students rather than passive ones. Our code is available at: https://github.com/ysfalh/distillation-game.

</details>


### [518] [Building a privacy-preserving Federated Recommender system for mobile devices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.22924)
*Aasheesh Singh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种两阶段联邦推荐系统，将非敏感的用户偏好数据与敏感的移动上下文数据分离，前者在云端进行协同过滤生成候选列表，后者在设备端利用敏感信号重排序，仅模型更新离开设备。在多个数据集上验证并在Kotlin跨平台库中实现生产级部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统移动端个性化推荐需要将敏感用户数据集中到中央服务器，这种做法与现代隐私期望和地域法规相冲突。亟需一种既能保护隐私又能提供高质量个性化推荐的方法。

Method: 两阶段联邦推荐管道：(1) 云端阶段：基于非敏感应用上下文数据运行协同过滤模型，生成相关物品的短列表；(2) 设备端阶段：利用敏感的移动上下文信号对候选列表进行重排序，仅模型更新/梯度离开设备。数据按原则分离：非敏感偏好数据与敏感上下文数据永不混合。

Result: 在MovieLens、UCI Human Activity Recognition以及一个专有试点数据集上验证了该方法，并交付了一个生产就绪的Kotlin Multiplatform库实现，可部署于Android和iOS。

Conclusion: 该方法实现了隐私保护与个性化推荐的平衡，通过严格的数据分离和联邦学习架构，使敏感上下文数据始终留在设备端，同时保持推荐质量，并具备跨平台的生产部署能力。

Abstract: Serving personalized content on mobile devices has traditionally required pooling sensitive user data on centralized servers, a practice increasingly at odds with modern privacy expectations and geographical regulations. We present a two-stage federated recommendation system pipeline for mobile devices, built around a principled separation between non-sensitive user preference data and sensitive mobile context data that never leaves the device. The first stage runs a collaborative filtering model on non-sensitive app-context data in the cloud to generate a shortlist of relevant items. The second stage re-ranks these candidates on-device using sensitive mobile signals, with only model updates/gradients ever leaving the device. We validate the approach on MovieLens, UCI Human Activity Recognition, and a proprietary pilot dataset, and deliver a production-ready implementation as a Kotlin Multiplatform library deployable on Android and iOS.

</details>


### [519] [Self-supervised Adversarial Purification for Graph Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.23239)
*Woohyun Lee,Hogun Park*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出GPR-GAE，一个基于广义PageRank滤波器的自监督图自编码器净化框架，通过将鲁棒性与分类器解耦，实现对图神经网络的对抗性防御。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统对抗训练方法将准确性与鲁棒性这两个冲突目标捆绑在同一个分类器中，难以有效平衡；现有对抗净化方法缺乏对多样图结构的自适应能力。

Method: 设计GPR-GAE作为专用净化器，采用自监督训练策略；利用多个广义PageRank（GPR）滤波器捕获多样化的结构表示；通过多步净化过程实现精确的图恢复。

Result: 在多种数据集和攻击场景下，GPR-GAE达到了最先进的鲁棒性，可作为独立的即插即用净化器用于GNN分类器。

Conclusion: 将鲁棒性与分类器解耦的净化范式有效解决了准确性与鲁棒性的权衡问题，GPR-GAE展现出色的泛化能力和防御性能。

Abstract: Defending Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) against adversarial attacks requires balancing accuracy and robustness, a trade-off often mishandled by traditional methods like adversarial training that intertwine these conflicting objectives within a single classifier. To overcome this limitation, we propose a self-supervised adversarial purification framework. We separate robustness from the classifier by introducing a dedicated purifier, which cleanses the input data before classification. In contrast to prior adversarial purification methods, we propose GPR-GAE, a novel graph auto-encoder (GAE), as a specialized purifier trained with a self-supervised strategy, adapting to diverse graph structures in a data-driven manner. Utilizing multiple Generalized PageRank (GPR) filters, GPR-GAE captures diverse structural representations for robust and effective purification. Our multi-step purification process further facilitates GPR-GAE to achieve precise graph recovery and robust defense against structural perturbations. Experiments across diverse datasets and attack scenarios demonstrate the state-of-the-art robustness of GPR-GAE, showcasing it as an independent plug-and-play purifier for GNN classifiers.

</details>


### [520] [Tiny Brains, Giant Impact: Uncovering the Keystone Neurons of LLM with Just a Few Prompts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24846)
*Xiangtian Ji,Yuxin Chen,Zhengzhou Cai,Xiang Wang,An Zhang,Tat-Seng Chua*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现Transformer模型中存在一类"基石神经元"（keystone neurons），这些神经元在所有任务中持续高度激活，其移除会导致模型行为崩溃。这类神经元训练前就已确立，参数精确校准对模型能力至关重要。基于此，提出仅更新基石神经元的微调方法，在极少参数修改下达到甚至超越全参数微调的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型展现出强大的综合能力，但其内部工作机制尚不明确，需要探索支撑模型行为的关键神经结构。

Method: 1）跨任务激活强度探针分析，分离出极度稀疏的神经元子集；2）验证这些神经元在预训练阶段确立且训练过程中参数紧密校准；3）提出仅更新基石神经元的监督微调方法。

Result: 移除基石神经元导致模型行为崩溃；仅更新基石神经元的微调方法在任务增益上达到或超越全参数微调，同时更好地保持其他能力维度的性能。

Conclusion: 基石神经元是模型中稳定且内在的神经元子集，其精确参数值对模型能力至关重要，基于此的稀疏微调方法具有高效性和优越性。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) display strong comprehensive abilities, yet the internal mechanisms that support these behaviors remain insufficiently understood. In this work, we show that across a wide range of open-weight Transformers, a subset of neurons remains consistently highly activated during inference across tasks of multiple capability dimensions. By probing along the cross-task activation strength, an extremely sparse subset is isolated, whose removal causes a collapse in model behavior, which we term keystone neurons. Our analysis reveals that keystone neurons are a stable and intrinsic neuron subset of the model that is largely established during pretraining. The parameters associated with these neurons are tightly calibrated during the training process, and their precise values are critical for the capabilities of the model. Building on these insights, we propose a supervised fine-tuning approach that updates only keystone neurons, achieving task gains comparable to or even better than full-parameter fine-tuning while better preserving performance in other capability dimensions, despite modifying a much smaller number of parameters.

</details>


### [521] [Theoretical Analysis of Sparse Optimization with Reparameterization, Weight Decay, and Adaptive Learning Rate](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25134)
*Huangyu Xu,Jingqin Yang,Qianqian Xu,Jiaye Teng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种名为ReWA的稀疏优化方法，通过重参数化、权重衰减和自适应学习率来解决ℓ_p正则化(0<p<1)中梯度无界导致的优化不稳定问题，实验表明该方法在保持测试精度的同时显著提升了稀疏性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ℓ_p正则化(0<p<1)在稀疏优化中效果优于ℓ_1正则化，但其梯度在零点附近无界，导致优化过程不稳定，需要一种既能保持良好稀疏性又能避免优化不稳定的方法。

Method: 提出ReWA方法，核心包括：(1) 重参数化(Reparameterization)改变优化景观；(2) 权重衰减(Weight decay)控制参数规模；(3) 自适应学习率(Adaptive learning rate)调整更新步长，三者协同缓解梯度无界问题。

Result: 在CIFAR-10和ImageNet数据集上使用ResNet架构进行实验，ReWA相比ℓ_1正则化方法显著提升了模型稀疏性，同时保持了测试精度。

Conclusion: ReWA通过重新设计优化策略有效解决了ℓ_p正则化的梯度不稳定问题，在保持精度的前提下实现了更优的稀疏性，为稀疏优化提供了新的有效方案。

Abstract: Sparse optimization is a fundamental challenge in various practical applications. A popular approach to sparse optimization is $\ell_p$ regularization. However, it may encounter optimization instability due to the unbounded gradients when $0<p<1$. In this paper, we introduce a novel approach to sparse optimization termed ReWA, based on Reparameterization, Weight decay, and Adaptive learning rate. ReWA is closely connected to $\ell_p$-regularization, yet it unveils a distinct optimization landscape that helps mitigate instability issues. Experiments on CIFAR-10 and ImageNet with ResNets demonstrate that ReWA leads to significant sparsity improvements over the $\ell_1$-regularization approach while preserving test accuracy.

</details>


### [522] [Autoregression-Free Neural Operators for Time-Dependent PDEs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25413)
*Jiaquan Zhang,Caiyan Qin,Haoyu Bian,Libin Cai,Yi Lu,Chaoning Zhang,Wei Dong,Yuanfang Guo,Yang Yang,Hen Tao Shen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出自回归自由神经算子(AFNO)，将PDE时间演化映射到潜空间并通过流匹配学习连续时间向量场，避免自回归滚动，在六个PDE上验证了长程预测的稳定性和误差降低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有神经算子处理时间依赖PDE时采用自回归滚动方式，直接在高维物理场空间递归预测，导致长程预测中误差逐步累积，且缺乏连续时间建模能力。

Method: AFNO将PDE时间演化映射到潜空间，在潜空间中利用流匹配(flow matching)学习连续时间向量场，避免自回归滚动，并通过显式物理参数条件化捕捉不同参数配置下的动力学。

Result: 在六个PDE上的理论分析和实验表明，AFNO相比基线方法显著提升了长程预测稳定性，并持续降低了滚动误差。

Conclusion: 潜空间连续时间建模结合流匹配是克服神经算子长程预测误差累积问题的有效途径，为时间依赖PDE求解提供了新的范式。

Abstract: Neural operators learn mappings from function-dependent inputs to solutions, providing an effective framework for solving partial differential equations (PDEs). For time-dependent PDEs, existing methods typically perform long-horizon prediction through autoregressive rollout directly in high-dimensional physical field spaces, where each predicted state is recursively fed back as the input for the next step. Although effective for short-term prediction, this autoregressive rollout and the lack of continuous-time modeling lead to progressive error accumulation over long-horizon rollouts. In this work, we propose Autoregression-Free Neural Operators (AFNO), which map the time evolution of PDEs into a latent space and model continuous-time vector fields within it. AFNO uses flow matching to learn the latent vector field, thereby enabling continuous evolution over extended horizons, avoiding autoregressive rollout and capturing dynamics under varying parameter configurations through explicit conditioning on physical parameters. Theoretical analysis and extensive experiments on six PDEs demonstrate that AFNO improves long-horizon prediction stability and consistently reduces rollout errors compared with the baselines.

</details>


### [523] [GoQuant: Geometric Orthogonal Residual Projection for Multiplier-Free Power-of-Two Transformer Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26092)
*Maoyang Xiang,Bo Wang,Tao Luo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GoQuant是一种算法-硬件协同设计框架，通过几何正交残差投影量化方法，在超低位宽（<4-bit）下用移位-加法操作替代传统MAC运算，解决了对数幂次量化中低角度分辨率导致的特征流形退化问题，在LLaMA-2-7B的3-bit量化下达到6.10困惑度，并将关键路径延迟降至0.35ns。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型和视觉Transformer在边缘设备部署受到内存限制和密集MAC阵列时序瓶颈的严重制约。超低位宽下的对数幂次量化虽可用移位替代MAC，但其非均匀指数格点存在低角度分辨率固有问题，在sub-4-bit阈值下导致高维特征流形显著退化。

Method: 将量化问题建模为双基几何投影，通过移位-加法操作自适应合成更高分辨率的残差格点；提出解析求解器替代计算密集的梯度优化，将LLaMA-2-7B全模型校准时间缩短至约15分钟。

Result: 在3-bit (W3/A16)约束下，LLaMA-2-7B困惑度达6.10，优于传统MAC密集型基线AWQ；4-bit场景保持竞争性精度。28nm节点标准单元RTL综合显示并行移位-加法数据路径将关键路径延迟降至0.35ns。

Conclusion: GoQuant通过算法-硬件协同设计有效缓解了超低位宽量化中的角度分辨率瓶颈，在无需非对称缩放的情况下实现了与MAC密集型方法相当的性能，同时显著降低了硬件时序瓶颈，适用于多模态边缘部署场景。

Abstract: The deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision Transformers (ViTs) on edge devices is significantly constrained by memory limitations and the critical timing bottlenecks introduced by dense Multiply-Accumulate (MAC) arrays. In the ultra-low bit regime, logarithmic Power-of-Two (PoT) quantization provides a hardware-efficient alternative by replacing MAC operations with bit-shifts. However, the non-uniform exponential lattice is inherently limited by a \textbf{Low Angular Resolution Regime}, a structural flaw that becomes particularly pronounced at sub-4-bit thresholds, leading to a notable degradation of high-dimensional feature manifolds. To address this geometric limitation, we propose Geometric Orthogonal Residual Projection Quantization (GoQuant), an algorithm-hardware co-design framework. By formulating quantization as a dual-basis geometric projection, GoQuant adaptively synthesizes a higher-resolution residual lattice using strictly shift-and-add operations. Furthermore, its analytical solver offers a practical alternative to computationally intensive gradient-based optimization, reducing the full-model calibration time for LLaMA-2-7B to approximately 15 minutes. Extensive evaluations demonstrate GoQuant's applicability across modalities and its hardware efficiency. Under the 3-bit (W3/A16) constraint, it achieves a perplexity of 6.10 on LLaMA-2-7B, comparing favorably to conventional MAC-intensive baselines like AWQ without relying on asymmetric scaling, while maintaining competitive accuracy in 4-bit scenarios. At the silicon level, standard-cell RTL synthesis at a 28nm node indicates that GoQuant effectively mitigates the timing bottlenecks associated with dense multiplier trees. By flattening the combinational logic depth, our parallel shift-and-add datapath reduces the critical path delay to 0.35 ns.

</details>


### [524] [Bridging Classification and Reconstruction: Cooperative Time Series Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26193)
*Qideng Tang,Dai Chaofan,Wubin Ma,Yahui Wu,Haohao Zhou,Tao Zhang,Huan Li,Dalin Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CoAD框架，通过统一分类范式（Outlier Exposure）和重构范式（Masked Autoencoder）实现时序异常检测，利用分类模块生成概率驱动的软掩码辅助重构模块，同时缓解分类模块的泛化问题，在多项基准测试中显著优于现有方法，且具备轻量高效的特点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度学习方法在检测细微和长期异常时效果不佳；OE方法受限于泛化能力差，MAE方法存在掩码对齐问题；亟需一种能融合两种范式优势并弥补各自缺陷的统一框架。

Method: 提出CoAD协作框架：1) 分类模块（基于Outlier Exposure）生成概率驱动的软掩码；2) 重构模块（基于Masked Autoencoder）利用软掩码进行重构；3) 重构模块的反向信息缓解分类模块的泛化问题；4) 分类模块针对分类粒度和频率信息丢失问题进行了专门设计。

Result: 在高质量基准数据集上、严格评估协议下，CoAD显著优于当前最先进的深度学习和传统数据挖掘方法；模型轻量且速度远超现有SOTA方法，适用于大规模实时应用。

Conclusion: 通过分类与重构范式的协作设计，CoAD有效解决了细微/复杂异常检测难题，证明了深度学习在时序异常检测中的潜力，并具备良好的实际部署价值。

Abstract: Time series anomaly detection (TSAD) has long been a hot research topic in data mining due to its various applications. Recent studies challenge the effectiveness of popular deep learning methods for TSAD, suggesting their failure in detecting subtle and prolonged anomalies. Outlier Exposure (OE) and Masked Autoencoder (MAE) emerge as two promising paradigms (classification and reconstruction) for solving the above problems. However, OE-based methods are constrained by poor generalization, while MAE-based methods are limited by masking misalignment issues. To address these limitations, this paper proposes a novel framework, CoAD, which unifies the two paradigms to leverage their complementary strengths while mitigating their respective weaknesses. In this framework, the classification module generates probability-informed soft masks for the reconstruction module, which in turn alleviates the generalization problem of the classification module. This cooperative design enables CoAD to effectively detect subtle and complex anomalies that are often overlooked by existing methods. Additionally, the classification module is carefully designed to resolve issues related to improper classification granularity and the neglect of frequency information. Extensive experiments on high-quality benchmark datasets, conducted under rigorous evaluation protocols, demonstrate that CoAD significantly outperforms both state-of-the-art deep learning and traditional data mining methods, highlighting the potential of deep learning in TSAD. Moreover, CoAD is lightweight and substantially faster than existing SOTA methods, demonstrating its practical value for large-scale, real-time applications.

</details>


### [525] [On the Role of Inductive Bias in Time-Series Pretraining: A Case Study in Learning Generalizable Representations for Clinical Time Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26194)
*Sharmita Dey,Diego Paez-Granados*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出PathoFM，一种用于脊髓损伤病理步态分析的编码器中心Transformer，通过局部补全、时间连续性和无监督上下文动态三种互补目标预训练，发现动态中心的目标混合策略（尤其是局部重建+时间连续性+上下文条件）能产生最平衡的跨任务（分类/回归）和跨受试者迁移的表征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床时间序列学习受限于小规模异质队列和协议漂移，而下游任务同时涵盖分类和回归。本文探究预训练目标应施加何种归纳偏好，才能使表征在任务类型和受试者之间有效迁移。

Method: 提出PathoFM，一种编码器中心Transformer，在多元步态窗口上以三种互补目标预训练：局部补全（重建连续掩码跨度以强化局部结构）、时间连续性（从观测前缀预测掩码中期延续以强化平滑性和因果一致性）、无监督上下文动态（通过注意力机制基于受试者示例窗口进行支持-查询重建）。

Result: 动态中心的目标混合产生最平衡的迁移效果：分组/对比目标有利于判别边界但降低连续目标的幅度保真度，纯重建目标保留波形结构但分类性能可能不足。结合局部重建和时间连续性，并在可行时加入上下文条件，产生稳健的受试者泛化表征。

Conclusion: 在病理步态分析中，预训练目标的设计应优先考虑动态中心的目标混合，而非单一的对比学习或纯重建目标，以实现跨任务类型和跨受试者的最佳迁移效果。

Abstract: Clinical time-series learning is routinely constrained by small, heterogeneous cohorts and protocol drift, while its downstream use spans both classification (e.g., pathology diagnosis) and regression (e.g., temporal forecasting). These constraints make foundation-model pretraining appealing, but raises an important question of which inductive biases should the pretraining objective impose so that representations transfer across task types and subjects. We study this question in pathological gait analysis for spinal cord injury (SCI) via PathoFM, an encoder-centric transformer pretrained on multivariate gait windows with three complementary objectives: Local Completion (reconstruct contiguous masked spans to enforce local structure), Temporal Continuity (predict a masked mid-horizon continuation from an observed prefix to enforce smoothness and causal consistency), and Unsupervised In-Context Dynamics (support-query reconstruction conditioned on subject exemplar windows via attention). Empirically comparing objective families (grouping/contrastive, dynamics-based, and generative reconstruction), we find that dynamics-centric mixtures produce the most balanced transfer: grouping objectives favor discriminative margins but can degrade magnitude fidelity needed for continuous targets, whereas reconstruction-only objectives preserve waveform structure but may underperform on classification. Overall, combining local reconstruction with temporal continuity, and adding in-context conditioning when exemplar access is realistic, yields robust subject-generalizing representations.

</details>


### [526] [Function-Valued Causal Influence in Nonlinear Time Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26408)
*Valentina V. Kuskova,Dmitry Zaytsev,Michael Coppedge*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 非线性时序因果发现中，标量边得分会严重丢失信息，本文提出基于个体条件期望的函数值因果影响分析框架，揭示状态依赖的非对称因果结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有非线性时序因果发现方法几乎都使用标量边得分来概括因果关系，但这种做法掩盖了非线性自回归模型所学习的真实对象——一个状态依赖的函数，其效应随机制、幅度和上下文而变化。标量得分混淆了状态间变异和状态内残差噪声，构成严重的信息瓶颈。

Method: 形式化了可加、贡献可分解架构下的函数值因果影响；以神经可加向量自回归为代表架构，引入基于个体条件期望的实用框架，直接从训练好的模型中估计因果响应函数。

Result: 通过控制合成实验证明，标量得分不可区分的边可能表现出截然不同的函数行为（单调、阈值、饱和、符号变化等）；民主发展案例研究进一步表明，函数值分析能揭示得分中心方法系统遗漏的特定机制和非对称因果结构。

Conclusion: 函数值因果分析能捕捉标量得分无法反映的丰富因果信息，是理解非线性时序因果关系的必要工具。

Abstract: Causal discovery in time series is increasingly performed using nonlinear machine-learning models, yet the resulting causal relationships are almost always summarized by scalar edge scores. We argue that this practice obscures the true object learned by nonlinear autoregressive models: a state-dependent function whose effect varies across regimes, magnitudes, and contexts. We formalize function-valued causal influence for additive, contribution-decomposable architectures and show that scalar causal scores constitute a severe information bottleneck, conflating between-state variation with within-state residual noise. Using Neural Additive Vector Autoregression as a representative architecture, we introduce a practical framework based on Individual Conditional Expectation for estimating causal response functions directly from trained models. Through controlled synthetic experiments, we demonstrate that edges with indistinguishable scalar scores can exhibit qualitatively different functional behaviors, including monotonic, thresholded, saturating, and sign-changing effects. An applied case study on democratic development further shows that function-valued analysis reveals regime-specific and asymmetric causal structure systematically missed by score-centric approaches.

</details>


### [527] [Localizing Memorized Regions in Diffusion Models via Coordinate-Wise Curvature Differences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26756)
*Gwangho Kim,Sungyoon Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于几何特征（坐标方差坍塌）的扩散模型局部记忆检测方法，通过曲率差分技术区分过拟合驱动的记忆与数据内在约束，并推导了分数差分代理指标，在Stable Diffusion上优于基于注意力的定位方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有扩散模型记忆检测方法依赖全局或模型级信号，难以定位生成图像中的记忆出现位置，且无法区分过拟合记忆与数据本身约束导致的特征坍塌。

Method: 1) 将局部记忆表征为坐标方差的几何坍塌；2) 提出曲率差分方法，通过减去欠拟合基线（无条件模型或自身早期版本）的曲率来分离过拟合驱动的记忆；3) 推导分数差分代理，为现有基于分数差值的检测指标提供几何解释。

Result: 在Stable Diffusion上，使用真实记忆掩膜评估，所提方法优于先前的基于注意力的定位方法。

Conclusion: 曲率差分能有效区分过拟合记忆与数据内在约束，分数差分代理为现有检测指标提供了几何理论基础，实现了更精准的局部记忆定位。

Abstract: Diffusion models can unintentionally memorize training samples, raising concerns about privacy and copyright. While recent methods can detect memorization, they often rely on global or model-specific signals and provide limited insight into where memorization appears within a generated image. We provide a geometric characterization of local memorization as a coordinate-wise variance collapse. However, such collapse can also arise from intrinsic data constraints rather than overfitting. To isolate overfitting-driven memorization, we propose curvature-difference methods that subtract the curvature of an underfitted baseline, either the unconditional model or a less-trained version of itself. We further derive a score-difference proxy that provides a geometric explanation for the widely used score-difference-based detection metric. Experiments on Stable Diffusion, evaluated against ground-truth memorization masks, show that our method outperforms the prior attention-based localization method. Code is available at https://github.com/Gwangho99/mem-curv-diff.

</details>


### [528] [Two Speeds of Learning: A Representation-Readout Decomposition of Grokking and Double Descent](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27078)
*Chi-Ning Chou,Oscar Uzdelewicz,Neng-Chun Chiu,Yao-Yuan Yang,SueYeon Chung*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出表示-读出分解框架，将训练动态分解为编码器表示学习和最终分类器读出校准两个竞争过程，用表征几何、神经正切核和线性探测工具揭示grokking和epoch-wise double descent等现象背后的机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有对grokking和epoch-wise double descent等异常泛化现象的解释往往任务特定，缺乏跨任务和架构的通用分析框架，亟需一个任务无关的分析工具来诊断和解释这些现象。

Method: 提出表示-读出分解框架，利用表征几何、神经正切核和线性探测等工具，将训练动态分解为编码器表示学习和分类器读出校准两个竞争过程，分析两者相对速度的波动如何产生异常泛化动态。

Result: 1）发现grokking中读出在爆发前偏向训练集，表示学习虽渐进但并未缺失，反驳了懒到丰富（lazy-to-rich）的已有解释；2）揭示了MNIST grokking和epoch-wise double descent中表观延迟或非单调泛化源于非标准训练导致的表示退化和读出失配；3）提供了区分真正泛化与伪泛化的诊断信号。

Conclusion: 表示-读出分解框架为理解学习动态和揭示底层算法提供了自上而下的分析工具，可用于可解释性研究。

Abstract: Training loss and accuracy are the standard signals used to monitor generalization during deep neural network training. Two well-documented phenomena complicate this picture: in grokking, train loss falls rapidly while test performance improves abruptly only after a long delay; in epoch-wise double descent, train loss decreases monotonically while test loss or error rises and falls. Existing accounts are often task-specific, and a task-agnostic analysis framework for diagnosing and explaining these phenomena across realistic tasks and architectures is missing. We address this challenge by analyzing two competing processes that underlie learning dynamics: representation learning in the encoder and readout calibration in the final classifier. Using tools from representational geometry, neural tangent kernels, and linear probing, we show that both processes are active throughout training, with the fluctuations of their relative speed giving rise to seemingly anomalous generalization dynamics. Applying the representation-readout decomposition to grokking across a wide range of tasks and architectures, we find that the readout is train-biased before grokking onset, and representation learning is gradual but not absent, contrary to the lazy-to-rich account. The framework further provides diagnostic signatures distinguishing spurious from genuine generalization: in a previously reported MNIST grokking example and an epoch-wise double descent example, apparent delayed or non-monotone generalization is shown to arise from representation degradation and readout misalignment induced by non-standard training recipes. Together, these results establish the representation-readout decomposition as a top-down framework for understanding learning dynamics and revealing underlying algorithms for interpretability research.

</details>


### [529] [Density-aware Sample-specific Attack](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27809)
*Qiyuan Wang,Yao Li,Raymond K. W. Wong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于密度比估计和后门攻击最优条件分析的后门攻击方法，通过将触发样本引导至干净数据分布的低密度区域，实现对微调和剪枝防御的免疫。在MNIST、CIFAR-10、GTSRB和TinyImageNet上，攻击成功率超99%，防御后仍比最强基线高50-85个百分点，对神经元剪枝防御完全免疫。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有后门攻击方法在微调或剪枝等防御手段下容易被擦除后门，缺乏对攻击最优性的理论指导。

Method: 首先从贝叶斯最优训练框架出发，推导样本特定触发器构建的最优准则，即触发样本应位于干净数据分布的低密度区域。提出双层优化框架，通过条件时间分数匹配估计密度比，并优化混合模型目标函数以实现触发样本的稀疏区域放置。

Result: 在MNIST、CIFAR-10、GTSRB和TinyImageNet上攻击成功率超99%；微调防御后仍保持比最强基线高50-85个百分点；对神经元剪枝防御完全免疫，所有剪枝阈值下均无神经元被识别为需移除。

Conclusion: 当前防御范式存在根本性缺陷，需要发展超越干净分布支持域的防御策略。

Abstract: Despite recent progress in backdoor attacks, existing methods remain susceptible to post-training defenses that erase the backdoor through fine-tuning or pruning. We revisit the core objectives of backdoor attacks and derive principled criteria characterizing optimal sample-specific trigger construction under a Bayes-optimal model of the victim's training. Our analysis reveals that both attack success and clean-accuracy preservation are simultaneously optimized when triggered samples are steered into low-density regions of the clean data distribution, a distributional condition that controls all moments of the poisoned distribution at once rather than a handful of input-space summary statistics. We introduce a bilevel optimization framework that estimates density ratios via conditional time-score matching and optimizes a mixture-model objective to place triggered samples in these sparse regions. Extensive evaluations on MNIST, CIFAR-10, GTSRB, and TinyImageNet demonstrate that our method achieves above 99\% attack success rate before defense and retains 50--85 percentage points higher post-defense ASR than the strongest baselines under fine-tuning defenses. Against neuron-pruning defenses, the method exhibits complete immunity, with zero neurons identified for removal across all pruning thresholds. These results expose a fundamental gap in current defense paradigms and underscore the need for defenses that operate beyond the support of the clean distribution.

</details>


### [530] [Continual Learning in Modern Hopfield Networks with an Application to Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27975)
*Ken Takeda,Masafumi Oizumi,Ryo Karakida*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文利用现代Hopfield能量分析扩散模型在持续学习中的遗忘机制，证明高能量异常样本更容易被遗忘，并提出基于能量的重放样本选择策略，在Stable Diffusion和DDPM上得到验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成模型（如扩散模型）被广泛用作基础模型并通过顺序微调适配，持续学习成为一个关键问题。然而，生成模型中的持续学习机制尚不清晰：任务变化后，学习分布的哪些方面最容易丢失？应该优先重放哪些样本？

Method: 利用现代Hopfield网络（MHN）与扩散模型之间的理论联系，将MHN中的分析迁移到扩散模型。定义内在遗忘为任务变化后Hopfield能量的增加。在MHN的可处理设置中，理论证明高能量离群样本比聚类样本经历更大的能量增加（即更容易遗忘）。进一步分析记忆重放，表明重放对高能量样本特别有效，从而实现基于能量的重放样本选择。

Result: 在MHN和两种扩散模型（Stable Diffusion和像素空间DDPM）的持续学习实验中验证了理论预测：Hopfield能量能够追踪基于重建的遗忘，重放实验显示出与MHN分析一致的能量依赖性遗忘缓解效果。

Conclusion: 现代Hopfield能量为理解和缓解扩散模型在持续学习中的遗忘提供了有效框架，基于能量的重放样本选择策略优于传统方法。

Abstract: Generative models, including diffusion models, are increasingly used as foundation models and adapted through sequential fine-tuning, making continual learning an essential problem setting. However, continual learning in such generative models remains poorly understood: after a task change, what aspects of the learned distribution are most easily lost, and what replay samples should be prioritized? We address these questions through the modern Hopfield energy. Recent links between modern Hopfield networks (MHNs) and diffusion models allow analyses in MHNs to be transferred to diffusion models. We introduce intrinsic forgetting as an increase in Hopfield energy after the task change. In tractable settings in an MHN, we prove that high-energy, outlier-like samples undergo a larger energy increase than cluster-like samples, implying that samples located in sharp, isolated basins are more forgettable. We further analyze memory replay and show that replay is particularly effective for high-energy samples, enabling an energy-based selection of replay samples. We validate these predictions in experiments on MHNs and two diffusion models under continual-learning settings: Stable Diffusion and a pixel-space DDPM. In these diffusion models, Hopfield energy tracks reconstruction-based forgetting, and replay experiments reveal energy-dependent mitigation of forgetting that is consistent with the MHN analysis.

</details>


### [531] [QuITE: Query-Based Irregular Time Series Embedding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28166)
*JungHoon Lim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出QuITE，一种即插即用的查询注意力嵌入模块，用于将不规则多变量时间序列转换为规则表示，无需修改主干架构或生成人工值，在预测和分类任务上分别取得最高54.7%和15.8%的平均相对提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法要么设计专门架构限制了成熟MTS模型的复用，要么通过插值映射到规则网格引入人工值扭曲时间动态。本文认为瓶颈不在于主干架构，而在于传统嵌入层假设均匀采样。

Method: 提出QuITE嵌入模块，使用可学习查询令牌通过单层自注意力聚合不规则观测值，直接生成与主干架构兼容的潜在表示，无需人工值生成或架构修改。

Result: 在真实世界基准上，QuITE一致提升MTS模型性能：预测任务平均相对提升最高54.7%，分类任务最高15.8%，覆盖多种数据集和主干架构。

Conclusion: QuITE作为即插即用模块有效解决了不规则时间序列的嵌入问题，验证了瓶颈在于嵌入层而非主干架构的假设，为复用现有规则MTS模型处理不规则数据提供了通用方案。

Abstract: Irregular Multivariate Time Series (IMTS) are common in practice, yet their irregular sampling complicates effective modeling. Existing approaches typically either (i) design specialized architectures that limit the reuse of proven Multivariate Time Series (MTS) models, or (ii) map IMTS onto regular temporal grids through interpolation, which may distort temporal dynamics by introducing artificial values. To address these limitations, we propose a new input-embedding-based approach. We identify that the key bottleneck lies not in the backbone architecture, but in conventional embedding layers that assume uniform sampling. In this work, we introduce QuITE (Query-Based Irregular Time Series Embedding), a simple yet effective plug-and-play embedding module for IMTS. QuITE employs learnable query tokens to aggregate irregular observations through a single self-attention layer, directly producing backbone-compatible latent representations without artificial value generation or architectural modification. Extensive experiments on real-world benchmarks show that QuITE consistently improves MTS models, yielding average relative gains of up to $54.7\%$ in forecasting and $15.8\%$ in classification across diverse datasets and backbone architectures. Code is available at: https://github.com/Meaningfull9502/QuITE.

</details>


### [532] [ProRL: Effective Reinforcement Learning for Proactive Recommendation via Rectified Policy Gradient Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28293)
*Hongru Hou,Tiehua Mei,Denghui Geng,Jinhui Huang,Ao Xu,Hengrui Chen,Jiaqing Liang,Deqing Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对主动推荐系统（PRS）中强化学习策略梯度存在的两个缺陷（长度依赖偏差和梯度方差高），提出了ProRL框架，通过Stepwise Reward Centering和Position-Specific Advantage Estimation两种机制，在三个真实数据集上显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主动推荐系统旨在通过生成中间推荐路径引导用户偏好向目标物品转移，但现有强化学习方法直接应用策略梯度会导致梯度估计存在缺陷，影响推荐效果。

Method: 提出ProRL框架，包含两种机制：(1) Stepwise Reward Centering - 减去期望奖励以消除长度依赖偏差；(2) Position-Specific Advantage Estimation - 利用奖励分解结构计算位置相关的基线，降低梯度方差。

Result: 在三个真实世界数据集上的实验表明，ProRL显著优于当前最先进的主动推荐系统。

Conclusion: 通过修正策略梯度中的偏差和方差问题，ProRL能够更精确地优化路径质量，有效提升主动推荐系统的引导效果。

Abstract: Proactive Recommender Systems (PRSs) aim to guide user preference shift toward target items by generating paths of intermediate recommendations. Reinforcement learning (RL) provides a principled framework for optimizing such sequential decision tasks, as path rewards can naturally capture both short-term acceptance and long-term guidance effectiveness. However, naively applying policy gradients to PRS results in deficient gradient estimation. We identify two deficiencies: (1) path-level rewards decompose into step-level rewards with positive mean, creating a length-dependent bias that causes gradients to favor path extension over meaningful exploration; (2) weighting each step by the entire path-level reward ignores the decomposition structure, leading to high gradient variance. To rectify these two deficiencies, we propose an effective RL framework ProRL with two novel mechanisms for proactive recommendation. First, Stepwise Reward Centering subtracts expected rewards to neutralize length-dependent bias, ensuring that path extension yields zero expected gradient signal. Second, Position-Specific Advantage Estimation leverages the reward decomposition structure to compute step-dependent baselines, reducing gradient variance. Together, these mechanisms yield policy gradients that precisely target path quality. Our experiments on three real-world datasets demonstrate that ProRL significantly outperforms state-of-the-art PRSs. Our code is available at https://github.com/hongruhou89/ProRL.

</details>


### [533] [LEIA: Learned Environment for Interactive Architected Materials](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28368)
*Haiqian Yang,Yuan Cao,Markus J. Buehler*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了LEIA，一个用于工程化超构材料的交互式世界模型，能够在三维非结构化网格上实时模拟用户指定载荷下的变形和应力场，并基于MicroPlate基准验证了其在显式/隐式微结构建模两种体制下的有效性，最终展示了其在基于代理的快速设计搜索中实现精确候选排序的能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界模型在游戏环境和机器人操作中取得成功，但物理工程领域仍难以企及——真实材料具有非线性本构关系、历史依赖内状态、惯性动力学以及跨尺度的层级结构，亟需一种能够处理这些复杂性的交互式仿真工具。

Method: LEIA采用自回归方式对用户指定的加载条件进行逐帧响应，能够处理大规模三维非结构化网格并实时输出变形与应力场。同时构建了MicroPlate基准，包含两种微结构建模体制：显式解析三维几何的格子结构和通过内隐自由度建模的均质板。

Result: 在MicroPlate基准上，LEIA与四种基线方法进行了比较评估，并在两种建模体制下均表现优异。进一步地，LEIA能够实现高效的候选生成与排序，用于超构材料的快速代理引导搜索，其应力精度通过有限元真实验证。

Conclusion: LEIA成功将世界模型范式拓展到物理工程领域，为超构材料的实时交互式仿真与加速设计优化提供了有效工具。

Abstract: World models have enabled interactive exploration of game environments and robotic manipulation, but physical engineering remains beyond their reach: real materials exhibit nonlinear constitutive laws, carry history-dependent internal state, undergo inertial dynamics, and may possess hierarchical structures spanning multiple length scales. We present LEIA (Learned Environment for Interactive Architected materials), a world model that lets engineers apply boundary conditions step by step and observe the resulting deformation and stress fields in real time. LEIA handles large three-dimensional unstructured meshes and generates autoregressive responses to user-specified loading. We introduce MicroPlate, a benchmark of architected plates spanning two regimes of microstructure modeling: architected lattices that resolve microstructure explicitly through three-dimensional geometry, and a homogeneous plate where microstructural change is modeled implicitly through internal degrees of freedom. MicroPlate is used to assess LEIA alongside four baseline methods across both regimes. Finally, we demonstrate that LEIA enables efficient candidate generation and ranking for fast surrogate-guided search for de novo designs of architected materials, with stress-accurate candidate ranking validated by finite element ground truth.

</details>


### [534] [Revisiting Metafeatures to Explain Model Differences on Tabular Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28418)
*Markus Herre,Andrej Tschalzev,Sascha Marton,Christian Bartelt*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了数据集元特征是否能解释不同模型族在表格预测任务上的性能差距。基于TabArena基准的51个数据集，经过严格的统计检验发现：(1)神经网络与树模型之间的性能差距无显著关联的元特征；(2)非基础模型与基础模型之间的差距有一个关联但无法泛化；(3)TabICLv2与TabPFN-2.6之间有一个关联能改善预测。总体上，全局元特征方法不足以解释表格数据集的异质性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表格基础模型兴起的同时传统模型在许多任务上仍表现良好，如何为特定表格数据集选择合适模型仍然困难。作者希望通过数据集元特征来解释不同模型族之间的性能差距，从而为模型选择提供指导。

Method: 使用TabArena基准结果，分析数据集层面的性能差距，将其与模型无关的数据集描述符进行关联。采用严格的统计检验并控制错误发现率，进行留一数据集预测分析。

Result: (1)神经网络与树模型性能差距无元特征通过错误发现控制；(2)非基础与基础模型差距有一个稳健关联但无法在留一法预测中泛化；(3)TabICLv2与TabPFN-2.6差距有一个稳健关联并能改善留出集预测。整体上，元特征预测器未能比简单基线有实质性改进。

Conclusion: 表格数据集存在高度异质性，全局元特征方法在TabArena的51个数据集上不够稳健，无法为模型选择提供可靠的解释。

Abstract: With the rise of tabular foundation models alongside traditional models still performing well on many tasks, choosing the right model for a tabular dataset remains difficult. We investigate whether dataset meta-features can explain performance gaps between model families on tabular prediction tasks. Using the TabArena benchmark results, we analyze dataset-level performance gaps and relate them to model-agnostic dataset descriptors. After strict statistical tests with false discovery control, we find that (1) for neural network vs. tree gaps, no meta-feature survives false discovery control, (2) for non-foundation vs. foundation model gaps, one association is robust but does not generalize when tested in leave-one-dataset-out prediction, and (3) for TabICLv2 vs. TabPFN-2.6, one robust association also improves held-out prediction. Furthermore, we conduct a leave-one-dataset-out analysis and find that meta-feature predictors fail to improve meaningfully over a simple baseline. Overall, our results show the heterogeneity of tabular datasets and that global meta-feature approaches are not robust enough to offer explanations on the 51 TabArena datasets.

</details>


### [535] [Stage-wise Distortion-Perception Traversal in Zero-shot Inverse Problems with Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28711)
*Jiawei Zhang,Ziyuan Liu,Leon Yan,Zhenyu Xiao,Yuantao Gu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出MAP-RPS和LMAP-RPS框架，通过单扩散模型在零样本逆问题中实现失真-感知权衡的动态遍历，包含MAP估计阶段（近似MMSE解、低失真初始化）和重噪声后验采样阶段（逐步提升感知质量），理论分析与实验验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 贝叶斯逆问题中存在失真-感知（D-P）权衡这一基本现象，现有扩散模型虽在零样本逆问题求解中取得成功，但缺乏高效且 principled 的策略来实现推理时对D-P权衡的灵活遍历。

Method: 提出两阶段框架MAP-RPS：第一阶段进行MAP估计，近似MMSE解并提供低失真初始化；第二阶段进行重噪声后验采样，逐步提升感知质量。同时扩展至潜在空间得到LMAP-RPS，利用大规模预训练潜在扩散骨干网络以提升适用性。

Result: 大量实验表明，MAP-RPS和LMAP-RPS在各种任务上实现了更有效的D-P权衡遍历，同时作为真实世界逆问题的高效求解器展现出强劲性能。

Conclusion: 该工作为扩散模型在零样本逆问题中实现可控的失真-感知权衡提供了理论严谨且实践有效的框架，具有广泛的应用前景。

Abstract: The distortion-perception (D-P) tradeoff is a fundamental phenomenon of Bayesian inverse problems, which characterizes the inherent tension between distortion performance and perceptual quality. Enabling flexible traversal of the D-P tradeoff at inference time is crucial for practical applications. Despite the recent success of diffusion models in zero-shot inverse problem solving, efficient and principled strategies for D-P traversal in diffusion-based inverse algorithms remain inadequately characterized. In this paper, we propose a stage-wise framework for realizing D-P traversal using a single diffusion model in zero-shot inverse problems. Our proposed method, termed MAP-RPS, starts with an MAP estimation stage that approximates the MMSE solution and provides a low-distortion initialization, followed by a re-noised posterior sampling stage that progressively improves perceptual quality. We provide theoretical analyses for both stages, establishing the validity and effectiveness of the proposed design. Furthermore, we extend MAP-RPS to the latent space, yielding LMAP-RPS, which enjoys broader applicability by leveraging large-scale pre-trained latent diffusion backbones. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MAP-RPS and LMAP-RPS enable more effective D-P traversal on various tasks, while also exhibiting strong performance as efficient solvers for real-world inverse problems.

</details>


<div id='q-bio.NC'></div>

# q-bio.NC [[Back]](#toc)

### [536] [Subcortical Shape Variations and Their Associations with Cognition Across the 8th Decade of Life. A Study in the Lothian Birth Cohort 1936](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29703)
*Maria del C. Valdes-Hernandez,Wonjung Park,Joanna Moodie,Susana Muñoz Maniega,Janie Corley,Fraser N. Sneden,Mark E. Bastin,Joanna M. Wardlaw,Simon R. Cox,Jinah Park*

Main category: q-bio.NC
